blade-cloak.desc: Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for 20 seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by 20%. Every 2 seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing 1153 Physical Damage to all enemies within 5 meters.

morphs.name: Quick Cloak
morphs.note: Increases duration and grants Major Expedition for a short duration after casting.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for 30 seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by 20%. Every 2 seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing 1154 Physical Damage to all enemies within 5 meters. You also gain Major Expedition for 4 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30%.

morphs.name: Deadly Cloak
morphs.note: Increases the damage done.
morphs.desc: Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for 20 seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by 20%. Every 2 seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing 1550 Physical Damage to all enemies within 5 meters.

arrow-spray.name: Arrow Spray
arrow-spray.desc: Fire a burst of arrows in one shot, dealing 4764 Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

morphs.name: Bombard
morphs.note: Immobilizes enemies hit and reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3240 Stamina, Duration: 4 seconds.
Fire a burst of arrows in one shot, dealing 4764 Physical Damage to enemies in front of you. Enemies hit are immobilized for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Acid Spray
morphs.note: Deals Poison Damage and adds additional damage over time.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 4 seconds.
Fire a burst of arrows in one shot, dealing 4764 Poison Damage to enemies in front of you, and dealing an additional 4465 Poison Damage over 5 seconds.

balanced-blade.name: Balanced Blade
balanced-blade.desc: WITH TWO-HANDED WEAPON EQUIPPED Reduces the Stamina cost of your Two-Handed abilities by 7%.
balanced-blade.desc_max: WITH TWO-HANDED WEAPON EQUIPPED Reduces the Stamina cost of your Two-Handed abilities by 15%.

accuracy.name: Accuracy
accuracy.desc: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Increases your Critical Chance rating by 657.
accuracy.desc_max: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Increases your Critical Chance rating by 1314.

blood-rage.name: Blood Rage
blood-rage.desc: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Honor your pact and let loose your rage. Increases the amount of Fury you generate by 5. Fury is generated by using Werewolf abilities while in combat. Once you have 1000, you gain access to the Rampage Ultimate, which increases your damage done by 15%, Movement Speed by 20%, and removes the cost of all Werewolf abilities for 20 seconds.
blood-rage.desc_max: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Honor your pact and let loose your rage. Increases the amount of Fury you generate by 10. Fury is generated by using Werewolf abilities while in combat. Once you have 1000, you gain access to the Rampage Ultimate, which increases your damage done by 15%, Movement Speed by 20%, and removes the cost of all Werewolf abilities for 20 seconds.

agility-skill.name: Agility
agility-skill.desc: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 1% for each piece of Medium Armor worn.
agility-skill.desc_max: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 2% for each piece of Medium Armor worn.

blade-of-woe.name: Blade of Woe
blade-of-woe.desc: Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%. This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

berserker-strike.name: Berserker Strike
berserker-strike.desc: Strike at an enemy with a vicious blow, dealing 9529 Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack ignores the target's Physical Resistance, and grants you Physical and Spell Resistance equal to the amount ignored from the initial target for 12 seconds.

morphs.name: Onslaught
morphs.note: Now grants Penetration rather than Resistances and guarantees Critical Chance, but for a shorter duration.
morphs.desc: Strike at an enemy with a vicious blow, dealing 9528 Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack ignores the target's Resistance and grants you Physical and Spell Penetration for direct damage attacks equal to 100% of the amount ignored from the initial target and if Battle Spirit is inactive you gain 100% Critical Chance for 8 seconds.

morphs.name: Berserker Rage
morphs.note: You are immune to all disabling, snare, and immobilization effects for the duration.
morphs.desc: Strike at an enemy with a vicious blow, dealing 9842 Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack ignores the target's Resistance and grants you Physical and Spell Resistance equal to the amount ignored from the initial target for 12 seconds. You are immune to all disabling, snare, and immobilization effects for the duration.

betty-netch-skill.name: Betty Netch
betty-netch-skill.desc:
Duration: 22 seconds.
Call a betty netch to your side, which grants you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 22 seconds. Every 5 seconds, the netch removes 1 negative effect from you. If no negative effects are removed you instead increase your damage done by 5% for 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Blue Betty
morphs.note: Restores Magicka every second while active.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 25 seconds.
Call a betty netch to your side, which restores 4992 Magicka to you over 25 seconds and grants you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%. Every 5 seconds, the netch removes 1 negative effect from you. If no negative effects are removed you instead increase your damage done by 5% for 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Bull Netch
morphs.note: Restores Stamina every second while active.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 25 seconds.
Call a bull netch to your side, which restores 4992 Stamina to you over 25 seconds and grants you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%. Every 5 seconds, the netch removes 1 negative effect from you. If no negative effects are removed you instead increase your damage done by 5% for 5 seconds.

bond-with-nature.name: Bond with Nature
bond-with-nature.desc: Anytime one of your Animal Companion skills end, you are healed for 765 Health.
bond-with-nature.desc_max: Anytime one of your Animal Companion skills end, you are healed for 1530 Health.

advanced-species.name: Advanced Species
advanced-species.desc: Increases your Critical Damage by 2% for each Animal Companion ability slotted.
advanced-species.desc_max: Increases your Critical Damage by 5% for each Animal Companion ability slotted.

arctic-wind.name: Arctic Wind
arctic-wind.desc: Envelop yourself in winter winds, instantly healing for 4958 Health and an additional 991 Health every 2 seconds over 10 seconds. This ability scales off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Polar Wind
morphs.note: Increases the healing over time and now heals a nearby ally for a portion of the initial heal.
morphs.desc:
Area: 12 meters, Target: Area.
Envelop yourself in winter winds, instantly healing for 4958 Health and healing for an additional 1365 Health every 2 seconds over 10 seconds. You also heal a nearby ally for 3305 Health. This ability scales off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Arctic Blast
morphs.note: Damages enemies instead of healing yourself but heals if no enemies are damaged. Stuns enemies after a delay. Reduces the cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka, Duration: 18 seconds, Area: 6 meters, Target: Area.
Envelop yourself in winter winds, instantly dealing 4921 Frost Damage to nearby enemies. If no enemies are hit, you heal for 6349 Health. The winds persist for 20 seconds and chill your foes to the bone, dealing 983 Frost Damage every 2 seconds, after 2 seconds. The damage has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect. Stuns enemies after the delay for 3 seconds.

accelerated-growth.name: Accelerated Growth
accelerated-growth.desc: When you heal yourself or an ally under 40% Health with a Green Balance ability you gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by 16% for 2 seconds.
accelerated-growth.desc_max: When you heal yourself or an ally under 40% Health with a Green Balance ability you gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by 16% for 4 seconds.

accelerate.name: Accelerate
accelerate.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka.
Bend time and space around you to gain Major Expedition for 4 seconds and Minor Force for 20 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% and Critical Damage by 10%.

morphs.name: Channeled Acceleration
morphs.note: Triples the duration, but adds a cast time.
morphs.desc:
Casting Time: 1.3 seconds, Cost: 3510 Magicka.
Bend time and space around you to gain Major Expedition for 12 seconds and Minor Force for 1 minute, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% and Critical Damage by 10%.

morphs.name: Race Against Time
morphs.note: Grants immunity to snares and immobilizations for a short duration.
morphs.desc: Bend time and space around you to gain Major Expedition for 4 seconds and Minor Force for 20 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% and Critical Damage by 10%. Activating this ability removes all snares and immobilizations from you and grants immunity to them for 4 seconds.

amplitude.name: Amplitude
amplitude.desc: Increases your damage done against enemies by 1% for every 20% current Health they have.
amplitude.desc_max: Increases your damage done against enemies by 1% for every 10% current Health they have.

bitter-harvest.name: Bitter Harvest
bitter-harvest.desc: Sap the lingering life from fresh corpses, granting you 2 Ultimate and healing 661 Health every 1 second for 2 seconds per corpse consumed. This ability scales off your Max Health. While slotted, your damage taken is reduced by 3%.

morphs.name: Deaden Pain
morphs.note: Doubles the duration and grants Major Protection while active.
morphs.desc: Sap the lingering life from fresh corpses, granting you 2 Ultimate and healing 682 Health every 1 second for 4 seconds per corpse consumed. While you have the heal effect, you gain Major Protection, reducing the damage you take by 10%. This ability scales off your Max Health. While slotted, your damage taken is reduced by 3%.

morphs.name: Necrotic Potency
morphs.note: Gain more Ultimate per corpse.
morphs.desc: Sap the lingering life from fresh corpses, granting you 6 Ultimate and healing 682 Health every 1 second for 2 seconds per corpse consumed. This ability scales off your Max Health. While slotted, your damage taken is reduced by 3%.

accursed-charge.name: Accursed Charge
accursed-charge.desc: Spring across the battlefield to smash an enemy, dealing 6300 Physical Damage.

blood-frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
blood-frenzy.desc: Allow your monstrous appetites to take hold, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 60 every 2 seconds, up to 5 times. While toggled on, the Health cost of this ability increases by 360 per stack and you cannot be healed by anyone but yourself, your pets, or your Companions.

morphs.name: Simmering Frenzy
morphs.note: Increases the Weapon and Spell Damage granted per stack.
morphs.desc: Allow your monstrous appetites to take hold, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 80 every 2 seconds, up to 5 times. While toggled on, the Health cost of this ability increases by 360 per stack and you cannot be healed by anyone but yourself, your pets, or your Companions.

morphs.name: Sated Fury
morphs.note: Reduces the ramping Health cost and when you toggle the ability off, you heal for a portion of the Health cost you spent.
morphs.desc: Allow your monstrous appetites to take hold, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 60 every 2 seconds, up to 5 times. While toggled on, the Health cost of this ability increases by 300 per stack and you cannot be healed by anyone but yourself, your pets, or your Companions. When toggled off, you heal for 33% of the total Health cost you spent while active.

blood-scion.name: Blood Scion
blood-scion.desc:
Cost: 335 Ultimate.
Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health. While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by 10000, you heal for 15% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls.

morphs.name: Swarming Scion
morphs.note: Bats swarm around you and deal damage to enemies that come close.
morphs.desc: Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health. While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by 10000, you heal for 15% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls. Bats also swarm around you and shred enemies that come close, dealing 2382 Magic Damage every 1 second.

morphs.name: Perfect Scion
morphs.note: You ascend to Vampire Stage 5.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 320 Ultimate.
Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health. While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by 10000, you heal for 15% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls. You also ascend to Vampire Stage 5, which grants all the benefits of Vampire Stage 4 with none of the drawbacks.

antiquarian-insight.name: Antiquarian Insight
antiquarian-insight.desc: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Simple difficulty.
antiquarian-insight.desc_max: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Ultimate difficulty.

augur.name: Augur
augur.desc: Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty. Only works on the lowest three layers of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot. Using Augur does not consume a turn.
augur.desc_max: Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty. Works on the lowest six layers of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot. Using Augur does not consume a turn.

abyssal-impact.name: Abyssal Impact
abyssal-impact.desc: Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes, dealing 5303 Physical Damage. Enemies are immobilized for 3 seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for 20 seconds. You deal 5% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

morphs.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
morphs.note: Generates Crux. Heals you if an enemy is damaged.
morphs.desc: Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing 5303 Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for 3 seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for 20 seconds. If an enemy is hit, you heal for 2737 Health, once per cast. You deal 5% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

morphs.name: Tentacular Dread
morphs.note: Converts into a Magicka ability and deals Frost Damage. Consume Crux to increase the base damage and Abyssal Ink strength.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3510 Magicka.
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes, dealing 5477 Frost Damage. Enemies are immobilized for 3 seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for 20 seconds. You deal 5% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink. Consume all Crux and increase Tentacular Dread damage by 33% and damage to foes drenched in Abyssal Ink by 2% per Crux spent.

aegis-of-the-unseen.name: Aegis of the Unseen
aegis-of-the-unseen.desc: Form a secret soldier within your mind, a defense against arcane forces without. While a beneficial Soldier of Apocrypha ability is active on you, increase your Armor by 1636.
aegis-of-the-unseen.desc_max: Form a secret soldier within your mind, a defense against arcane forces without. While a beneficial Soldier of Apocrypha ability is active on you, increase your Armor by 3271.

arcanists-domain.name: Arcanist's Domain
arcanists-domain.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Draw forth your tome and invoke the vigoratum of Hermaeus Mora to conjure a vortex of eldritch power. Entering this vortex grants you and your allies Minor Courage, Minor Fortitude, Minor Intellect, and Minor Endurance, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 215 and your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 15%.

morphs.name: Zenas' Empowering Disc
morphs.note: The effects remain on you and your allies for a short duration after leaving the area.
morphs.desc: Draw forth your tome and invoke the enigmatum of Morian Zenas to conjure a vortex of eldritch power. Entering this vortex grants you and your allies Minor Courage, Minor Fortitude, Minor Intellect, and Minor Endurance, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 215 and your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 15%. These effects cling to you and your allies for up to 10 seconds after leaving the vortex.

morphs.name: Reconstructive Domain
morphs.note: Heals you and your allies in the area over time.
morphs.desc: Draw forth your tome and invoke the leviathanum of the Abyssal Sea to conjure a vortex of eldritch power. Entering this vortex grants you and your allies Minor Courage, Minor Fortitude, Minor Intellect, and Minor Endurance, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 215 and your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 15%. The vortex also heals you and your allies for 12683 Health over 20 seconds.

apocryphal-gate.name: Apocryphal Gate
apocryphal-gate.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka.
Breach the world walls to create a portal at a target location. Its twin appears directly before you. Crossing the threshold allows you to teleport from one to the other for as long as the portals remain open. Apocryphal Gate generates Crux each time you teleport.

morphs.name: Fleet-Footed Gate
morphs.note: Increases your Movement Speed after teleporting.
morphs.desc: Breach the world walls to create a portal at a target location. Its twin appears directly before you. Crossing the threshold allows you to teleport from one to the other for as long as the portals remain open. After teleporting, you gain Major Expedition for 5 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30%. Fleet-Footed Gate generates Crux each time you teleport.

morphs.name: Passage Between Worlds
morphs.note: Grants a synergy to allies allowing them to teleport from one portal to the other.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3510 Magicka.
Breach the world walls to create a portal at a target location. Its twin appears directly before you. Crossing the threshold allows you to teleport from one to the other for as long as the portals remain open. Allies standing within either portal can activate the Passage synergy, allowing them to teleport to the opposite portal. Passage Between Worlds generates Crux each time you teleport.

a-soul-ablaze.name: A Soul Ablaze
a-soul-ablaze.desc: The will to survive burns bright in your chest. Increases your Healing Taken by 4%.
a-soul-ablaze.desc_max: The will to survive burns bright in your chest. Increases your Healing Taken by 8%.

blessing-at-the-peak.name: Blessing at the Peak
blessing-at-the-peak.desc: Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will. When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate 1 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 6 seconds. Increases your Critical Damage by 5%.
blessing-at-the-peak.desc_max: Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will. When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate 3 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 6 seconds. Increases your Critical Damage by 10%.

above-and-beyond.name: Above and Beyond
above-and-beyond.desc: An assassin is only as good as their reputation. Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by 25%. This effect is reduced to 5% against targets with Battle Spirit. Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by 30%.

abyssal-emergence.name: Abyssal Emergence
abyssal-emergence.desc: Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim. Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you 666 Weapon and Spell Damage for 15 seconds.

an-eye-for-exploitation.name: An Eye for Exploitation
an-eye-for-exploitation.desc: Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution. Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to 2000, based on your target's missing Health. Reduces your damage taken by up to 20%, based on your attacker's missing Health. Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

bastion-of-light.name: Bastion of Light
bastion-of-light.desc: Light consecrates the ground on which you tread. Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for 1280 Health every 1 second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain 2 Ultimate.

burning-light.name: Burning Light
burning-light.desc: When you deal damage you generate a stack of Burning Light for 3 seconds. After reaching 4 stacks, you deal 748 Magic Damage to your target. This effect can stack once every half second and scales off the higher of your Weapon and Spell Damage.
burning-light.desc_max: When you deal damage you generate a stack of Burning Light for 3 seconds. After reaching 4 stacks, you deal 1498 Magic Damage to your target. This effect can stack once every half second and scales off the higher of your Weapon and Spell Damage.

combustion.name: Combustion
combustion.desc: WITH AN ARDENT FLAME ABILITY SLOTTED To you, flame is fuel. When you apply Burning, you restore 112 Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every 1 second.
combustion.desc_max: WITH AN ARDENT FLAME ABILITY SLOTTED To you, flame is fuel. When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore 225 Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every 1 second.

continuous-attack.name: Continuous Attack
continuous-attack.desc: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 5% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 10% for 10 minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep. Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by 15%.
continuous-attack.desc_max: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 10% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 20% for 10 minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep. Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by 15%.

combat-frenzy.name: Combat Frenzy
combat-frenzy.desc: You generate 10 Ultimate when you kill an enemy player.
combat-frenzy.desc_max: You generate 20 Ultimate when you kill an enemy player.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.desc: Hurl a ball of caltrops that scatter over the target area, dealing 768 Physical Damage every 1 second to enemies inside, and reducing their Movement Speed by 50%.

morphs.name: Anti-Cavalry Caltrops
morphs.note: Increases the duration and drains the Mount Stamina of any enemy in the area.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 15 seconds.
Hurl a ball of caltrops that scatter over the target area, dealing 768 Physical Damage every 1 second to enemies inside, and reducing their Movement Speed by 50%. The caltrops also drain the Mount Stamina of any enemy in the area.

morphs.name: Razor Caltrops
morphs.note: Applies Major Breach to damaged enemies, reducing their Resistances.
morphs.desc: Hurl a ball of caltrops that scatter over the target area, dealing 768 Physical Damage every 1 second to enemies inside, and reducing their Movement Speed by 50%. Enemies who take damage from the caltrops have Major Breach applied to them, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 4.1 seconds.

daedric-protection.name: Daedric Protection
daedric-protection.desc: Reduce your damage taken by 2% while you have a Daedric Summoning ability active.
daedric-protection.desc_max: Reduce your damage taken by 5% while you have a Daedric Summoning ability active.

daedric-curse.name: Daedric Curse
daedric-curse.desc: Curse an enemy with a destructive rune, dealing 7940 Magic Damage to the target and all other nearby enemies after 6 seconds. You can have only one Daedric Curse active at a time.

morphs.name: Daedric Prey
morphs.note: Reduces the cost and your Daedric Summoning pets deal additional damage to the cursed target.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2160 Magicka.
Curse an enemy with a destructive rune, dealing 7939 Magic Damage to the target and all other nearby enemies after 6 seconds. While the curse is active, your Daedric Summoning pets prioritize the target and deal an additional 50% damage to them. You can have only one Daedric Prey active at a time.

morphs.name: Haunting Curse
morphs.note: The curse will continue to haunt the enemy and explode a second time.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 12 seconds.
Curse an enemy with a destructive rune, dealing 8200 Magic Damage to the target and all other nearby enemies after 3.5 seconds. The curse will continue to haunt the enemy and explode a second time, dealing 8200 Magic Damage to the target and all other nearby enemies after an additional 8.5 seconds. You can have only one Haunting Curse active at a time.

bound-armor.name: Bound Armor
bound-armor.desc: Protect yourself with the power of Oblivion, creating a suit of Daedric mail that increases your block mitigation by 36% for 2 seconds. The duration is based on your combined Physical and Spell Resistance. While slotted on either ability bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by 5%.

morphs.name: Bound Armaments
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability that grants Major Savagery. Light and Heavy attacks create Bound weapons that can be used to attack your current target. No longer grants block mitigation or Minor Protection.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 1377 Stamina, Range: 28 meters, Target: Enemy.
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Bound Armaments for 10 seconds, up to 8 times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks. When at one or more stacks, you can arm up to 4 of them to strike your target for 2359 Physical Damage every 0.3 seconds for each stack of Bound Armaments consumed.

morphs.name: Bound Aegis
morphs.note: Passively grants Minor Resolve while slotted. Increases the potency of the block mitigation.
morphs.desc: Protect yourself with the power of Oblivion, creating a suit of Daedric mail that increases your block mitigation by 50% for 2 seconds. The duration is based on your combined Physical and Spell Resistance. When slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection and Minor Resolve, reducing your damage taken by 5% and increasing your Armor by 2974.

conjured-ward.name: Conjured Ward
conjured-ward.desc: Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs 10226 damage for 6 seconds. This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at 55% of your Max Health.

morphs.name: Hardened Ward
morphs.note: Damage shield absorbs more and has a higher capped value.
morphs.desc: Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs 7375 damage for 6 seconds. This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at 72% of your Max Health.

morphs.name: Regenerative Ward
morphs.note: Reduces the cost, increases the duration of the shield, and also grants you and your allies Minor Intellect and Endurance. This ability now applies a self heal.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka, Duration: 10 seconds, Area: 20 meters, Target: Area.
Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs 10226 damage for 10 seconds, heals you for 831 Health, and grants Minor Intellect and Minor Endurance to you and nearby allies for 10 seconds. This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at 55% of your Max Health.

crystal-shard.name: Crystal Shard
crystal-shard.desc: Conjure dark crystals to bombard an enemy, dealing 6575 Magic Damage. Your next non-Ultimate ability cast within 3 seconds costs 10% less.

morphs.name: Crystal Weapon
morphs.note: Converts the ability into an instant cast Stamina ability, which causes your next three Light or Heavy Attacks to deal bonus Physical Damage and reduce the enemy's Armor.
morphs.desc:
Casting Time: Instant, Cost: 2295 Stamina, Duration: 6 seconds, Target: Self.
Encase your weapon in dark crystals for 6 seconds, causing your next 3 Light or Heavy Attacks to deal additional damage and reduce the target's Armor by 1000 for 5 seconds. The first hit deals 5715 Physical Damage and the others deal 2285 Physical Damage. You cannot conceal your presence while active. After casting, your next non-Ultimate ability used within 3 seconds costs 10% less.

morphs.name: Crystal Fragments
morphs.note: Casting abilities has a chance to make your next Crystal Fragments instant, deal more damage, and cost less.
morphs.desc: Conjure dark crystals to bombard an enemy, dealing 6790 Magic Damage. Your next non-Ultimate ability cast within 3 seconds costs 10% less. While slotted on either bar, casting a non-Ultimate ability has a 33% chance of causing your next Crystal Fragments to be instant cast at half cost, dealing 11274 Magic Damage.

daedric-mines.name: Daedric Mines
daedric-mines.desc: Surprise your foes by placing 3 volatile Daedric mines around you, which take 3 seconds to arm and last for 15 seconds. When a mine is triggered it explodes, dealing 7143 Magic Damage and immobilizing the enemy for 2 seconds. Enemies can only be damaged by your mines once every 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Daedric Tomb
morphs.note: You place the mines at a target location instead of around you. The mines arm instantly.
morphs.desc:
Range: 28 meters, Target: Ground.
Surprise your foes by placing 3 volatile Daedric mines at a target location, which arm instantly and last for 15 seconds. When a mine is triggered it explodes, dealing 7380 Magic Damage and immobilizing the enemy for 2 seconds. Enemies can only be damaged by your mines once every 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Daedric Refuge
morphs.note: Converts the mines into protective wards that shield you or allies when they activate.
morphs.desc: Carefully form 5 protective Daedric wards around you, which take 3 seconds to arm and last for 15 seconds. When a Daedric ward is triggered it grants you or the ally a damage shield that absorbs 8977 damage for 6 seconds. Targets can only be shielded by Daedric Refuge once every 2 seconds and the shield is capped at 43% of the target's Max Health.

controlled-fury.name: Controlled Fury
controlled-fury.desc: WHILE DUAL WIELDING Reduces the Stamina cost of Dual Wield abilities by 7%.
controlled-fury.desc_max: WHILE DUAL WIELDING Reduces the Stamina cost of Dual Wield abilities by 15%.

bounty-hunter.name: Bounty Hunter
bounty-hunter.desc: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

circle-of-protection.name: Circle of Protection
circle-of-protection.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Brand the earth at your location with a rune of protection for 20 seconds. You and your allies in the area gain Minor Protection and Minor Endurance, reducing your damage taken by 5% and increasing your Stamina Recovery by 15%.

morphs.name: Turn Evil
morphs.note: Enemies in the initial area upon activation are feared.
morphs.desc: Brand the earth at your location with a rune of protection for 20 seconds. You and your allies in the area gain Minor Protection and Minor Endurance, reducing your damage taken by 5% and increasing your Stamina Recovery by 15%. Upon activation, enemies in the area are feared for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Ring of Preservation
morphs.note: The rune now heals allies inside for the duration, but the rune lasts half as long.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 10 seconds.
Brand the earth at your location with a rune of protection for 10 seconds. You and your allies in the area gain Minor Protection and Minor Endurance, reducing damage taken by 5% and increasing Stamina Recovery by 15%, and are healed for 1189 Health every 1 second.

constitution.name: Constitution
constitution.desc: Increases your Health Recovery by 2% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. You restore 108 Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every 8 seconds.
constitution.desc_max: Increases your Health Recovery by 4% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. You restore 108 Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every 4 seconds.

concentration.name: Concentration
concentration.desc: Increases your Physical and Spell Penetration by 469 for each piece of Light Armor worn.
concentration.desc_max: Increases your Physical and Spell Penetration by 939 for each piece of Light Armor worn.

cycle-of-life.name: Cycle of Life
cycle-of-life.desc: WITH RESTORATION STAFF EQUIPPED Your fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore 15% more Magicka.
cycle-of-life.desc_max: WITH RESTORATION STAFF EQUIPPED Your fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore 30% more Magicka.

cleansing-ritual.name: Cleansing Ritual
cleansing-ritual.desc: Exalt in the sacred light of the Aedra, cleansing up to 2 harmful effects from yourself immediately and healing you and nearby allies for 2308 Health every 2 seconds for 20 seconds. Allies in the area can activate the Purify synergy, cleansing all harmful effects from themselves and healing for 5227 Health.

morphs.name: Ritual of Retribution
morphs.note: The area now harms enemies who enter it, rather than healing allies, and reduces the cost. Damage increases over duration.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4050 Magicka.
Exalt in the sacred light of the Aedra, cleansing up to 2 harmful effects from yourself immediately. While in the area, enemies take 1189 Magic Damage every 2 seconds for 20 seconds which increases by 12% per tick. Allies in the area can activate the Purify synergy, cleansing all harmful effects from themselves and healing for 5227 Health.

morphs.name: Extended Ritual
morphs.note: Increases the duration and the amount of harmful effects cleansed from yourself.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Exalt in the sacred light of the Aedra, cleansing up to 5 harmful effects from yourself immediately and healing you and nearby allies for 2307 Health every 2 seconds for 30 seconds. Allies in the area can activate the Purify synergy, cleansing all harmful effects from themselves and healing for 5227 Health.

catalyst.name: Catalyst
catalyst.desc: After drinking a potion you gain 11 Ultimate.
catalyst.desc_max: After drinking a potion you gain 22 Ultimate.

cripple.name: Cripple
cripple.desc: Sap an enemy's agility and wrack them with pain, dealing 12683 Magic Damage over 20 seconds and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Debilitate
morphs.note: Increases the snare potency and quintuples the chance to apply the Overcharged status effect.
morphs.desc: Sap an enemy's agility and wrack them with pain, dealing 13079 Magic Damage over 20 seconds and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 4 seconds. This ability has a higher chance of applying the Overcharged status effect.

morphs.name: Crippling Grasp
morphs.note: Converts some of the damage over time into more up front damage, immobilizes the enemy on impact, and reduces the cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka.
Sap an enemy's agility and wrack them with pain, dealing 3278 Magic Damage and an additional 11890 Magic Damage over 20 seconds, immobilizing them for 2 seconds, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

capacitor.name: Capacitor
capacitor.desc: Increases your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 70.
capacitor.desc_max: Increases your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 141.

combat-medic.name: Combat Medic
combat-medic.desc: Increases your healing done by 10% when you are near a Keep.
combat-medic.desc_max: Increases your healing done by 20% when you are near a Keep.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing 4764 Physical Damage to enemies in front of you. You also gain a damage shield that absorbs 4761 damage for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Carve
morphs.note: Converts into Bleed Damage and applies a bleed over time to enemies hit.
morphs.desc: Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing 4764 Bleed Damage to enemies in front of you, and causing them to bleed for an additional 7866 Bleed Damage over 12 seconds. Hitting a target that is already affected from this ability extends the duration by 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 32. You also gain a damage shield that absorbs 4763 damage for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Brawler
morphs.note: Damage shield now increases in strength for each enemy hit.
morphs.desc: Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing 4764 Physical Damage to enemies in front of you. You also gain a damage shield that absorbs 4919 damage for 6 seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by 50%, up to 300%.

critical-charge.name: Critical Charge
critical-charge.desc: Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing 3811 Physical Damage. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

morphs.name: Stampede
morphs.note: Increases the cost and the charge now deals damage in an area around the target, and leaves residual damage at the impact area.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4590 Stamina, Duration: 15 seconds, Area: 5 meters.
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing 3811 Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike. After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing 873 Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every 1 second for 15 seconds.

morphs.name: Critical Rush
morphs.note: Deals more damage based on the distance traveled. Reduces the cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3240 Stamina.
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing 3811 Physical Damage. Deals up to 50% more damage based on the distance traveled. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

bone-shield.name: Bone Shield
bone-shield.desc: Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to 4958 damage for 6 seconds. This ability scales off your Max Health. An ally near you can activate the Bone Wall synergy, granting the ally and up to 5 other allies a damage shield equal to 30% of their Max Health for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Spiked Bone Shield
morphs.note: Absorbing direct damage causes you to deal a portion of the damage back to enemies if they are in melee range.
morphs.desc: Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to 4958 damage for 6 seconds and returns 100% of direct damage absorbed back to the enemy. This ability scales off your Max Health. An ally near you can activate the Bone Wall synergy, granting the ally and up to 5 other allies a damage shield equal to 30% of their Max Health for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Bone Surge
morphs.note: Upgrades the synergy to grant Major Vitality.
morphs.desc: Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to 5121 damage for 6 seconds. This ability scales off your Max Health. An ally near you can activate the Spinal Surge synergy, granting up to 6 allies a damage shield that absorbs up to 30% of their Max Health for 6 seconds and Major Vitality, increasing their healing received and damage shield strength by 12%.

consuming-darkness-skill.name: Consuming Darkness
consuming-darkness-skill.desc:
Duration: 13 seconds.
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by 70% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by 10%. Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by 70%, and healing them for 24900 Health over 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Bolstering Darkness
morphs.note: Major Protection persists after leaving the area.
morphs.desc: Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by 70% and granting you and your allies Major Protection for 10 seconds, reducing your damage taken by 10%. Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by 70%, and healing them for 24900 Health over 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Veil of Blades
morphs.note: Enemies in the area take damage over time.
morphs.desc: Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by 70%, dealing 3934 Magic Damage to them every 1 second, and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by 10%. Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by 70%, and healing them for 24900 Health over 4 seconds.

clemency.name: Clemency
clemency.desc: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for 1 minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

crystallized-shield.name: Crystallized Shield
crystallized-shield.desc: Spin a shield of ice around you, absorbing up to 16528 damage from 3 projectiles. Each time you absorb a projectile you gain 2 Ultimate.

morphs.name: Crystallized Slab
morphs.note: Greatly increases the shield strength. Absorbing projectiles launches an icy bolt back at the enemy, damaging and stunning them, but no longer restores Ultimate.
morphs.desc: Spin a shield of ice around you, absorbing up to 24792 damage from 3 projectiles. Each time you absorb a projectile you launch an icy bolt back at the enemy, dealing 3278 Frost Damage and stunning them for 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Shimmering Shield
morphs.note: Absorbing projectiles grants you Major Heroism and reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4050 Magicka.
Spin a shield of ice around you, absorbing up to 16528 damage from 3 projectiles. Each time you absorb a projectile you gain 2 Ultimate and gain Major Heroism for 6 seconds, granting you 3 Ultimate every 1.5 seconds.

clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
clairvoyance.desc: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by 8%.
clairvoyance.desc_max: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by 15%.

concentrated-barrier.name: Concentrated Barrier
concentrated-barrier.desc: While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs 2500 damage. This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend 10 seconds not Bracing.
concentrated-barrier.desc_max: While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs 5000 damage. This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend 10 seconds not Bracing.

curative-curse.name: Curative Curse
curative-curse.desc: While you have a negative effect on you, your healing done is increased by 6%.
curative-curse.desc_max: While you have a negative effect on you, your healing done is increased by 12%.

corpse-consumption.name: Corpse Consumption
corpse-consumption.desc: When you consume a corpse, you generate 5 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 16 seconds.
corpse-consumption.desc_max: When you consume a corpse, you generate 10 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 16 seconds.

bone-armor.name: Bone Armor
bone-armor.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Wrap yourself in hardened bone, granting you Major and Minor Resolve, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948 and 2974 for 20 seconds. If cast during combat, you can cast a corpse consuming ability on yourself. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Beckoning Armor
morphs.note: Pulls in ranged enemies and attempts to taunt them. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Magicka.
Wrap yourself in hardened bone, granting you Major Resolve and Minor Resolve for 20 seconds, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948 and 2974. While active, ranged attackers will be pulled to you once every 2 seconds and become taunted for 15 seconds if they are not already taunted. If cast during combat, you can cast a corpse consuming ability on yourself. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Summoner's Armor
morphs.note: Increases the duration. While active, reduces the cost of your Necromancer summon abilities.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Wrap yourself in hardened bone, granting you Major Resolve and Minor Resolve for 30 seconds, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948 and 2974. While active, reduce the cost of Blastbones, Skeletal Mage, and Spirit Mender by 15%. If cast during combat, you can cast a corpse consuming ability on yourself. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

boneyard.name: Boneyard
boneyard.desc: Desecrate the ground at the target location, dealing 8448 Frost Damage over 10 seconds to enemies inside and applying Minor Vulnerability, increasing their damage taken by 5%. Consumes a corpse on cast to deal 30% more damage. An ally in the area can activate the Grave Robber synergy, dealing 6149 Frost Damage to nearby enemies and healing for the damage done.

morphs.name: Unnerving Boneyard
morphs.note: Applies Major Breach and Minor Vulnerability each tick, persisting for a duration when enemies leave the area.
morphs.desc: Desecrate the ground at the target location, dealing 8734 Frost Damage over 10 seconds to enemies inside and applying Major Breach and Minor Vulnerability, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 and increasing damage taken by 5% for 4.1 seconds each tick. Consumes a corpse on cast to deal 30% more damage. An ally in the area can activate the Grave Robber synergy, dealing 6149 Frost Damage to nearby enemies and healing for the damage done.

morphs.name: Avid Boneyard
morphs.note: You can use your own synergy.
morphs.desc: Desecrate the ground at the target location, dealing 8734 Frost Damage over 10 seconds to enemies inside and applying Minor Vulnerability, increasing their damage taken by 5%. Consumes a corpse on cast to deal 30% more damage. You or an ally in the area can activate the Grave Robber synergy, dealing 6149 Frost Damage to enemies and healing for the damage done.

bone-totem.name: Bone Totem
bone-totem.desc:
Cost: 4050 Magicka.
Conjure an effigy of bone at your feet for 11 seconds that grants Minor Protection to you and your allies, reducing damage taken by 5%. Enemies in the area are afflicted with Major Cowardice, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by 430. After 2 seconds, the totem begins fearing nearby enemies every 2 seconds, causing them to cower in place for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Remote Totem
morphs.note: The totem can be summoned up to 28 meters away, and costs less.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3240 Magicka, Range: 28 meters, Target: Ground.
Conjure an effigy of bone for 11 seconds that grants Minor Protection to you and your allies, reducing damage taken by 5%. Enemies in the area are afflicted with Major Cowardice, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by 430. After 2 seconds, the totem begins fearing nearby enemies every 2 seconds, causing them to cower in place for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Agony Totem
morphs.note: Allies can activate a synergy to damage to enemies. Increases the duration of the totem as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 13 seconds.
Conjure an effigy of bone at your feet for 13 seconds that grants Minor Protection to you and your allies, reducing damage taken by 5%. Enemies in the area are afflicted with Major Cowardice. After 2 seconds, the totem begins fearing nearby enemies every 2 seconds, causing them to cower in place for 4 seconds. Allies can activate the Pure Agony synergy, dealing 6186 Magic Damage over 5 seconds to enemies.

bone-goliath-transformation.name: Bone Goliath Transformation
bone-goliath-transformation.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Become a horrific Bone Goliath, increasing your Max Health by 30000 for 20 seconds and immediately restoring 30000 Health. You cannot conceal your presence while active. While transformed, your damaging Light Attacks restore 320 Health and your fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore 800 Health. This ability scales off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Pummeling Goliath
morphs.note: While transformed your Bash attack now scales off your offensive stats, and deal damage in a cone in front of you, but have an increased cooldown.
morphs.desc: Become a destructive Pummeling Goliath, increasing your Max Health by 30000 for 20 seconds. You cannot conceal your presence while active. While transformed, damaging Light Attacks restore 320 Health and fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore 800 Health, scaling off your Max Health. Your Bash attacks hit in an area in front of you, dealing 8748 Physical Damage, but can be used once per second.

morphs.name: Ravenous Goliath
morphs.note: Adds damage in an area around you that damages enemies and heals you while transformed.
morphs.desc: Become a horrific Ravenous Goliath, increasing your Max Health by 30000 for 20 seconds and immediately restoring 30000 Health. You cannot conceal your presence while active. While transformed, your damaging Light Attacks restore 320 Health and fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore 800 Health. You deal 826 Magic Damage to nearby enemies every second and heal for that amount. These abilities scale off your Max Health.

coalescence.name: Coalescence
coalescence.desc: Unites a hexagonal cluster of facets in the Antiquarian's Eye, converting the symbols to match that of the central facet. Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.
coalescence.desc_max: Unites a hexagonal cluster of facets in the Antiquarian's Eye, converting the symbols to match that of the central facet. New Effect: The ability's range increases by one facet, creating a snowflake-like pattern. Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

circumvented-fate.name: Circumvented Fate
circumvented-fate.desc: Casting an Arcanist ability warps the weave of fate around you, granting you and your group members Minor Evasion for 10 seconds and reducing damage from area attacks by 10%. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.
circumvented-fate.desc_max: Casting an Arcanist ability warps the weave of fate around you, granting you and your group members Minor Evasion for 20 seconds and reducing damage from area attacks by 10%. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.

chakram-shields.name: Chakram Shields
chakram-shields.desc: Cost determined by highest max resource Carve the runes of the Blind Man to call forth spinning mystical discs. Discs surround you or up to 4 allies in front of you, granting a shield that absorbs 7666 damage for 6 seconds. Discs prefer your reticle target, or low-Health targets without shields.

morphs.name: Chakram of Destiny
morphs.note: Creates a Crux. Recasting the shield on a target increases the maximum strength of the shield.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4320 Magicka.
Cost determined by highest max resource Carve the Fate Crone's runes to create spinning mystical discs and generate Crux. Discs surround you or up to 4 allies in front of you, granting a shield that absorbs 7668 damage for 6 seconds. Recasting on a target already shielded grants a new shield that is 30% stronger. Discs prefer your reticle target, or low-Health targets without shields.

morphs.name: Tidal Chakram
morphs.note: Consumes Crux to heal based on the shield's strength every second it persists.
morphs.desc: Cost determined by highest max resource Carve the Baron of Breakers' runes to create spinning discs. Discs surround you or up to 4 allies in front of you, granting a shield that absorbs 7921 damage for 6 seconds. Consume Crux to cause the shields to heal for 33% of the shield's remaining strength every 1 second per Crux spent. Discs prefer your reticle target, or low-Health targets without shields.

burnished-scales.name: Burnished Scales
burnished-scales.desc: A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade. Increases the amount of damage you block by 4%.
burnished-scales.desc_max: A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade. Increases the amount of damage you block by 10%.

chains-of-flame.name: Chains of Flame
chains-of-flame.desc: Lash out with a flaming chain, pulling an enemy to you. The searing metal deals 3811 Flame Damage, applies the Burning status effect, and taunts them for 15 seconds if they are not already taunted. This attack cannot be dodged or reflected. Also inflicts Major Cowardice on the enemy, reducing Weapon and Spell Damage by 430 for 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Chains of Devastation
morphs.note: Converts the enemy pull into a self pull that no longer taunts or debuffs. Grants Major Berserk and Major Evasion.
morphs.desc: Lash out with a chain bound in jagged links, pulling yourself to an enemy. The searing metal deals 3936 Flame Damage and applies the Burning status effect. This attack cannot be dodged or reflected. Hitting the target grants you Major Berserk for 6 seconds and Major Evasion for 10 seconds, increasing damage done by 10% reducing damage taken from area attacks by 20%.

morphs.name: Chains of Dominance
morphs.note: If the target cannot be pulled, you are refunded the Magicka cost. Extends the duration of the Major Cowardice.
morphs.desc: Lash out with a chain bound in Draconic runes, pulling an enemy to you. The enchanted metal deals 3811 Flame Damage, applies the Burning status effect, and taunts them for 15 seconds if they are not already taunted. If the target cannot be pulled, you restore the ability's Magicka cost. This attack cannot be dodged or reflected. Also inflicts Major Cowardice on the enemy, reducing Weapon and Spell Damage by 430 for 15 seconds.

core-of-flame.name: Core of Flame
core-of-flame.desc: Let the fire within draw heat to your core, restoring 12% of your missing Magicka and Stamina every 2 seconds over 4 seconds. When this ability completes, you release this heat as a blast of fire that deals 5477 Flame Damage to nearby enemies.

morphs.name: Soul of Flame
morphs.note: Initial hit interrupts enemies that are casting. Final explosion damage increased.
morphs.desc: Let the fire within draw heat to your soul, restoring 12% of your missing Magicka and Stamina every 2 seconds over 4 seconds. Much of this heat is drawn from enemies around you. Those that are casting are interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for 2 seconds. When this ability completes, you release this heat as a blast of fire that deals 7546 Flame Damage to nearby enemies.

morphs.name: Heart of Flame
morphs.note: Adds a heal based on max Health.
morphs.desc: Let the fire within draw heat to your heart, restoring 12% of your missing Magicka and Stamina and healing 2048 Health every 2 seconds over 4 seconds. When this ability completes, you release this heat as a blast of fire that deals 5478 Flame Damage to nearby enemies.

booming-voice.name: Booming Voice
booming-voice.desc: Let your voice echo across the peaks. Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants 5 Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for 10 seconds after a delay of 15 seconds.

bountiful-harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
bountiful-harvest.desc: Share in the spoils of nature's abundance. Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for 3 seconds and an additional 125 Magicka and Stamina, up to once every 2 seconds.

bright-harbinger.name: Bright Harbinger
bright-harbinger.desc: Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer. Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants 300 Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.

calculated-defense.name: Calculated Defense
calculated-defense.desc: Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance. While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for 0.5 seconds that can absorb 5280 damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain 6% Weapon and Spell Damage for 20 seconds.

call-of-the-hunt.name: Call of the Hunt
call-of-the-hunt.desc: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM No beast can resist their master's call. Hunt as one and none shall escape. Reduces the cost of remaining in your Werewolf Transformation by 8%, plus 8% for each transformed werewolf or direwolf in your group, including yourself, up to a maximum of 40%.
call-of-the-hunt.desc_max: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM No beast can resist their master's call. Hunt as one and none shall escape. Reduces the cost of remaining in your Werewolf Transformation by 16%, plus 16% for each transformed werewolf or direwolf in your group, including yourself, up to a maximum of 80%.
call-of-the-hunt.img_note: The wiki has no icon for this passive; the picture is the Werewolf line's Werewolf Transformation.

conservation-of-energy.name: Conservation of Energy
conservation-of-energy.desc: Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study. Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores 450 Magicka and 450 Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.

cutthroats-focus.name: Cutthroat's Focus
cutthroats-focus.desc: This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance. Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for 0.3 seconds. Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by 5% for 5 seconds, increasing to 20 seconds against monsters.

cycle-unending.name: Cycle Unending
cycle-unending.desc: The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die. Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for 25 seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by 1% for every 1% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at 25%, or 10% against players.

dragonknight-standard.name: Dragonknight Standard
dragonknight-standard.desc: Call down a battle standard for 15 seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 300 and reducing damage taken by 10%. An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing 9225 Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Shifting Standard
morphs.note: Now deals damage and debuffs enemies rather than granting you and group members bonuses. Increases the duration, and recasting the ability allows you to move the standard.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 25 seconds.
Call down a battle standard, dealing 2458 Flame Damage every 1 second for 25 seconds to enemies and applying Major Defile to them, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by 12%. Activating this ability again allows you to move the standard to your location. An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing 9225 Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Standard of Might
morphs.note: Enhances the bonuses you gain by standing in the banner.
morphs.desc: Call down a battle standard for 15 seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 300 and reducing damage taken by 10%. You gain an additional 15% damage done, 15% reduced damage taken, and 300 Weapon and Spell Damage. An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing 9225 Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for 5 seconds.

death-stroke.name: Death Stroke
death-stroke.desc: Ravage an enemy with a swift strike, dealing 10164 Magic Damage and causing them to take 20% more damage from your attacks for 8 seconds.

morphs.name: Incapacitating Strike
morphs.note: Deals Disease Damage. Improves the ability significantly if cast with more Ultimate.
morphs.desc: Ravage an enemy with a swift strike, dealing 10499 Disease Damage and causing them to take 20% more damage from your attacks for 8 seconds. If cast with 120 or more Ultimate, you instead deal 11548 Disease Damage, stun the enemy for 3 seconds, and increase the duration of the damage taken effect to 12 seconds.

morphs.name: Soul Harvest
morphs.note: Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile. While slotted on either bar, gain Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.
morphs.desc: Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing 10164 Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by 20% for 8 seconds. Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by 12%. While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain 10 Ultimate.

encase.name: Encase
encase.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka.
Call forth Daedric shards from the earth to immobilize enemies in front of you for 4 seconds. Enemies hit are afflicted with Major Maim, reducing their damage done by 10% for 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Shattering Spines
morphs.note: The ability no longer has a cap of how many targets it can affect, and now deals damage when the effect ends.
morphs.desc: Call forth Daedric shards from the earth to encase and immobilize all enemies in front of you for 4 seconds. After the effect ends the shards shatter, dealing 5413 Magic Damage to any enemy that was encased. Enemies hit are afflicted with Major Maim, reducing their damage done by 10% for 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Vibrant Shroud
morphs.note: The area now heals you and allies, rather than immobilizing enemies, but at an increased cost. Healed targets receive Minor Vitality.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4860 Magicka.
Call forth a Daedric shroud from the Colored Rooms to heal you and your allies and enfeeble foes in front of you. You and allies in the area are healed for 7381 Health and receive Minor Vitality, increasing your healing received and damage shield strength by 6% for 10 seconds. Enemies are afflicted with Major Maim, reducing their damage done by 10% for 10 seconds.

dark-exchange.name: Dark Exchange
dark-exchange.desc: Bargain with darkness to restore 8000 Health and 3600 Magicka instantly, and an additional 2400 Magicka over 20 seconds. The exchange also grants you Minor Berserk for 20 seconds, increasing your damage done by 5%.

morphs.name: Dark Deal
morphs.note: Converts Magicka into Health and Stamina instead. Reduces the cost and the time it takes the ability to restore resources.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka, Duration: 10 seconds.
Bargain with darkness to restore 8000 Health and 3600 Stamina instantly, and an additional 2400 Stamina over 10 seconds. The exchange also grants you Minor Berserk for 20 seconds, increasing your damage done by 5%.

morphs.name: Dark Conversion
morphs.note: Increases the amount of Health and Magicka restored.
morphs.desc: Bargain with darkness to restore 10000 Health and 4500 Magicka instantly, and an additional 3000 Magicka over 20 seconds. The exchange also grants you Minor Berserk for 20 seconds, increasing your damage done by 5%.

enduring-rays.name: Enduring Rays
enduring-rays.desc: Increases the duration of your Sun Fire, Eclipse, Solar Flare, and Nova abilities by 1 second.
enduring-rays.desc_max: Increases the duration of your Sun Fire, Eclipse, Solar Flare, and Nova abilities by 2 seconds.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.desc:
Cost: 4320 Magicka.
Envelop an enemy in a lightless sphere for 4 seconds, that harms them with growing intensity anytime they use a direct damage attack. Limited to one. Their first attack reduces their Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds, their second attack immobilizes them for 3 seconds, and their third attack stuns them for 3 seconds. The effects can activate once every 1 second.

morphs.name: Living Dark
morphs.note: You now apply the ability to yourself, healing when you take direct damage instead. Melee attackers are snared.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4050 Magicka, Duration: 10 seconds, Target: Self.
Envelop yourself in a lightless sphere for 10 seconds to protect yourself. Anytime you take direct damage, the sphere lashes back at the attacker, reducing their Movement Speed by 40% for 3 seconds and healing you for 2066 Health. These effects can occur once every half second.

morphs.name: Unstable Core
morphs.note: Deals damage to the attacker and anyone near them when they trigger any of the effects.
morphs.desc:
Area: 5 meters.
Envelop an enemy in a lightless sphere for 4 seconds, that harms them with growing intensity anytime they deal direct damage. Limited to one. Their first attack reduces their Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds and deals 1228 Magic Damage, their second attack immobilizes them for 3 seconds and deals 2458 Magic Damage, and their third attack stuns them for 3 seconds and deals 4919 Magic Damage. The effects can activate once every 1 second.

elemental-force.name: Elemental Force
elemental-force.desc: With Destruction Staff Equipped Increases your chance to apply status effects by 50%.
elemental-force.desc_max: With Destruction Staff Equipped Increases your chance to apply status effects by 100%.

destruction-expert.name: Destruction Expert
destruction-expert.desc: With Destruction Staff Equipped When you kill an enemy with a Destruction Staff ability, you restore 1800 Magicka. When you absorb damage using a Destruction Staff Damage Shield, you restore 900 Magicka. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.
destruction-expert.desc_max: With Destruction Staff Equipped When you kill an enemy with a Destruction Staff ability, you restore 3600 Magicka. When you absorb damage using a Destruction Staff Damage Shield, you restore 1800 Magicka. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

destructive-touch.name: Destructive Touch
destructive-touch.desc: Devastate an enemy with an enhanced charge from your staff, dealing 3175 Magic Damage and an additional 9510 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. The initial hit always applies the element's status effect.

morphs.name: Destructive Clench
morphs.note: Converts the damage over time into a new effect based on your staff type.
morphs.desc: Devastate an enemy with an enhanced charge from your staff, dealing 3175 Magic Damage. The initial hit always applies the element's status effect. Flame Clench also knocks the enemy back. Frost Clench deals less damage, has increased range, applies Major Maim, immobilizes, and taunts the enemy. Shock Clench converts the attack into an area of effect explosion.

morphs.name: Destructive Reach
morphs.note: Increases the range. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka, Range: 28 meters.
Devastate an enemy with an enhanced charge from your staff, dealing 3175 Magic Damage and an additional 9520 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. The initial hit always applies the element's status effect.

elder-dragon.name: Elder Dragon
elder-dragon.desc: The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you. Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for 20 seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 10%. Increases your Health Recovery by up to 350, based on your missing Health. Current amount: 0
elder-dragon.desc_max: The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you. Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for 20 seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 10%. Increases your Health Recovery by up to 700, based on your missing Health. Current amount: 0

dragon-leap.name: Dragon Leap
dragon-leap.desc: Launch yourself at an enemy, dealing 9771 Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking players back 4 meters and stunning them for 2 seconds. If the target is a monster they are instead knocked into the air and stunned for 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Take Flight
morphs.note: Increases the damage and increases your damage done for a duration after activating.
morphs.desc: Launch yourself at an enemy, dealing 11223 Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them back 4 meters, and stunning them for 2 seconds. If the target is a monster they are instead knocked into the air and stunned for 3 seconds. Upon activation you are filled with draconic fury for 15 seconds, increasing your damage done by 10%. This effect's potency doubles against monsters.

morphs.name: Ferocious Leap
morphs.note: Grants a damage shield upon activation.
morphs.desc: Launch yourself at an enemy, dealing 9772 Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking players back 4 meters and stunning them for 2 seconds. If the target is a monster they are instead knocked into the air and stunned for 3 seconds. Upon activation you gain a damage shield that absorbs 17173 damage for 10 seconds. This portion of the ability scales with your Max Health.

dark-talons.name: Dark Talons
dark-talons.desc: Call forth talons from the ground, dealing 4764 Flame Damage to enemies near you and immobilizing them for 4 seconds. An ally near the talons can activate the Ignite synergy, dealing 7687 Flame Damage to all enemies held within them.

morphs.name: Burning Talons
morphs.note: Deals additional damage over time.
morphs.desc: Call forth talons from the ground, dealing 4921 Flame Damage to enemies near you, an additional 4465 Flame Damage over 5 seconds, and immobilizing them for 4 seconds. An ally near the talons can activate the Ignite synergy, dealing 7687 Flame Damage to all enemies held within them.

morphs.name: Choking Talons
morphs.note: Reduces the cost and affected enemies deal less damage.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3240 Magicka.
Call forth talons from the ground, dealing 4764 Flame Damage to enemies near you and immobilizing them for 4 seconds. Enemies hit are afflicted with Minor Maim, reducing damage done by 5% for 20 seconds. An ally near the talons can activate the Ignite synergy, dealing 7687 Flame Damage to all enemies held within them.

dragon-blood.name: Dragon Blood
dragon-blood.desc: Draw on your draconic blood to heal for 4132 Health, increasing by up to 50% additional healing based on your missing Health. This ability scales off your Max Health. You also gain Major Fortitude, increasing your Health Recovery by 30% for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Blood of the Green Dragon
morphs.note: You also gain Major Endurance, Minor Vitality, and additional healing over time.
morphs.desc: Draw on your draconic blood to heal for 4132 Health, increasing by up to 50% additional healing based on your missing Health. Heals for an additional 2555 Health over 5 seconds. This ability scales off your Max Health. You also gain Major Endurance and Fortitude and Minor Vitality, increasing Health and Stamina Recovery by 30% and increasing healing received and damage shield strength by 6% for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Blood of the Elder Dragon
morphs.note: Now heals based on your offensive stats rather than Health, heals nearby allies, and adds Minor Courage.
morphs.desc:
Area: 10 meters, Target: Area.
Draw on your draconic blood to heal yourself for 8202 and nearby allies for 5467 Health, increasing by up to 50% additional healing based on missing Health. Healed targets gain Major Fortitude and Minor Courage, increasing Health Recovery by 30% and Weapon and Spell Damage by 215 for 20 seconds.

dragon-blood.img_note: The wiki has no icon for this passive; the picture is the Draconic Power line's Dragon Leap.

dual-wield-expert.name: Dual Wield Expert
dual-wield-expert.desc: WHILE DUAL WIELDING Increases Weapon and Spell Damage by 3% of off-hand weapon's damage.
dual-wield-expert.desc_max: WHILE DUAL WIELDING Increases Weapon and Spell Damage by 6% of off-hand weapon's damage.

expert-hunter.name: Expert Hunter
expert-hunter.desc:
Cost: 5130 Stamina.
Invoke your expertise in anatomy and enemy behavior to increase your Stealth Detection by 35 meters for 5 seconds. While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Evil Hunter
morphs.note: Increase duration. After activating your non Ultimate Fighters Guild abilities have increased damage.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 8 seconds.
Invoke your expertise in anatomy and enemy behavior to increase your Stealth Detection for 8 seconds. Increases the damage of your Stamina costing Fighters Guild abilities by 25% for 20 seconds. While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Camouflaged Hunter
morphs.note: While slotted, dealing Critical Damage from the flank of an enemy grants Minor Berserk.
morphs.desc: Invoke your expertise in anatomy and enemy behavior to increase your Stealth Detection for 5 seconds. While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. You also gain Minor Berserk for 5 seconds after dealing Critical Damage from an enemy's flank.

evocation.name: Evocation
evocation.desc: Increases your Magicka Recovery by 2% for each piece of Light Armor equipped. Reduces the Magicka cost of your abilities by 1% for each piece of Light Armor equipped.
evocation.desc_max: Increases your Magicka Recovery by 4% for each piece of Light Armor equipped. Reduces the Magicka cost of your abilities by 2% for each piece of Light Armor equipped.

everlasting-magic.name: Everlasting Magic
everlasting-magic.desc: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by 1 second.
everlasting-magic.desc_max: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by 2 seconds.

entropy.name: Entropy
entropy.desc: Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing 12683 Magic Damage over 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Degeneration
morphs.note: You gain Major Brutality for a time after casting. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Magicka.
Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing 12672 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Structured Entropy
morphs.note: Adds a heal over time when the damage over time is active.
morphs.desc: Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing 12672 Magic Damage over 20 seconds, and healing you for 1189 every 2 seconds.

equilibrium.name: Equilibrium
equilibrium.desc: Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for 3000 Magicka. The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by 50% for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Spell Symmetry
morphs.note: Reduces cost of next Magicka ability.
morphs.desc: Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for 3000 Magicka. After the exchange is complete, the cost of your next Magicka ability is reduced by 33% for 5 seconds. The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by 50% for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Balance
morphs.note: After the exchange is complete, you gain Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance.
morphs.desc: Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for 3000 Magicka. After the exchange is complete, you gain Major Resolve for 30 seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948. The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by 50% for 4 seconds.

dexterity.name: Dexterity
dexterity.desc: Increases your Critical Damage and Healing done rating by 1% for every 2 pieces of Medium Armor equipped.
dexterity.desc_max: Increases your Critical Damage and Healing done rating by 2% for every piece of Medium Armor equipped.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Requires 5 pieces of medium armor equipped Shroud yourself in mist to gain Major Evasion, reducing damage taken from area attacks by 20% for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Shuffle
morphs.note: Each piece of Medium Armor worn removes and grants immunity to snares and immobilizations.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2943 Stamina.
Requires 5 pieces of medium armor equipped Shroud yourself in mist to gain Major Evasion, decreasing damage taken from area attacks by 20% for 20 seconds. Each piece of Medium Armor worn removes and grants immunity to snares and immobilizations for 1 second.

morphs.name: Elude
morphs.note: When you take area damage, you gain Major Expedition. Each piece of Medium Armor worn increases the duration of this ability.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 16 seconds.
Requires 5 pieces of medium armor equipped Shroud yourself in mist to gain Major Evasion, reducing damage taken from area attacks by 20% for (2 * # Medium Armor + 16). While this effect is active, when you take damage from a direct area of effect attack you gain Major Expedition for (# Medium Armor), increasing your Movement Speed by 30%. Each piece of Medium Armor worn increases the duration of this ability.

deadly-bash.name: Deadly Bash
deadly-bash.desc: WITH ONE HAND WEAPON AND SHIELD EQUIPPED Improves your standard Bash attacks, causing them to deal 250 more damage and cost 25% less Stamina.
deadly-bash.desc_max: WITH ONE HAND WEAPON AND SHIELD EQUIPPED Improves your standard Bash attacks, causing them to deal 500 more damage and cost 50% less Stamina.

deflect-bolts.name: Deflect Bolts
deflect-bolts.desc: WITH ONE HAND WEAPON AND SHIELD EQUIPPED Increases the amount of damage you can block from projectiles and ranged attacks by 6%.
deflect-bolts.desc_max: WITH ONE HAND WEAPON AND SHIELD EQUIPPED Increases the amount of damage you can block from projectiles and ranged attacks by 14%.

defensive-posture.name: Defensive Posture
defensive-posture.desc: Bolster your defenses, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to 4958 damage for 6 seconds. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health. You reflect the next harmful direct damage projectile cast at you. This effect can occur once per cast.

morphs.name: Defensive Stance
morphs.note: While slotted and with a shield equipped, you reduce the cost of block and increase the amount of damage you can block.
morphs.desc: Bolster your defenses, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to 4958 damage for 6 seconds. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health. You reflect the next harmful direct damage projectile cast at you, once per cast. While slotted and you have a shield equipped, the amount of damage you can block is increased by 10% and the cost of blocking is reduced by 10%.

morphs.name: Absorb Missile
morphs.note: Projectiles that are absorbed by the damage shield heal you, rather than reflect.
morphs.desc: Bolster your defenses, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to 4958 damage for 6 seconds. While the shield persists, you are healed for 2560 Health the next time a harmful direct damage projectile hits you. This effect can occur once per cast. This ability scales off your Max Health.

essence-drain.name: Essence Drain
essence-drain.desc: WITH RESTORATION STAFF EQUIPPED You gain Major Mending for 2 seconds after completing a fully-charged Heavy Attack, increasing your healing done by 16%. You also heal yourself or an ally within 12 meters of the target for 25% of the damage inflicted by the final hit of a fully-charged Heavy Attack.
essence-drain.desc_max: WITH RESTORATION STAFF EQUIPPED You gain Major Mending for 4 seconds after completing a fully-charged Heavy Attack, increasing your healing done by 16%. You also heal yourself or an ally within 12 meters of the target for 50% of the damage inflicted by the final hit of a fully-charged Heavy Attack.

dark-veil.name: Dark Veil
dark-veil.desc: Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by 1 second. Does not apply to Shadow Cloak or its morphs.
dark-veil.desc_max: Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by 2 seconds. Does not apply to Shadow Cloak or its morphs.

drain-power.name: Drain Power
