drain-power.desc: Siphon the vigor from your enemies' blood, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to all nearby enemies. If an enemy is hit, you gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 30 seconds.

morphs.name: Power Extraction
morphs.note: Converts to a Stamina ability that deals Disease Damage. Applies Minor Cowardice to enemies hit and grants Minor Courage to you.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2983 Stamina.
Siphon the vigor from your enemies' blood, dealing 4764 Disease Damage to all nearby enemies. If an enemy is hit you gain Major Brutality, and Minor Courage increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% and 215 for 30 seconds. Enemies hit have Minor Cowardice applied to them for 10 seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by 215.

morphs.name: Sap Essence
morphs.note: Also heals you and your allies. Heal is stronger for each enemy hit.
morphs.desc: Siphon the vigor from your enemies' blood, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and healing you and your allies for 1639 plus 20% more for each enemy hit. If an enemy is hit, you gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 30 seconds.

energized.name: Energized
energized.desc: Increases your Physical and Shock Damage by 3%.
energized.desc_max: Increases your Physical and Shock Damage by 5%.

expert-mage.name: Expert Mage
expert-mage.desc: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 54 for each Sorcerer ability slotted.
expert-mage.desc_max: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 108 for each Sorcerer ability slotted.

dark-stalker.name: Dark Stalker
dark-stalker.desc: Ignore the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak. Decreases the time it takes to enter Sneak by 25%.
dark-stalker.desc_max: Ignore the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak. Decreases the time it takes to enter Sneak by 50%.

dawnbreaker.name: Dawnbreaker
dawnbreaker.desc: Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing 7940 Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and an additional 9516 Physical Damage over 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Flawless Dawnbreaker
morphs.note: After activating, your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased.
morphs.desc: Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing 7940 Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and an additional 9522 Physical Damage over 6 seconds. After activating, your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by 300 for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Dawnbreaker of Smiting
morphs.note: Increases the damage and stuns enemies hit.
morphs.desc: Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing 9842 Physical Damage to enemies in front of you, an additional 11802 Physical Damage over 6 seconds, and stunning them for 2 seconds.

executioner-skill.name: Executioner
executioner-skill.desc: When an enemy dies within 2 seconds of being damaged by you, you restore 500 Magicka and Stamina.
executioner-skill.desc_max: When an enemy dies within 2 seconds of being damaged by you, you restore 1000 Magicka and Stamina.

dark-vigor.name: Dark Vigor
dark-vigor.desc: Increases your Max Health by 2% for each Shadow ability slotted.
dark-vigor.desc_max: Increases your Max Health by 5% for each Shadow ability slotted.

elemental-storm.name: Elemental Storm
elemental-storm.desc: Create a cataclysmic storm at the target location that builds for 2 seconds then lays waste to all enemies in the area, dealing 4764 Magic Damage every 1 second for 7 seconds.

morphs.name: Elemental Rage
morphs.note: Increases the damage and gains a new effect depending on your staff type.
morphs.desc: Create a cataclysmic storm at the target location that builds for 2 seconds then lays waste to all enemies in the area, dealing 6151 Magic Damage every 1 second for 7 seconds. Fiery Rage increases the damage by 15%. Icy Rage immobilizes enemies hit for 3 seconds. Thunderous Rage increases the duration by 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Eye of the Storm
morphs.note: The storm is cast above you instead, and follows you wherever you move.
morphs.desc:
Target: Area.
Create a cataclysmic storm above you that builds for 2 seconds then lays waste to all enemies nearby, dealing 4921 Magic Damage every 1 second for 7 seconds. You cannot conceal your presence while active.

dive.name: Dive
dive.desc: Command a cliff racer to dive bomb an enemy, dealing 5717 Magic Damage. If you are more than 7 meters away from the target, you set them Off Balance for 7 seconds.

morphs.name: Cutting Dive
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Bleed Damage, and applies a damage over time to enemies hit.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Stamina.
Command a cliff racer to dive bomb an enemy, dealing 5717 Bleed Damage immediately and then causing them to bleed for 5830 Bleed Damage over 10 seconds. If you are more than 7 meters away from the target, you set them Off Balance for 7 seconds.

morphs.name: Screaming Cliff Racer
morphs.note: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage after dealing damage, which increases when hitting Off Balance targets.
morphs.desc: Command a cliff racer to dive bomb an enemy, dealing 5905 Magic Damage. If you are more than 7 meters away from the target, you set them Off Balance for 7 seconds. After dealing damage you increase your Weapon and Spell Damage by 100 for 10 seconds, which quadruples after damaging Off Balance enemies.

emerald-moss.name: Emerald Moss
emerald-moss.desc: Increase your healing done with Green Balance abilities by 2% for each Green Balance ability slotted.
emerald-moss.desc_max: Increases your healing done with Green Balance abilities by 5% for each Green Balance ability slotted.

deliberation.name: Deliberation
deliberation.desc: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by 30%.

death-scythe.name: Death Scythe
death-scythe.desc: Slice into your enemy's life force, dealing 4764 Magic Damage. You heal for 2400 Health for the first enemy hit, and an additional 800 for each additional enemy hit, up to five times. The healing of this ability scales off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Ruinous Scythe
morphs.note: Converts to a Stamina ability and deals Bleed Damage, applying the Hemorrhaging status effect. Enemies hit are set Off Balance.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2754 Stamina.
Slice into your enemy's life force, dealing 4921 Bleed Damage, applying the Hemorrhaging status effect, and setting them Off Balance for 7 seconds. You heal for 2400 Health for the first enemy hit, and an additional 800 for each additional enemy, up to five times. The healing of this ability scales off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Hungry Scythe
morphs.note: Gain a heal over time and reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2970 Magicka.
Slice into your enemy's life force, dealing 4764 Magic Damage. You heal for 2400 Health for the first enemy hit, and an additional 800 for each additional enemy, up to five times. After dealing damage, you heal for 990 Health every 2 seconds over 10 seconds. The healing of this ability scales off your Max Health.

death-gleaning.name: Death Gleaning
death-gleaning.desc: WITH A BONE TYRANT ABILITY SLOTTED Whenever an enemy you are in combat with dies within 28 meters of you, restore 333 Magicka and Stamina.
death-gleaning.desc_max: WITH A BONE TYRANT ABILITY SLOTTED Whenever an enemy you are in combat with dies within 28 meters of you, restore 666 Magicka and Stamina.

disdain-harm.name: Disdain Harm
disdain-harm.desc: Reduce the damage you take from damage over time abilities by 7% while you have a Bone Tyrant ability active.
disdain-harm.desc_max: Reduce the damage you take from damage over time abilities by 15% while you have a Bone Tyrant ability active.

death-knell.name: Death Knell
death-knell.desc: WITH A GRAVE LORD ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Critical Strike Chance against enemies under 33% Health by 10%.
death-knell.desc_max: WITH A GRAVE LORD ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Critical Strike Chance against enemies under 33% Health by 20%.

dismember.name: Dismember
dismember.desc: While a Grave Lord ability is active, your Spell and Physical Penetration are increased by 1635.
dismember.desc_max: While a Grave Lord ability is active, your Spell and Physical Penetration are increased by 3271.

eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
eviscerate.desc: Rend an enemy, dealing 6351 Magic Damage and applying the Hemorrhaging status effect. Deals up to 33% more damage based on your missing Health.

morphs.name: Blood for Blood
morphs.note: Costs Health to cast, but greatly increases the execute scaling. After casting the ability, you cannot be healed by allies for a short duration.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Health.
Rend an enemy, dealing 6352 Magic Damage and applying the Hemorrhaging status effect. Deals up to 75% more damage based on your missing Health. After you cast this ability, you cannot be healed by allies for 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Arterial Burst
morphs.note: Will always be a Critical Strike if you cast it while under half Health.
morphs.desc: Rend an enemy, dealing 6561 Magic Damage and applying the Hemorrhaging status effect. Deals up to 33% more damage based on your missing Health. If you use this ability while you are under 50% Health, it will always be a Critical Strike.

dilation.name: Dilation
dilation.desc: Claim all facets of the selected type that touch your area of control, as well as matching facets directly adjacent. Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.
dilation.desc_max: Claim all facets of the selected type that touch your area of control, as well as matching facets directly adjacent. New Effect: Dilation now claims ALL contiguous facets of the same type. Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

excavators-reserves.name: Excavator's Reserves
excavators-reserves.desc: Increases the amount of time you have available when excavating a dig site.
excavators-reserves.desc_max: Further increases the amount of time you have available when excavating a dig site.

erudition.name: Erudition
erudition.desc: Knowledge is power. Your excessive scholarship increases your Magicka and Stamina Recovery by 9%.
erudition.desc_max: Knowledge is power. Your excessive scholarship increases your Magicka and Stamina Recovery by 18%.

dragonfire-breath.name: Dragonfire Breath
dragonfire-breath.desc: Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing 4764 Flame Damage and an additional 7925 Flame Damage over 10 seconds to enemies in your path.

morphs.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
morphs.note: Initial hit applies the Burning status effect and Major Breach.
morphs.desc: Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing 4921 Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional 8190 Flame Damage over 10 seconds to enemies in your path. The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948.

morphs.name: Engulfing Dragonfire
morphs.note: Converts the ability into a channeled attack that deals direct damage.
morphs.desc:
Casting Time: , Channel Time: 4.8 seconds, Cost: 3510 Magicka, Target: Area.
Breathe forth an unending torrent of draconic fire, dealing 3791 Flame Damage every 0.5 seconds in a channeled attack over 4.8 seconds. While channeling, reduce your damage taken by 15%. Each tick increases the damage dealt by 5%, up to a maximum of 50%. While Take Flight is active you always deal maximum damage. This ability is considered direct damage but can trigger Wildfire Embers once every 4 seconds.

earthspike-mantle.name: Earthspike Mantle
earthspike-mantle.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Envelop your body in molten spikes to increase your damage done to monsters by 100 and gain Major Resolve, increasing Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Earthshield Mantle
morphs.note: You gain a damage shield after casting.
morphs.desc: Envelop your body in molten spikes to increase your damage done to monsters by 100 and gain Major Resolve, increasing Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds. Power drawn from the heart of a volcano forms a damage shield around you that absorbs up to 5121 damage for 6 seconds, scaling off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Shatterspike Mantle
morphs.note: Enemies near you take damage over time when you activate the ability.
morphs.desc:
Area: 10 meters, Target: Area.
Envelop your body in molten spikes to increase your damage done to monsters by 100 and gain Major Resolve, increasing Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds. As the armor forms you blast foes around you with shattered obsidian, causing them to take 13079 Flame Damage over 20 seconds. When this effect deals damage you gain a stack of Landslide, up to once every 10 seconds.

devout-guardian.name: Devout Guardian
devout-guardian.desc: Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark. While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for 6 seconds, up to once every 6 seconds. The shield absorbs up to 3200 damage and provides 300 Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain 10 Ultimate.

erudites-rigor.name: Erudite's Rigor
erudites-rigor.desc: Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict. Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for 4 seconds. You gain 1 Ultimate for every Crux you have. These effects can occur once every 2 seconds.

focused-charge.name: Focused Charge
focused-charge.desc: Charge with your divine lance to impale an enemy, dealing 3811 Magic Damage while taunting them to attack you for 15 seconds. If the enemy hit was casting, they are interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for 3 seconds. You also gain Major Protection for 7 seconds, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Explosive Charge
morphs.note: Deals increased damage and interrupts all enemies near the point of impact. Increases duration of Major Protection.
morphs.desc:
Area: 6 meters.
Charge with your divine lance to impale all enemies in the area, dealing 4921 Magic Damage while taunting the first enemy hit to attack you for 15 seconds. Any enemy hit that was casting is interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for 3 seconds. You also gain Major Protection for 15 seconds, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Toppling Charge
morphs.note: Always stuns the enemy and sets them Off Balance, regardless if they are casting. Reduces cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3510 Magicka.
Charge with your divine lance to impale an enemy, dealing 3811 Magic Damage while taunting them to attack you for 15 seconds. The enemy hit is stunned for 3 seconds, set Off Balance, and if they were casting, they are interrupted. You also gain Major Protection for 7 seconds, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

expert-summoner.name: Expert Summoner
expert-summoner.desc: Increases your Magicka and Stamina by 2%. Increases your Max Health 2% if you have a permanent summoned combat pet active.
expert-summoner.desc_max: Increases your Magicka and Stamina by 5%. Increases your Max Health by 5% if you have a permanent summoned combat pet active.

exploitation.name: Exploitation
exploitation.desc: Attempting to activate a Dark Magic skill grants you and your group 2974 Offensive Penetration for 10 seconds.
exploitation.desc_max: Attempting to activate a Dark Magic skill grants you and your group 2974 Offensive Penetration for 20 seconds.

force-shock.name: Force Shock
force-shock.desc: Focus all the elemental energies with your staff and blast an enemy for 1905 Flame Damage, 1903 Frost Damage, and 1903 Shock Damage.

morphs.name: Crushing Shock
morphs.note: Interrupts spells, putting the caster Off Balance. Reduces cost as ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Magicka.
Focus all the elemental energies with your staff and blast an enemy for 1905 Flame Damage, 1904 Frost Damage, and 1904 Shock Damage. Enemies hit while casting are interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Force Pulse
morphs.note: Damages nearby enemies if they are under the effects of a status effect.
morphs.desc:
Area: 8 meters.
Focus all the elemental energies with your staff and blast an enemy for 1905 Flame Damage, 1904 Frost Damage, and 1904 Shock Damage. Up to 2 nearby enemies will take 6561 Magic Damage if they were already afflicted with a status effect.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: Flood an enemy with steel, battering them with four consecutive attacks that each deal 1825 Physical Damage.

morphs.name: Rapid Strikes
morphs.note: Reduces the cost and each hit increases the damage of the subsequent hit.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Stamina.
Flood an enemy with steel, battering them with four consecutive attacks that each deal 1886 Physical Damage. Each hit increases the damage of the subsequent hit by 5%.

morphs.name: Bloodthirst
morphs.note: Converts into Bleed Damage and heals you for a percentage of the damage caused.
morphs.desc: Flood an enemy with steel, battering them with four consecutive attacks that each deal 1886 Bleed Damage and heal you for 33% of the damage caused.

fire-rune.name: Fire Rune
fire-rune.desc: Inscribe a rune of cosmic fire on the earth, which takes 2 seconds to arm and lasts for 20 seconds. When triggered, the rune blasts all enemies in the target area for 6349 Flame Damage.

morphs.name: Volcanic Rune
morphs.note: The rune knocks enemies into the air and stuns them. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2970 Magicka.
Inscribe a rune of cosmic fire on the earth, which takes 2 seconds to arm and lasts for 20 seconds. When triggered, the rune blasts all enemies in the target area for 6349 Flame Damage, knocks them into the air, and stuns them for 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Scalding Rune
morphs.note: The rune also deals additional damage over time.
morphs.desc: Inscribe a rune of cosmic fire on the earth, which takes 2 seconds to arm and lasts for 20 seconds. When triggered, the rune blasts all enemies in the target area for 6349 Flame Damage and an additional 7843 Flame Damage over 22 seconds.

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.desc: WITH ONE HAND WEAPON AND SHIELD EQUIPPED Reduces the Stamina cost of your One Hand and Shield abilities by 7% and reduces the cost of blocking by 18%.
fortress.desc_max: WITH ONE HAND WEAPON AND SHIELD EQUIPPED Reduces the Stamina cost of your One Hand and Shield abilities by 15% and reduces the cost of blocking by 36%.

grand-healing.name: Grand Healing
grand-healing.desc: Call upon restoring spirits with your staff, healing you and your allies in the target area for 12683 Health over 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Illustrious Healing
morphs.note: Increases the duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 15 seconds.
Call upon restoring spirits with your staff, healing you and your allies in the target area for 18421 Health over 15 seconds.

morphs.name: Healing Springs
morphs.note: You gain Magicka Recovery for each target healed.
morphs.desc: Call upon restoring spirits with your staff, healing you and your allies in the target area for 12672 Health over 10 seconds. Increases your Magicka Recovery by 15 for each target affected, stacking up to 20 times.

force-siphon.name: Force Siphon
force-siphon.desc:
Duration: 24 seconds.
Focus your staff's power to apply Minor Lifesteal to an enemy for 24 seconds, healing you and your allies for 600 Health every 1 second when damaging them.

morphs.name: Siphon Spirit
morphs.note: Also applies Minor Magickasteal to the enemy.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Focus your staff's power to apply Minor Lifesteal to an enemy for 30 seconds, healing you and your allies for 600 Health every 1 second when damaging them. Also applies Minor Magickasteal to the enemy for 30 seconds, causing you and your allies to restore 168 Magicka every 1 second when damaging them.

morphs.name: Quick Siphon
morphs.note: Allies who hit the enemy target also gain Minor Expedition.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Focus your staff's power to apply Minor Lifesteal to an enemy for 30 seconds, healing you and your allies for 600 Health every 1 second when damaging them. When you or an ally hits the target, they gain Minor Expedition, which increases their Movement Speed by 15% for 4 seconds.

healing-ritual.name: Healing Ritual
healing-ritual.desc: Focus your spiritual devotion, healing you and nearby allies for 7146 Health.

morphs.name: Ritual of Rebirth
morphs.note: You heal a single ally outside the ability's radius.
morphs.desc: Focus your spiritual devotion, healing you and nearby allies for 7146 Health. You heal a single ally outside this ability's radius for an additional 7381 Health.

morphs.name: Hasty Prayer
morphs.note: Healed allies gain Minor Expedition for a short duration and reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4995 Magicka.
Focus your spiritual devotion, healing you and nearby allies for 7146 Health. Affected targets gain Minor Expedition, increasing their Movement Speed by 15% for 10 seconds.

forceful.name: Forceful
forceful.desc: WITH TWO-HANDED WEAPON EQUIPPED Your Light and Heavy Attacks damage up to 3 other nearby enemies for 50% of the damage inflicted to the primary target.
forceful.desc_max: WITH TWO-HANDED WEAPON EQUIPPED Your Light and Heavy Attacks damage up to 3 other nearby enemies for 100% of the damage inflicted to the primary target.

grim-focus.name: Grim Focus
grim-focus.desc: When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Grim Focus, up to 10 times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks. When at 5 or more stacks, you can consume 5 to fire a spectral arrow to deal 11435 Magic Damage and heal for 33% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

morphs.name: Relentless Focus
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Disease Damage. Reduces the cost and the amount of stacks needed.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 1107 Stamina.
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Relentless Focus, up to 10 times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks. When at 4 or more stacks, you can consume 4 to fire a spectral arrow to deal 11435 Disease Damage and heal for 33% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

morphs.name: Merciless Resolve
morphs.note: Increases the damage and healing of the spectral arrow.
morphs.desc: When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Merciless Resolve, up to 10 times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks. When at 5 or more stacks, you can consume 5 to fire a spectral arrow to deal 12993 Magic Damage and heal for 50% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

follow-up.name: Follow Up
follow-up.desc: WITH TWO-HANDED WEAPON EQUIPPED When you complete a fully-charged Heavy Attack, your damage done with Two Handed attacks increases by 5% for 4 seconds.
follow-up.desc_max: WITH TWO-HANDED WEAPON EQUIPPED When you complete a fully-charged Heavy Attack, your damage done with Two Handed attacks increases by 10% for 4 seconds.

hawk-eye.name: Hawk Eye
hawk-eye.desc: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Dealing damage with a Light or Heavy Attack increases the damage of your Bow abilities by 2% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
hawk-eye.desc_max: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Dealing damage with a Light or Heavy Attack increases the damage of your Bow abilities by 5% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

hasty-retreat.name: Hasty Retreat
hasty-retreat.desc: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Grants you Major Expedition for 2 seconds after you use Roll Dodge. Major Expedition increases your Movement Speed by 30%.
hasty-retreat.desc_max: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Grants you Major Expedition for 4 seconds after you use Roll Dodge. Major Expedition increases your Movement Speed by 30%.

finders-keepers.name: Finders Keepers
finders-keepers.desc: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

haggling.name: Haggling
haggling.desc: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth 2% more. Does not apply to Laundering.
haggling.desc_max: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth 10% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

guard-skill.name: Guard
guard-skill.desc:
Cost: 3402 Stamina.
Create a lifebond between you and an allied player. While bonded, 30% of the damage they take is instead redistributed to you. The bond will remain until you recast the spell or move more than 15 meters away from your ally.

morphs.name: Mystic Guard
morphs.note: You and your bonded ally also gain Minor Vitality, increasing your healing received.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3132 Stamina.
Create a lifebond between you and an allied player. While bonded, 30% of the damage they take is instead redistributed to you. You and your bonded ally also gain Minor Vitality, increasing your healing received and damage shield strength by 6%. The bond will remain until you recast the spell or move more than 15 meters away from your ally.

morphs.name: Stalwart Guard
morphs.note: You and your bonded ally also gain Minor Force, increasing your Critical Damage.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3132 Stamina.
Create a lifebond between you and an allied player. While bonded, 30% of the damage they take is instead redistributed to you. You and your bonded ally also gain Minor Force, increasing your Critical Damage by 10%. The bond will remain until you recast the spell or move more than 15 meters away from your ally.

feral-guardian.name: Feral Guardian
feral-guardian.desc: Rouse a grizzly to fight by your side. The grizzly swipes at an enemy, dealing 1587 Magic Damage, and sometimes swipes all enemies in front of it, dealing 6351 Magic Damage and stunning them for 2 seconds. Once summoned you can activate Guardian's Wrath for 75 Ultimate, causing the grizzly to maul an enemy for 8894 Magic Damage. Deals 100% more damage to enemies below 25% Health.

morphs.name: Eternal Guardian
morphs.note: The grizzly instantly respawns when it dies. Increases the amount of bonus damage dealt to low Health targets.
morphs.desc: Rouse a grizzly to fight by your side. The grizzly swipes an enemy, dealing 1639 Magic Damage, and sometimes swipes all enemies in front of it, dealing 6561 Magic Damage and stunning them for 2 seconds. Once summoned you can activate Guardian's Wrath for 75 Ultimate, causing the grizzly to maul an enemy for 9186 Magic Damage. Deals 150% more damage to enemies below 25% Health. The grizzly respawns when killed, once per minute.

morphs.name: Wild Guardian
morphs.note: The bear now deals Bleed Damage, and has a quintuple chance of applying the Hemorrhaging status effect.
morphs.desc: Rouse a grizzly to fight by your side. The grizzly swipes at an enemy, dealing 1803 Bleed Damage, and sometimes swipes all enemies in front of it, dealing 7217 Bleed Damage and stunning them for 2 seconds. Once summoned you can activate Guardian's Savagery for 75 Ultimate, to maul an enemy for 10105 Bleed Damage. Deals 100% more damage to enemies below 25% Health. The damage has a higher chance to apply the Hemorrhaging status effect.

falcons-swiftness.name: Falcon's Swiftness
falcons-swiftness.desc:
Cost: 3240 Magicka.
Invoke the spirit of agility to gain Major Expedition for 6 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30%. Gain immunity to snares and immobilizations for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Deceptive Predator
morphs.note: Passively grants Minor Evasion while slotted.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka.
Invoke the spirit of agility to gain Major Expedition for 6 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30%. Gain immunity to snares and immobilizations for 4 seconds. While slotted you gain Minor Evasion, reducing damage from area attacks by 10%.

morphs.name: Bird of Prey
morphs.note: Passively grants Minor Berserk while slotted.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka.
Invoke the spirit of agility to gain Major Expedition for 6 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30%. Gain immunity to snares and immobilizations for 4 seconds. While slotted you gain Minor Berserk, increasing your damage done by 5%.

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.desc: WITH AN ANIMAL COMPANION ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Magicka and Stamina recovery by 10%.
flourish.desc_max: WITH AN ANIMAL COMPANION ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Magicka and Stamina recovery by 20%.

frost-cloak.name: Frost Cloak
frost-cloak.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Wrap a thick cloak of ice around you and your grouped allies. The ice grants Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Expansive Frost Cloak
morphs.note: Increases the radius and reduces the cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Magicka, Area: 36 meters.
Wrap a thick cloak of ice around you and your grouped allies. The ice grants Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Ice Fortress
morphs.note: Grants Minor Protection to you. Increases the duration as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Wrap a thick cloak of ice around you and your grouped allies. The ice grants Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 30 seconds. You gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by 5% for 30 seconds.

frozen-gate.name: Frozen Gate
frozen-gate.desc: Conjure an ancient portal, which arms after 1.5 seconds and lasts for 15 seconds. You cannot conceal your presence while active. When triggered the enemy is teleported to you if within range, immobilized for 3 seconds, and dealt 4761 Frost Damage. You can have up to 3 Frozen Gates active at a time.

morphs.name: Frozen Device
morphs.note: Teleported enemies have their damage done reduced.
morphs.desc: Conjure an ancient portal, which arms after 1.5 seconds and lasts for 15 seconds. You cannot conceal your presence while active. When triggered the enemy is teleported to you if within range, immobilized for 3 seconds, dealt 4919 Frost Damage, and afflicted with Major Maim, reducing their damage done by 10% for 4 seconds. You can have up to 3 Frozen Devices active at a time.

morphs.name: Frozen Retreat
morphs.note: Grants allies in the area a synergy that teleports them to you and grants them increased Movement Speed.
morphs.desc: Conjure an ancient portal, which arms after 1.5 seconds and lasts for 15 seconds. You cannot conceal your presence while active. When triggered the enemy is teleported to you if within range, immobilized for 3 seconds, and dealt 4919 Frost Damage. An ally in the area can activate the Icy Escape synergy, teleporting them to you and granting them Major Expedition for 8 seconds. You can have up to 3 Frozen Retreats active at a time.

fungal-growth.name: Fungal Growth
fungal-growth.desc: Seed a large area of mushrooms in front of you, healing you and your allies for 7146 Health.

morphs.name: Enchanted Growth
morphs.note: Affected targets have increased Magicka and Stamina Recovery.
morphs.desc: Seed a large area of mushrooms in front of you, healing you and your allies for 7381 Health. Any target healed gains Minor Intellect and Minor Endurance, increasing their Magicka and Stamina Recovery by 15% for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Soothing Spores
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability. Allies near you are healed for more.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3902 Stamina.
Seed a large area of mushrooms in front of you, healing you and your allies for 7381 Health. Heals for 15% more on allies that are within 8 meters of you.

healing-seed.name: Healing Seed
healing-seed.desc: Sprout a field of flowers which blooms after 6 seconds, healing you and allies in the area for 9526 Health. An ally within the field can activate the Harvest synergy, healing for 9222 Health over 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Budding Seeds
morphs.note: The area now heals allies while it grows, and can be activated a second time to instantly trigger the delayed heal.
morphs.desc: Sprout a field of flowers which blooms after 6 seconds, healing you and allies in the area for 9526 Health. While the field grows, you and allies are healed for 1123 Health every 1 second. You can activate this ability again to cause it to instantly bloom. An ally within the field can activate the Harvest synergy, healing for 9222 Health over 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Corrupting Pollen
morphs.note: Enemies in the field receive less healing and have reduced Weapon and Spell Damage.
morphs.desc: Sprout a field of flowers which blooms after 6 seconds, healing you and allies in the area for 9839 Health. Enemies who enter the field are afflicted with Major Defile and Minor Cowardice, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by 12% and their Weapon and Spell Damage by 215. An ally within the field can activate the Harvest synergy, healing for 9222 Health over 5 seconds.

frozen-armor.name: Frozen Armor
frozen-armor.desc: Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by 620 for each Winter's Embrace ability slotted.
frozen-armor.desc_max: Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by 1240 for each Winter's Embrace ability slotted.

glacial-presence.name: Glacial Presence
glacial-presence.desc: Increases your chance to apply the Chilled status effect by 125% and increases its damage done by 158. The damage increasing effect scales off the higher of your Weapon and Spell Damage.
glacial-presence.desc_max: Increases your chance to apply the Chilled status effect by 250% and increases its damage by 316. The damage increasing effect scales off the higher of your Weapon and Spell Damage.

grace.name: Grace
grace.desc: Reduces the effectiveness of snares applied to you by 1% for each piece of Light Armor worn. Reduces the cost of Sprint by 1% for each piece of Light Armor worn.
grace.desc_max: Reduces the effectiveness of snares applied to you by 4% for each piece of Light Armor worn. Reduces the cost of Sprint by 3% for each piece of Light Armor worn.

expunge.name: Expunge
expunge.desc:
Cost: 1940 Health.
Embrace the power of death, removing up to 2 negative effects from yourself. While slotted, the cost of all your abilities are reduced by 3%.

morphs.name: Expunge and Modify
morphs.note: You restore Magicka and Stamina for each negative effect removed.
morphs.desc: Embrace the power of death, removing up to 2 negative effects from yourself and restoring 515 Magicka and Stamina for each negative effect removed. While slotted, the cost of all your abilities are reduced by 3%.

morphs.name: Hexproof
morphs.note: Reduces cost as the ability ranks up and Increases the amount of negative effects removed.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 1670 Health.
Embrace the power of death, removing up to 4 negative effects from yourself. While slotted, the cost of all your abilities are reduced by 3%.

frozen-colossus.name: Frozen Colossus
frozen-colossus.desc: Unleash a frostbitten Flesh Colossus to pulverize enemies in the area. The Colossus smashes the ground three times over 3 seconds, dealing 9526 Frost Damage with each smash. Dealing damage applies Major Vulnerability to any enemy hit for 12 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Pestilent Colossus
morphs.note: Converts to Disease Damage. Deals more damage with each smash and final hit applies the Diseased status effect.
morphs.desc: Unleash a pestilent Flesh Colossus to pulverize enemies in the area. The Colossus smashes the ground three times over 3 seconds, dealing 9842, 10827, and 11909 Disease Damage with the first, second, and third smash. The final hit always applies the Diseased status effect. Dealing damage applies Major Vulnerability to any enemy hit for 12 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Glacial Colossus
morphs.note: Increases the duration of Major Vulnerability and the final smash stuns all enemies hit.
morphs.desc: Unleash a frostbitten Flesh Colossus to pulverize enemies in the area. The Colossus smashes the ground three times over 3 seconds, dealing 9526 Frost Damage with each smash. The final smash stuns all enemies hit for 4 seconds. Dealing damage applies Major Vulnerability to any enemy hit for 17 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 10%.

flame-skull.name: Flame Skull
flame-skull.desc: Lob an explosive skull at an enemy, dealing 5717 Flame Damage. Every third cast of this ability deals 50% increased damage and creates a corpse near the enemy.

morphs.name: Venom Skull
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Poison Damage. Casting any Necromancer ability counts towards the third cast.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Stamina.
Lob an explosive skull at an enemy, dealing 5905 Poison Damage. Every third cast of this ability deals 50% increased damage and creates a corpse near the enemy, up to once every 3 seconds. While slotted, casting any Necromancer ability while you are in combat will count towards the third cast.

morphs.name: Ricochet Skull
morphs.note: The third cast of the skull will bounce to other nearby enemies.
morphs.desc:
Area: 8 meters.
Lob an explosive skull at an enemy, dealing 5905 Flame Damage. Every third cast of this ability deals 50% increased damage, creates a corpse near the initial enemy, and will bounce up to 2 times to other nearby enemies.

grave-grasp.name: Grave Grasp
grave-grasp.desc: Call forth three patches of skeletal claws from the ground in front of you. Enemies in the first area are snared by 30% for 5 seconds, immobilized in the second area for 4 seconds, and stunned in the final area for 3 seconds. Each patch applies Minor Maim to enemies hit for 10 seconds, reducing their damage done by 5%.

morphs.name: Ghostly Embrace
morphs.note: Deals damage in each area and applies new effects.
morphs.desc: Call forth three patches of skeletal claws from the ground in front of you, each dealing 2458 Frost Damage. The first area applies the Chilled status effect, the second area deals an additional 4465 Frost Damage over 5 seconds, and the final area creates a corpse if at least one enemy was hit.

morphs.name: Empowering Grasp
morphs.note: Each area now also grants allies Empower and improves the Minor Maim to Major Maim against enemies.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3510 Magicka.
Call forth three patches of skeletal claws from the ground in front of you. Enemies in the first area are snared by 30% for 5 seconds, immobilized in the second area for 4 seconds, and stunned in the final area for 3 seconds. Each area applies Major Maim to enemies and Empower to your allies for 10 seconds, reducing enemy damage done by 10% and allied Heavy Attack Damage against monsters by 150%.

health-avarice.name: Health Avarice
health-avarice.desc: Increase your Healing Received by 1% for each Bone Tyrant ability slotted.
health-avarice.desc_max: Increase your Healing Received by 3% for each Bone Tyrant ability slotted.

farsight-skill.name: Farsight
farsight-skill.desc: Claim a line of facets, stretching out from your area of control. Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.
farsight-skill.desc_max: Claim a line of facets, stretching out from your area of control. New Effect: Range increased from 4 facets to 6. Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

feed.name: Feed
feed.desc: Allows you to feed on an unsuspecting target, killing them and increasing your Vampire Stage. Higher Stages make you a stronger Vampire at the cost of your humanity. Stages decrease over long periods of time. Stage 1/2/3/4 Health Recovery: -10%/-30%/-60%/-100% Flame Damage Taken: +5%/+8%/+13%/+20% Regular Ability Costs: +3%/+5%/+8%/+12% Vampire Ability Costs: -6%/-10%/-16%/-24%

future-focus.name: Future Focus
future-focus.desc: Grants you an additional Magicka Charge for use in Scrying.
future-focus.desc_max: Grants you two additional Magicka Charges for use in Scrying.

hand-brush.name: Hand Brush
hand-brush.desc: Removes 1 layer of soil or rock from a 1x1 area. Generates: 1 Intuition Maximum Intuition: 2.
hand-brush.desc_max: Removes 1 layer of soil or rock from a 1x1 area. Generates: 1 Intuition Maximum Intuition: 4.

fatecarver.name: Fatecarver
fatecarver.desc: Cost Determined by Highest Max Resource Harness pure knowledge into a beam of energy that scars the world in front of you. Channel the beam for up to 4 seconds, dealing 2403 Magic Damage every 0.3 seconds to up to 6 enemies. Casting Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by 33% per Crux spent. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Exhausting Fatecarver
morphs.note: Applies a snare to damaged enemies. Consuming Crux also increases the duration and snare strength.
morphs.desc: Cost Determined by Highest Max Resource Harness pure knowledge into a beam of energy that scars the world in front of you. Channel the beam for up to 4 seconds, dealing 2403 Magic Damage every 0.3 seconds to up to 6 enemies and snares them by 15%. Casting Exhausting Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by 33%, duration by 0.3 seconds, and snare by 15% per Crux spent. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
morphs.note: Gain a damage shield while channeling and immunity to interrupts while the shield is active. Consuming Crux also reduces the cost.
morphs.desc: Cost Determined by Highest Max Resource Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to 4 seconds, dealing 2403 Magic Damage every 0.3 seconds to up to 6 enemies, and gain a damage shield that absorbs up to 8575 damage and grants interrupt immunity. Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by 33%, and decreases cost by 16% per Crux spent. This ability is considered direct damage.

fated-fortune.name: Fated Fortune
fated-fortune.desc: Warp fate when you generate or consume Crux, increasing your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by 6% for 7 seconds.
fated-fortune.desc_max: Warp fate when you generate or consume Crux, increasing your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by 12% for 7 seconds.

harnessed-quintessence.name: Harnessed Quintessence
harnessed-quintessence.desc: You master the warp and weft of your very soul. When you restore Magicka or Stamina, your Weapon and Spell Damage increase by 142 for 10 seconds.
harnessed-quintessence.desc_max: You master the warp and weft of your very soul. When you restore Magicka or Stamina, your Weapon and Spell Damage increase by 284 for 10 seconds.

gibbering-shield.name: Gibbering Shield
gibbering-shield.desc: Gather the true strength of Apocrypha around you, forming protective tentacles and a damage shield that absorbs 60% of all damage for 10 seconds, up to a max of 31733 damage, scaling off your Max Health. When the shield collapses you lash out, dealing all of the damage absorbed as Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters over 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Sanctum of the Abyssal Sea
morphs.note: Damage shield gains an increase in strength.
morphs.desc: Gather the true strength of Apocrypha as protective tentacles rise from the Abyssal Sea around you. The tentacles form a damage shield that absorbs 60% of all damage for 10 seconds, up to a max of 37697 damage, scaling off your Max Health. When the shield collapses you lash out, dealing all of the damage absorbed as Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters over 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Gibbering Shelter
morphs.note: No longer deals damage to enemies and grants allies a damage shield when you are hit.
morphs.desc: Gather the true strength of Apocrypha, forming a tentacle damage shield that absorbs 60% of all damage for 10 seconds, up to a max of 31733 damage. When the shield absorbs damage, pseudopods cascade out at up to 11 allies within 15 meters, granting them a damage shield for 4 seconds that absorbs up to 5462 damage. These shields can be applied once every 4 seconds. Both shields scale off your Max Health.

fatewoven-armor.name: Fatewoven Armor
fatewoven-armor.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Forge defiant runic armor around you, granting Major Resolve for 20 seconds, increasing your Armor by 5948. While the armor persists, taking damage applies Minor Breach, reducing the Armor of your attacker by 2974 for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Cruxweaver Armor
morphs.note: Increases the duration and when damaged, creates a Crux.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Forge defiant runic armor around you, granting Major Resolve for 30 seconds, increasing your Armor by 5948. While the armor persists, taking damage applies Minor Breach, reducing the Armor of your attacker by 2974 for 6 seconds. Blows against your armor also generate Crux, up to once every 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Unbreakable Fate
morphs.note: Gain bonus Block Mitigation and consume Crux to increase the bonus.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Magicka.
Forge defiant runic armor around you, granting 5% Block Mitigation and Major Resolve for 20 seconds, increasing your Armor by 5948 for 20 seconds. Consume Crux to gain 5% additional Block Mitigation per Crux spent. While the armor persists, taking damage applies Minor Breach, reducing the Armor of your attacker by 2974 for 6 seconds.

healing-tides.name: Healing Tides
healing-tides.desc: Your mastery of weaving fate and abyssal water increases your healing done by 2% for each active Crux.
healing-tides.desc_max: Your mastery of weaving fate and abyssal water increases your healing done by 4% for each active Crux.

fan-the-flames.name: Fan the Flames
fan-the-flames.desc: Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish. Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by 25% and its damage done by 12%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
fan-the-flames.desc_max: Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish. Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by 50% and its damage done by 25%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.

fate-realigned.name: Fate Realigned
fate-realigned.desc: Be the hand that guides the weave of fate. Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every 15 seconds. After this effect triggers you gain 300 Weapon and Spell Damage for 25 seconds.

feral-cruelty.name: Feral Cruelty
feral-cruelty.desc: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Lorkh teaches through suffering. So too will your claws. Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 10%, reducing to 5% against targets with Battle Spirit. Grants you Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948.
feral-cruelty.desc_max: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Lorkh teaches through suffering. So too will your claws. Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%, reducing to 10% against targets with Battle Spirit. Grants you Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948.
feral-cruelty.img_note: The wiki has no icon for this passive; the picture is the Werewolf line's Werewolf Transformation.

font-of-power.name: Font of Power
font-of-power.desc: Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power. Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 17% for 10 seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by 1% for every 1750 Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.

glacial-obstinance.name: Glacial Obstinance
glacial-obstinance.desc: Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve. Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant 15% Weapon and Spell Damage for 10 seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.

gnash.name: Gnash
gnash.desc: Bare your fangs and gnash your teeth into an enemy while ripping back, dealing 3639 Physical Damage on the initial lunge and 3638 Bleed Damage while ripping out. Consumes a stack of Blood Hunger to increase the initial damage done by 25%. The second hit deals 125% more damage to enemies with less than 25% Health.

morphs.name: Rip and Tear
morphs.note: The initial hit applies Sundered and Major Breach, while the second hit heals you. Blood Hunger applies to healing instead of damage.
morphs.desc: Rip and tear into an enemy with your fangs, dealing 3640 Physical Damage while applying Major Breach for 15 seconds and the Sundered status effect on the initial rip and 3638 Bleed Damage while tearing out, when it is done. The second hit deals 125% more damage to enemies with less than 25% Health and heals you for 3414, based off your Max Health. Consumes a stack of Blood Hunger to increase the healing done by 25%.

morphs.name: Bloody Gnash
morphs.note: Has a 50% chance to not consume Blood Hunger and the second hit applies Hemorrhaging. Increases execute scaling.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 1620 Stamina.
Bare your fangs and gnash your teeth into an enemy while ripping back, dealing 3640 Physical Damage on the initial lunge and 3758 Bleed Damage while ripping out. Consumes a stack of Blood Hunger to increase the initial damage done by 25%. There is a 50% chance to retain Blood Hunger each cast. The second hit deals 200% more damage to enemies with less than 25% Health and applies the Hemorrhaging status effect.

green-keepers-hide.name: Green-Keeper's Hide
green-keepers-hide.desc: The twisting of seasons has tempered your will. Reduce your damage taken by 3% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of 15%.

lava-whip.name: Lava Whip
lava-whip.desc: Lash an enemy with flame, dealing 6351 Flame Damage. Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants 5 stacks of Volcanic Whip for 20 seconds, up to once every 20 seconds. Volcanic Whip replaces this ability and consumes a stack to instead deal 11858 Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies.

morphs.name: Molten Whip
morphs.note: Splits the cost between Magicka and Stamina. Activating other Dragonknight abilities empowers your next Molten Whip cast to deal high single target damage.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 1148 Magicka and 1148 Stamina.
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing 6561 Flame Damage. Activating a different Dragonknight ability while in combat grants a stack of Seething Fury up to 3 times, increasing the damage of your next Molten Whip by 33%, halving against players, within 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Flame Lash
morphs.note: You heal whenever dealing damage with the ability. Grants bonus damage to monsters after activating the special variant.
morphs.desc: Lash an enemy with flame, dealing 6351 Flame Damage and healing for 2185 Health. Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants 5 stacks of Power Lash for 20 seconds, up to once every 20 seconds. After activating, you gain 3% damage done to monsters for 45 seconds. Activating again consumes a stack to deal 9781 Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for 4374 Health.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flame around you every 5 seconds, dealing 4764 Flame Damage directly to enemies inside. While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Incinerate
morphs.note: Increases the damage of the ability and chances of applying Burning.
morphs.desc: Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every 5 seconds, dealing 5412 Flame Damage directly to enemies inside. Each hit has a 15% chance of applying Burning. While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Cauterize
morphs.note: Now heals allies instead of damaging enemies. Increases radius and tick frequency.
morphs.desc:
Radius: 15 meters.
Activate an aura of embers which cauterizes the wounds of you or up to 6 nearby allies every 3 seconds, healing for 3279 Health. While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.desc: WITH AN ASSASSINATION ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Critical Damage by 5%. Critically striking in any form grants you and your group Minor Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 6% for 10 seconds.
hemorrhage.desc_max: WITH AN ASSASSINATION ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Critical Damage by 10%. Critically striking in any form grants you and your group Minor Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 6% for 20 seconds.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.desc: Casting a Dawn's Wrath ability grants you and your group 2974 Armor for 10 seconds.
illuminate.desc_max: Casting a Dawn's Wrath ability grants you and your group 2974 Armor for 20 seconds.

hidden-blade.name: Hidden Blade
hidden-blade.desc: Fire a secret dagger from your sleeve at an enemy, dealing 3811 Physical Damage and granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 20 seconds. If the enemy hit is casting an ability they are interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Shrouded Daggers
morphs.note: Increases the damage, and the dagger now bounces up to a total of three times.
morphs.desc:
Area: 8 meters.
Fire a secret dagger from your sleeve that bounces up to 3 times to nearby enemies, dealing 4921 Physical Damage per hit. If enemies hit are casting they are interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for 3 seconds. You also gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Flying Blade
morphs.note: Casting the ability again against the same target causes you to jump to them. Extends the duration of Major Brutality.
morphs.desc: Fire a secret dagger from your sleeve at an enemy, dealing 3936 Physical Damage and marking them for 5 seconds. If the enemy hit is casting an ability they are interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for 3 seconds. Reactivating this ability on them allows you to jump to a marked enemy free of cost, dealing 5905 Physical Damage. Casting grants you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 40 seconds.

intimidating-presence.name: Intimidating Presence
intimidating-presence.desc: Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation. Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by 15%.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.desc: Increases your Max Health by 1% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.
juggernaut.desc_max: Increases your Max Health by 2% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

mage-adept.name: Mage Adept
mage-adept.desc: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by 8%.
mage-adept.desc_max: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by 15%.

magelight.name: Magelight
magelight.desc:
Cost: 5130 Magicka.
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for 5 seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for 4 seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active. While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Inner Light
morphs.note: Also increases your Max Magicka while slotted.
morphs.desc: Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for 5 seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for 4 seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active. While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12% and your Max Magicka is increased by 5%.

morphs.name: Radiant Magelight
morphs.note: Increases the radius of the reveal. You and nearby allies cannot be stunned from sneak attacks while slotted. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4860 Magicka, Radius: 12 meters.
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for 5 seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for 4 seconds. The light is so radiant that you cannot conceal your presence while active. While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. You also prevent the stun from stealth attacks for you and nearby allies.

improved-sneak.name: Improved Sneak
improved-sneak.desc: Reduces the cost of Sneak by 4% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. Reduces the size of your detection area while Sneaking by 3% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.
improved-sneak.desc_max: Reduces the cost of Sneak by 7% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. Reduces the size of your detection area while Sneaking by 5% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

low-slash.name: Low Slash
low-slash.desc: Surprise an enemy with a deep lunge, dealing 3811 Physical Damage and afflicting them with Minor Maim, reducing their damage done by 5% for 15 seconds.

morphs.name: Deep Slash
morphs.note: Increases the damage dealt. Now hits all targets near the initial enemy hit, and snares them.
morphs.desc:
Area: 6 meters.
Surprise an enemy with a sweeping lunge, dealing 4921 Physical Damage to them and other nearby enemies, afflicting them with Minor Maim, reducing their damage done by 5% for 15 seconds. Enemies hit also have their Movement Speed reduced by 30% for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Heroic Slash
morphs.note: You gain Minor Heroism, increasing your Ultimate generation.
morphs.desc: Surprise an enemy with a deep lunge, dealing 3936 Physical Damage and afflicting them with Minor Maim, reducing their damage done by 5% for 15 seconds. You gain Minor Heroism, granting you 1 Ultimate every 1.5 seconds for 15 seconds.

light-weaver.name: Light Weaver
light-weaver.desc: When you heal an ally under 50% Health with a Restoring Light ability, you grant them 1 Ultimate. Activating an ability with a cast or channel time while in combat causes you to automatically block all attacks at no cost for 2 seconds, up to once every 30 seconds.
light-weaver.desc_max: When you heal an ally under 50% Health with a Restoring Light ability, you grant them 2 Ultimate. Activating an ability with a cast or channel time while in combat causes you to automatically block all attacks at no cost for 2 seconds, up to once every 15 seconds.

mages-fury.name: Mages' Fury
mages-fury.desc: Call down lightning to strike an enemy, dealing 2382 Shock Damage. If the enemy falls to or below 20% Health within 2 seconds of being struck, an explosion deals an additional 8734 Shock Damage to them and 1905 Shock Damage to other enemies nearby.

morphs.name: Mages' Wrath
morphs.note: Significantly increases the damage dealt to other enemies nearby.
morphs.desc: Call down lightning to strike an enemy, dealing 2382 Shock Damage. If the enemy falls to or below 20% Health within 2 seconds of being struck, an explosion deals an additional 8735 Shock Damage to them and all nearby enemies.

morphs.name: Endless Fury
morphs.note: Reduces the cost and restores Magicka if the target dies after this ability dealt damage to them.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2160 Magicka.
Call down lightning to strike an enemy, dealing 2382 Shock Damage. If the enemy falls to or below 20% Health within 2 seconds of being struck, an explosion deals an additional 8735 Shock Damage to them and 1905 Shock Damage to other enemies nearby. If any enemy is killed within 5 seconds of being hit with this ability, you restore 4860 Magicka.

lightning-form.name: Lightning Form
lightning-form.desc: Manifest yourself as pure lightning, zapping nearby enemies with electricity dealing 1270 Shock Damage every 2 seconds for 20 seconds. While in this form you also gain Major Resolve, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948.

morphs.name: Hurricane
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Physical Damage. Increases in size and damage the longer it is active. Grants Minor Expedition while active, increasing your Movement Speed.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Stamina.
Manifest yourself as pure air, buffeting nearby enemies with wind dealing 1310 Physical Damage every 2 seconds for 20 seconds. The winds grow in damage and size, increasing up to 120% more damage and up to 9 meters in size. While in this form you gain Major Resolve and Minor Expedition, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 and your Movement Speed by 15%.

morphs.name: Boundless Storm
morphs.note: Increases the duration, and you gain Major Expedition for brief period after activation, increasing your Movement Speed.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Manifest yourself as pure lightning, zapping nearby enemies with electricity dealing 1269 Shock Damage every 2 seconds for 30 seconds. While in this form you also gain Major Resolve, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948. Activating this grants you Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

lightning-splash.name: Lightning Splash
lightning-splash.desc: Create a nexus of storm energy at the target location, dealing 843 Shock Damage to enemies in the area every 1 second for 10 seconds. You or an ally standing within the nexus can activate the Conduit synergy, dealing 7380 Shock Damage to enemies around them.

morphs.name: Liquid Lightning
morphs.note: Increases the duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 15 seconds.
Create a nexus of storm energy at the target location, dealing 844 Shock Damage to enemies in the area every 1 second for 15 seconds. You or an ally standing within the nexus can activate the Conduit synergy, dealing 7380 Shock Damage to enemies around them.

morphs.name: Lightning Flood
morphs.note: Increases the radius and damage.
morphs.desc:
Radius: 8 meters.
Create a nexus of storm energy at the target location, dealing 1135 Shock Damage to enemies in the area every 1 second for 10 seconds. You or an ally standing within the nexus can activate the Conduit synergy, dealing 7380 Shock Damage to enemies around them.

magicka-aid.name: Magicka Aid
magicka-aid.desc: Increases your Magicka Recovery by 5% for each Support ability slotted.
magicka-aid.desc_max: Increases your Magicka Recovery by 10% for each Support ability slotted.

heavy-weapons.name: Heavy Weapons
heavy-weapons.desc: WITH A TWO-HANDED WEAPON EQUIPPED Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped: Swords increase your Weapon and Spell Damage by 129. Axes increase your Critical Damage done by 6%. Maces increase your Offensive Penetration by 1487.
heavy-weapons.desc_max: WITH A TWO-HANDED WEAPON EQUIPPED Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped: Swords increase your Weapon and Spell Damage by 258. Axes increase your Critical Damage done by 12%. Maces increase your Offensive Penetration by 2974.

inner-fire.name: Inner Fire
inner-fire.desc: Ignite the fires of hate in an enemy's heart, dealing 2858 Flame Damage and taunting them to attack you for 15 seconds. An ally targeting the taunted enemy can activate the Radiate synergy, dealing 3684 Flame Damage to them over 3 seconds then an additional 6146 Flame Damage to them and other nearby enemies.

morphs.name: Inner Rage
morphs.note: The synergy can now be activated by up to 3 allies.
morphs.desc: Ignite the fires of hate in an enemy's heart, dealing 2952 Flame Damage and taunting them to attack you for 15 seconds. Up to 3 allies targeting the taunted enemy can activate the Radiate synergy, dealing 3684 Flame Damage to them over 3 seconds then an additional 6146 Flame Damage to them and other nearby enemies.

morphs.name: Inner Beast
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals increased Physical Damage. Applies Minor Vulnerability and Maim to the enemy.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Stamina.
Ignite the fires of hate in an enemy's heart, dealing 5905 Physical Damage, taunting them to attack you, and applying Minor Maim and Minor Vulnerability for 15 seconds, reducing their damage done and increasing their damage taken by 5%. An ally targeting the enemy can activate the Radiate synergy, dealing 3684 Flame Damage to them over 3 seconds then an additional 6146 Flame Damage to them and other nearby enemies.

impulse.name: Impulse
impulse.desc: Release a surge of elemental energy, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Fire Impulse hits Burning enemies with Impulse Afterburn, which deals more damage based on their missing Health. Frost Impulse also provides Minor Protection. Shock Impulse's damage increases based on the number of enemies hit.

morphs.name: Elemental Ring
morphs.note: Deals damage at a target location instead of around you.
morphs.desc:
Range: 28 meters, Target: Ground.
Release a surge of elemental energy, dealing 4921 Magic Damage to enemies at the target location. Fire Ring hits Burning enemies with Ring Afterburn, which deals more damage based on their missing Health. Frost Ring also provides Minor Protection. Shock Ring's damage increases based on the number of enemies hit.

morphs.name: Pulsar
morphs.note: Applies Minor Mangle to non-boss enemies, reducing their Max Health. Triples the innate chance to apply the respective status effect.
morphs.desc: Release a surge of elemental energy, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to nearby enemies and afflicting them with Minor Mangle, reducing their Max Health by 10% for 10 seconds. Flame Pulsar hits Burning enemies with Pulsar Afterburn, which deals more damage based on their missing Health. Frost Pulsar also provides Minor Protection. Storm Pulsar's damage increases based on the number of enemies hit.

improved-hiding.name: Improved Hiding
improved-hiding.desc: Reduces the cost of Sneak by 10%.
improved-hiding.desc_max: Reduces the cost of Sneak by 40%.

light-fingers.name: Light Fingers
light-fingers.desc: Increases your chance of successfully Pickpocketing by 10%.
light-fingers.desc_max: Increases your chances of successfully Pickpocketing by 50%

locksmith.name: Locksmith
locksmith.desc: Improves your chances of forcing locks by 10%.
locksmith.desc_max: Improves your chances of forcing locks by 70%.

kickback.name: Kickback
kickback.desc: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by 10%.
kickback.desc_max: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by 40%.

hircines-bounty.name: Hircine's Bounty
hircines-bounty.desc: Invoke the Huntsman's blessing, healing you for 4958 Health, scaling off your Max Health. You also restore 10% Stamina, increasing by up to 100% based on how high your current Health is. Current Restore: 3000 While slotted you gain Major Brutality, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%.

morphs.name: Hircine's Rage
morphs.note: Healing now scales with offensive stats, grants double Fury, and passively grants Minor Berserk while slotted. Increases damage done and taken based on your current Health.
morphs.desc: Invoke the Huntsman's blessing, healing you for 9102 Health, granting double Fury, and increasing your damage done and taken by up to 12% for 20 seconds, based on how high your current Health is. You also restore 10% Stamina, increasing by up to 100%, based on how high your current Health is. Current Restore: 3000 While slotted you gain Major Brutality and Minor Berserk.

morphs.name: Hircine's Fortitude
morphs.note: Increases the healing and stamina restored. Passively grants Major Vitality while slotted.
morphs.desc: Invoke the Huntsman's blessing, healing you for 5890 Health, scaling off your Max Health. You also restore 12% Stamina, increasing by up to 100% based on how high your current Health is. Current Restore: 3600 While slotted you gain Major Brutality and Vitality increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% and healing received and damage shield strength by 12%.

lacerate.name: Lacerate
lacerate.desc: Slash enemies in front of you, causing them to bleed for 19040 Bleed Damage over 8 seconds and healing you for 50% of the damage done. Each tick applies the Hemorrhaging status effect.

morphs.name: Rend
morphs.note: Increases the duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 16 seconds.
Slash enemies in front of you, causing them to bleed for 35406 Bleed Damage over 16 seconds and healing you for 50% of the damage done. Each tick applies the Hemorrhaging status effect.

morphs.name: Thrive in Chaos
morphs.note: Converts into a attack. Each enemy hit increases your damage done.
morphs.desc:
Radius: 15 meters, Target: Cone.
Slash enemies in front of you, causing them to bleed for 19050 Bleed Damage over 8 seconds and healing you for 50% of the damage done. Each enemy hit increases your damage done by 6% for 15 seconds. This effect can stack up to 6 times. Each tick applies the Hemorrhaging status effect.

impaling-shards.name: Impaling Shards
impaling-shards.desc: Conjure icy shards around you to skewer enemies in the area, dealing 404 Frost Damage every 1 second for 12 seconds. Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds. Damage done is based on your Max Health, and has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.

morphs.name: Gripping Shards
morphs.note: Immobilizes enemies around you when cast and reduces the cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2970 Magicka.
Conjure icy shards around you to skewer enemies in the area, immobilizing them for 3 seconds and dealing 418 Frost Damage every 1 second for 12 seconds. Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds. Damage done is based on your Max Health and has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.

morphs.name: Winter's Revenge
morphs.note: Summons at targeted location instead of around you. Deals damage based on your offensive stats rather than Max Health.
morphs.desc:
Range: 28 meters, Target: Ground.
Conjure icy shards at the target location to skewer enemies in the area, dealing 803 Frost Damage every 1 second for 12 seconds. This damage increases by 30% if cast with a Destruction Staff equipped. Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds. This ability has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.

living-vines.name: Living Vines
living-vines.desc: Grow vines to embrace you or the lowest health ally in front of you for 10 seconds. The vines heal the target for 1903 Health each time they take damage. This effect can occur once every 1 second.

morphs.name: Leeching Vines
morphs.note: Minor Lifesteal is applied to attackers.
morphs.desc: Grow vines to embrace you or the lowest health ally in front of you for 10 seconds. The vines heal the target for 1966 Health each time they take damage. This effect can occur once every 1 second. The vines apply Minor Lifesteal to enemies that damage the target for 10 seconds, healing you and your allies for 600 Health every 1 second when damaging that enemy.

morphs.name: Living Trellis
morphs.note: Heals when effect ends.
morphs.desc: Grow vines to embrace you or the lowest health ally in front of you for 10 seconds. The vines heal the target for 1966 Health each time they take damage. This effect can occur once every 1 second. When the vines expire, they heal the target for an additional 4761 Health.

lotus-flower.name: Lotus Flower
lotus-flower.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Embrace the lotus blessing, causing your Light Attacks to restore 1320 Health and your fully-charged Heavy Attacks to restore 3036 Health to you or a nearby ally for 20 seconds. Upon activation you gain Major Savagery for 20 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Green Lotus
morphs.note: Heals two additional targets and increases the healing caused.
morphs.desc: Embrace the lotus blessing, causing your Light Attacks to restore 1500 Health and your fully-charged Heavy Attacks to restore 3450 Health to you or 2 nearby allies for 20 seconds. Upon activation you gain Major Savagery for 20 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Lotus Blossom
morphs.note: Significantly increases the duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 60 seconds.
Embrace the lotus blessing, causing your Light Attacks to restore 1320 Health and your fully-charged Heavy Attacks to restore 3036 Health to you or a nearby ally for 60 seconds. Upon activation you gain Major Savagery for 60 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

icy-aura.name: Icy Aura
icy-aura.desc: WITH A WINTER'S EMBRACE ABILITY SLOTTED When you take direct damage from an enemy in melee range, you apply a stack of Bite of Winter to them for 1.5 seconds, up to 5 stacks max. Attackers at max stacks are afflicted with Major Maim for 1.5 seconds, reducing their damage done by 10%.
icy-aura.desc_max: WITH A WINTER'S EMBRACE ABILITY SLOTTED When you take direct damage from an enemy in melee range, you apply a stack of Bite of Winter to them for 3 seconds, up to 5 stacks max. Attackers at max stacks are afflicted with Major Maim for 3 seconds, reducing their damage done by 10%.

imbue-weapon.name: Imbue Weapon
imbue-weapon.desc: Infuse your weapon with power, causing your next Light or Heavy Attack used within 6 seconds to deal an additional 5712 Physical Damage. You cannot conceal your presence while active. When cast, increases your damage done with weapon attacks by 5% for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Elemental Weapon
morphs.note: Converts into a Magicka ability and deals Magic Damage. Applies a random status effect.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka.
Infuse your weapon with power, causing your next Light or Heavy Attack used within 6 seconds to deal an additional 5903 Magic Damage and apply the Burning, Concussion, or Chill elemental status effect. You cannot conceal your presence while active. When cast, increases your damage done with weapon attacks by 5% for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Crushing Weapon
morphs.note: Applies Major Breach to the enemy. Increases the weapon attack bonus.
morphs.desc: Infuse your weapon with power, causing your next Light or Heavy Attack used within 6 seconds to deal an additional 5903 Physical Damage and applying Major Breach to the target, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 6 seconds. You cannot conceal your presence while active. When cast, increases your damage done with weapon attacks by 8% for 6 seconds.

life-amid-death.name: Life amid Death
life-amid-death.desc: Release residual fragments of fallen souls at the target location, healing you and your allies for 6351 Health. Consumes a corpse on cast to continue to heal you and your allies in the area for 6350 Health over 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Renewing Undeath
morphs.note: Consuming a corpse also removes negative effects.
morphs.desc: Release residual fragments of fallen souls at the target location, healing you and your allies for 6561 Health. Consumes a corpse on cast to immediately remove up to 3 negative effects and continue to heal you and your allies in the area for 6550 Health over 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Enduring Undeath
morphs.note: Can consume multiple corpses to increase the duration of the heal over time.
morphs.desc: Release residual fragments of fallen souls at the target location, healing you and your allies for 6561 Health. Consumes a corpse on cast to continue to heal you and your allies in the area for 6550 Health over 5 seconds. You can consume up to 5 additional corpses on cast, with each corpse extending the duration of the heal over time by 5 seconds.

heavy-shovel.name: Heavy Shovel
heavy-shovel.desc: Removes 1 layer of dirt and rocks from up to a 3x3 area. The shovel only affects a single contiguous height of dirt and rocks. Costs 2 Intuition to use.
heavy-shovel.desc_max: Removes 1 layer of dirt and rocks from up to a 3x3 area. The shovel only affects a single contiguous height of dirt and rocks. Costs 2 Intuition to use. Has a chance to consume no Intuition on use.

keen-eye-dig-sites.name: Keen Eye: Dig Sites
keen-eye-dig-sites.desc: Antiquity Dig Sites will be easier to see when you are 20 meters or closer.
keen-eye-dig-sites.desc_max: Antiquity Dig Sites will be easier to see when you are 30 meters or closer.

keen-eye-treasure-chests.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests
keen-eye-treasure-chests.desc: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are 20 meters or closer.
keen-eye-treasure-chests.desc_max: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are 30 meters or closer.

implacable-outcome.name: Implacable Outcome
implacable-outcome.desc: The will of an Arcanist is absolute. When you consume Crux, gain 2 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 8 seconds.
implacable-outcome.desc_max: The will of an Arcanist is absolute. When you consume Crux, gain 4 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 8 seconds.

hideous-clarity.name: Hideous Clarity
hideous-clarity.desc: You've stared too long into the abyss. When you generate Crux, you restore 112 Magicka and Stamina.
hideous-clarity.desc_max: You've stared too long into the abyss. When you generate Crux, you restore 225 Magicka and Stamina.

intricate-runeforms.name: Intricate Runeforms
intricate-runeforms.desc: With a Curative Runeforms Ability Slotted Your status as illuminatus reduces the cost and increases the strength of your damage shields by 5%.
intricate-runeforms.desc_max: With a Curative Runeforms Ability Slotted Your status as illuminatus reduces the cost and increases the strength of your damage shields by 10%.

heart-of-stone.name: Heart of Stone
heart-of-stone.desc: Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words. Increases your Armor by 1487.
heart-of-stone.desc_max: Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words. Increases your Armor by 2974.

hearthfire.name: Hearthfire
hearthfire.desc: Throw out a kindled flame, filling a large area with warmth for 15 seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for 1188 Health every 1 second. Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism while inside, increasing Health Recovery by 15% and generating 1 Ultimate every 1.5 seconds.

morphs.name: Fire Keeper
morphs.note: Heals for significantly more if you stand in the area. Minor buffs persist after being healed.
morphs.desc: Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for 15 seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for 1228 Health every 1 second. This healing increases by 50% if you are in the area. Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for 15 seconds, increasing Health Recovery by 15% and generating 1 Ultimate every 1.5 seconds.

morphs.name: Hearth and Home
morphs.note: While inside, you gain Major Protection and enemies move slower. Healing now scales off Max Health. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 270 Magicka / 1s.
Throw out a protective flame for 15 seconds, healing you and allies inside for 618 Health every 1 second, scaling off your Max Health. Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism while inside, increasing Health Recovery by 15% and generating 1 Ultimate every 1.5 seconds. You gain Major Protection while inside, reducing damage taken by 10%. Enemies inside have their Movement Speed reduced by 70%.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.desc: WITH AN EARTHEN HEART ABILITY ACTIVE Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation. Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by 1% per stack, up to 12 times. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds. Every 6 seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
landslide.desc_max: Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation. Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by 1% per stack, up to 12 times. This effect can occur once every 4 seconds. Every 6 seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.

inexorable-descent.name: Inexorable Descent
inexorable-descent.desc: Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you. Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by 1% per stack.

ink-scribes-verve.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve
