ink-scribes-verve.desc: Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink. While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of 100000 Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for 10 seconds, increasing Critical Damage by 20%.

insatiable-hunger.name: Insatiable Hunger
insatiable-hunger.desc: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Hunger gnaws at you. Like Storihbeg, shape it into a brutal weapon. Gain the ability to devour corpses, for up to 4 seconds per corpse. Each second devouring you heal for 3200 Health, based off your Max Health, and restore 15 Ultimate. If you are a Werewolf Berserker, each tick activates Fury generation.
insatiable-hunger.img_note: The wiki has no icon for this passive; the picture is the Werewolf line's Werewolf Transformation.

judgments-brand.name: Judgment's Brand
judgments-brand.desc: Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance. When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain 1600 damage done for 3.1 seconds. This bonus is halved against players.

lead-from-the-front.name: Lead from the Front
lead-from-the-front.desc: Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame. Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within 28 meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for 1 second per 15 Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by 10%.

piercing-spear.name: Piercing Spear
piercing-spear.desc: WITH AN AEDRIC SPEAR ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Critical Damage by 6%. Increases your damage done to blocking players by 6%.
piercing-spear.desc_max: WITH AN AEDRIC SPEAR ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Critical Damage by 12%. Increases your damage done to blocking players by 12%.

piercing-javelin.name: Piercing Javelin
piercing-javelin.desc: Hurl your spear at an enemy with godlike strength, dealing 3811 Magic Damage and knocking them back 8 meters. This ability ignores the enemy's Resistances and cannot be blocked.

morphs.name: Aurora Javelin
morphs.note: Deals additional damage based on the distance the spear travels.
morphs.desc: Hurl your spear at an enemy with godlike strength, dealing 3936 Magic Damage and knocking them back 8 meters. This ability ignores the enemy's Resistances and cannot be blocked. The spear deals an additional 2% damage for every 1 meter you are away from the target, up to a maximum of 40%.

morphs.name: Binding Javelin
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Physical Damage. Stuns the enemy for longer instead of knocking back.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3213 Stamina.
Hurl your spear at an enemy with godlike strength, dealing 3811 Physical Damage and stunning them for 4 seconds. This ability ignores the enemy's Resistances and cannot be blocked.

master-assassin.name: Master Assassin
master-assassin.desc: Increases your Critical Chance rating against enemies you are flanking by 724, increasing your chance to critically strike by 3.3%.
master-assassin.desc_max: Increases your Critical Chance rating against enemies you are flanking by 1448, increasing your chance to critically strike by 6.6%.

mark-target.name: Mark Target
mark-target.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Expose an enemy's weaknesses by applying Major Breach to them, reducing Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds. When a marked enemy dies, you heal to full Health. You can only have one Mark Target active at a time.

morphs.name: Piercing Mark
morphs.note: Ability has an increased duration, and you can see the target if they use stealth or invisibility.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 60 seconds.
Expose an enemy's weaknesses by applying Major Breach to them, reducing Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds. You can detect marked enemies even if they use stealth or invisibility for 3 seconds. When a marked enemy dies, you heal to full Health. You can only have one Piercing Mark active at a time.

morphs.name: Reaper's Mark
morphs.note: If the marked enemy dies, you gain Major Berserk, increasing your damage done.
morphs.desc: Expose an enemy's weaknesses by applying Major Breach to them, reducing Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds. When a marked enemy dies, you heal to full Health and gain Major Berserk, increasing your damage done by 10% for 10 seconds. You can only have one Reaper's Mark active at a time.

power-stone.name: Power Stone
power-stone.desc: Reduces the cost of your Ultimate abilities by 8%.
power-stone.desc_max: Reduces the cost of your Ultimate abilities by 15%.

persistence.name: Persistence
persistence.desc: After blocking an attack, your next Health, Magicka, or Stamina ability costs 9% less.
persistence.desc_max: After blocking an attack, your next Health, Magicka, or Stamina ability costs 18% less.

negate-magic.name: Negate Magic
negate-magic.desc:
Duration: 12 seconds.
Create a globe of magic suppression for 12 seconds, removing and preventing all enemy area of effect abilities from occurring in the area. Enemies within the globe are stunned, while enemy players will be silenced rather than stunned.

morphs.name: Suppression Field
morphs.note: The globe also damages enemies standing inside it.
morphs.desc: Create a globe of magic suppression for 12 seconds, removing and preventing all enemy area of effect abilities from occurring in the area. Enemies within the globe are stunned, while enemy players will be silenced rather than stunned. The globe also damages enemies for 2836 Magic Damage every 1 second.

morphs.name: Absorption Field
morphs.note: The globe also heals you and your allies standing inside it.
morphs.desc: Create a globe of magic suppression for 12 seconds, removing and preventing all enemy area of effect abilities from occurring in the area. Enemies within the globe are stunned, while enemy players will be silenced rather than stunned. The globe also heals you and your allies for 2836 Health every 1 second.

nova.name: Nova
nova.desc: Call down a fragment of the sun, dealing 3172 Magic Damage every 1 second for 8 seconds to enemies in the area and afflicting them with Major Maim, reducing their damage done by 10%. An ally near the fragment can activate the Supernova synergy, dealing 7128 Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and stunning them for 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Solar Prison
morphs.note: The synergy deals more damage and stuns for longer.
morphs.desc: Call down a fragment of the sun, dealing 3278 Magic Damage every 1 second for 8 seconds to enemies in the area and afflicting them with Major Maim, reducing their damage done by 10%. An ally near the fragment can activate the Gravity Crush synergy, dealing 14256 Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and stunning them for 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Solar Disturbance
morphs.note: Reduces the cost and Major Maim stays on enemies after leaving the area.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 225 Ultimate.
Call down a fragment of the sun, dealing 3174 Magic Damage every 1 second for 8 seconds to enemies in the area and applying Major Maim to them for 10 seconds, reducing their damage done by 10%. An ally near the fragment can activate the Supernova synergy, dealing 7128 Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and stunning them for 3 seconds.

penetrating-magic.name: Penetrating Magic
penetrating-magic.desc: With Destruction Staff Equipped Your Destruction Staff abilities ignore 1487 of the enemy's Spell Resistance.
penetrating-magic.desc_max: With Destruction Staff Equipped Your Destruction Staff abilities ignore 2974 of the enemy's Spell Resistance.

magma-armor.name: Magma Armor
magma-armor.desc:
Duration: 15 seconds.
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to 3% of your Max Health for 15 seconds. While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

morphs.name: Magma Shell
morphs.note: Grants a powerful damage shield to nearby allies.
morphs.desc:
Area: 28 meters, Target: Area.
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to 3% of your Max Health for 15 seconds. When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for 133% of their Max Health for 10 seconds. While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

morphs.name: Corrosive Armor
morphs.note: Your direct damage attacks ignore Physical and Spell Resistance and you deal Flame Damage around you while the Ultimate persists, but reduces the duration and damage limit.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 10 seconds, Area: 5 meters, Target: Area.
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to 6% of your Max Health and dealing 4428 Flame Damage to nearby enemies each second for 10 seconds. You cannot conceal your presence while active. While active your direct damage attacks ignore enemy Physical and Spell Resistance but you cannot generate Ultimate.

molten-weapons.name: Molten Weapons
molten-weapons.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 30 seconds. While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional 1228 Flame Damage, up to once every 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Igneous Weapons
morphs.note: Increases the duration and increases the radius.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 60 seconds, Radius: 36 meters.
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 60 seconds. While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional 1228 Flame Damage, up to once every 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Molten Armaments
morphs.note: You also gain Empower, the damage cooldown is shortened, and reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4050 Magicka.
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 30 seconds. While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional 1228 Flame Damage, up to once every 1.5 seconds. You also gain Empower for the duration, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150%.

obsidian-shield.name: Obsidian Shield
obsidian-shield.desc: Call the earth to your defense, granting a damage shield for you and nearby allies that absorbs 1322 damage. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health. You also gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by 16% for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Igneous Shield
morphs.note: Increased shield strength on self.
morphs.desc: Call the earth to your defense, granting a damage shield for nearby allies that absorbs 1322 damage. Your own damage shield absorbs 3824 damage. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health. You also gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by 16% for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Fragmented Shield
morphs.note: The shield strength now scales with your highest resource. Increases duration of Major Mending.
morphs.desc: Call the earth to your defense, creating a damage shield for you and nearby allies that absorbs 6001 damage. This portion of the ability scales off the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina and is capped at 31% of the target's Max Health. You also gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by 16% for 6 seconds.

petrify.name: Petrify
petrify.desc:
Cost: 3510 Magicka.
Encase an enemy in molten rock, reducing their movement speed by 50% for 1 second. Upon completion, the target is stunned for 4 seconds, or 8 seconds against monsters. This stun cannot be blocked. The molten rock melts through the enemy's armor and applies Minor Breach for 10 seconds, reducing Armor by 2974.

morphs.name: Fossilize
morphs.note: Adds Minor Vulnerability and extends the duration. Immobilizes after the stun ends.
morphs.desc: Encase an enemy in molten rock, reducing their movement speed by 50% for 1 second. Upon completion, the target is stunned for 4 seconds, or 8 seconds against monsters. Immobilizes the target for 4 seconds after the stun ends. This stun cannot be blocked. The molten rock melts through the enemy's armor and applies Minor Breach and Minor Vulnerability for 20 seconds, reducing Armor by 2974 and increasing damage taken by 5%.

morphs.name: Shattering Rocks
morphs.note: Damages the enemy and heals you when the stun ends.
morphs.desc: Encase an enemy in molten rock, reducing their movement speed by 50% for 1 second. Upon completion, the target is stunned for 4 seconds, or 8 seconds against monsters. After the stun ends, the target takes 3771 Flame Damage and you heal for 7544 Health. This stun cannot be blocked. The molten rock melts through the enemy's armor and applies Minor Breach for 10 seconds, reducing Armor by 2974.

persuasive-will.name: Persuasive Will
persuasive-will.desc: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

magicka-controller.name: Magicka Controller
magicka-controller.desc: Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by 1% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.
magicka-controller.desc_max: Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by 2% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

might-of-the-guild.name: Might of the Guild
might-of-the-guild.desc: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150% for 5 seconds.
might-of-the-guild.desc_max: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150% for 10 seconds.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing 11117 Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down, and stunning them for 2 seconds. One second after impact, enemies in the target area take 3172 Flame Damage every 1 second for 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Ice Comet
morphs.note: Converts to Frost Damage, increases damage done, and reduces the Movement Speed of enemies hit.
morphs.desc: Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing 12631 Frost Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down and stunning them for 2 seconds. One second after impact, enemies in the target area take 4374 Frost Damage every 1 second for 10 seconds. Enemies damaged by either portion have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Shooting Star
morphs.note: You generate Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast. Reduces the base cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 170 Ultimate.
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing 11117 Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down, and stunning them for 2 seconds. One second after impact, enemies in the target area take 3174 Flame Damage every 1 second for 10 seconds. You generate 10 Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.

power-bash.name: Power Bash
power-bash.desc: Strike an enemy full-force with your shield, dealing 6351 Physical Damage. This ability's damage is considered Bash damage and interrupts the enemy if they are casting.

morphs.name: Reverberating Bash
morphs.note: Initial damage is halved, but stuns the target. After the stun ends, the enemy takes the damage again.
morphs.desc: Strike an enemy full-force with your shield, dealing 3175 Physical Damage and stunning them for 3 seconds. After the stun ends, the enemy takes an additional 3175 Physical Damage. This ability's damage is considered Bash damage and interrupts the enemy if they are casting.

morphs.name: Power Slam
morphs.note: Blocking any attack reduces the cost of your next Power Slam.
morphs.desc: Strike an enemy full-force with your shield, dealing 6561 Physical Damage. While slotted, blocking any attack grants you Resentment, which reduces the cost of your next Power Slam cast within 10 seconds by 50%. This ability's damage is considered Bash damage and interrupts the enemy if they are casting.

mending.name: Mending
mending.desc: Increases your healing done by up to 6%, in proportion to the severity of the target's wounds.
mending.desc_max: Increases your healing done by up to 13%, in proportion to the severity of the target's wounds.

master-ritualist.name: Master Ritualist
master-ritualist.desc: Increases resurrection speed by 10%. Resurrected allies return with 50% more Health. Gives you a 50% chance to fill an empty Soul Gem after each successful resurrection.
master-ritualist.desc_max: Increases resurrection speed by 20%. Resurrected allies return with 100% more Health. Gives you a 50% chance to fill an empty Soul Gem after each successful resurrection.

path-of-darkness.name: Path of Darkness
path-of-darkness.desc: Create a corridor of shadows for 10 seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by 30%. Effect persists for 4 seconds after leaving the path.

morphs.name: Twisting Path
morphs.note: Reduces the cost and the path affects a larger area and deals damage.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka, Area: 15 meters, Target: Cone.
Create a corridor of shadows for 10 seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by 30% which persists for 4 seconds after leaving the path. Deals 1031 Magic Damage to enemies in the target area every 1 second.

morphs.name: Refreshing Path
morphs.note: Path also heals you and your allies and increases their Magicka and Stamina Recovery.
morphs.desc: Create a corridor of shadows for 10 seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, Minor Endurance, and Minor Intellect, increasing Movement Speed by 30%, as well as Stamina and Magicka Recovery by 15%. Effect persists for 4 seconds after leaving the path. Heals 1189 Health to you and allies in the area every 1 second.

magicka-flood.name: Magicka Flood
magicka-flood.desc: WITH A SIPHONING ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Max Magicka and Stamina by 3%.
magicka-flood.desc_max: WITH A SIPHONING ABILITY SLOTTED Increases your Max Magicka and Stamina by 6%.

malevolent-offering.name: Malevolent Offering
malevolent-offering.desc: Pour out your lifesblood and channel the arcane, healing yourself or an ally in front of you for 9529 Health, while draining 1080 Health from yourself over 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Shrewd Offering
morphs.note: Reduces the Magicka cost and the duration of the Health cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2970 Magicka.
Pour out your lifesblood and channel the arcane, healing yourself or an ally in front of you for 9528 Health, while draining 810 Health from yourself over 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Healthy Offering
morphs.note: Grants you Minor Mending after casting, increasing your healing done.
morphs.desc: Pour out your lifesblood and channel the arcane, healing yourself or an ally in front of you for 9842 Health, while draining 1080 Health from yourself over 3 seconds. After casting, gain Minor Mending for 10 seconds, increasing your healing done by 8%.

overload.name: Overload
overload.desc: Charge your fists with the power of the storm, replacing your Light and Heavy Attacks with new abilities. You cannot conceal your presence while active. Light Attacks become lightning bolts, dealing 6351 Shock Damage to an enemy up to 28 meters away. Heavy Attacks become channeled lightning, dealing 5717 Shock Damage to enemies in a 4 x 6 area in front of you every 1 second. Attacks deplete Ultimate until you run out, or the ability is toggled off.

morphs.name: Power Overload
morphs.note: Increase range of Light Attacks and radius of Heavy Attacks. Increases damage.
morphs.desc: Charge your fists with the power of the storm, replacing your Light and Heavy Attacks with new abilities. You cannot conceal your presence while active. Light Attacks deal 7217 Shock Damage to an enemy up to 32 meters away. Heavy Attacks blast enemies in a 6 x 8 area for 6496 Shock Damage every 1 second. Attacks deplete Ultimate until you run out, or the ability is toggled off.

morphs.name: Energy Overload
morphs.note: While active your Light and Heavy Attacks restore Magicka and Stamina.
morphs.desc: Charge your fists with the power of the storm, replacing your Light and Heavy Attacks with new abilities. You cannot conceal your presence while active. Light Attacks deal 6561 Shock Damage to an enemy up to 28 meters away. Heavy Attacks blast enemies in a 4 x 6 area for 5905 Shock Damage every 1 second. The attacks restore 1200 Magicka and Stamina, and deplete Ultimate until you run out, or the ability is toggled off.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Focus your strength and resolve to gain Major Brutality and Minor Endurance for 30 seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% and Stamina Recovery by 15%.

morphs.name: Forward Momentum
morphs.note: Reduces the cost, increases the duration, and provides a brief immunity to snares and immobilizations.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3240 Stamina, Duration: 60 seconds.
Focus your strength and resolve to gain Major Brutality and Minor Endurance for 1 minute, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% and Stamina Recovery by 15%. Activating this ability removes all snares and immobilizations from you and grants immunity to them for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Rally
morphs.note: Also heals you when the effect expires.
morphs.desc: Focus your strength and resolve to gain Major Brutality and Minor Endurance for 30 seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% and Stamina Recovery by 15%. You heal for 4921 Health when Rally ends. The final heal is increased by 20% every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 200%.

necrotic-orb.name: Necrotic Orb
necrotic-orb.desc: Project a globe of annihilation that slowly floats forward for 10 seconds, dealing 863 Magic Damage every 1 second to nearby enemies. An ally near the globe can activate the Combustion synergy, causing the orb to explode for 6146 Magic Damage to nearby enemies and restore 3960 Magicka or Stamina to the ally, whichever maximum is higher.

morphs.name: Mystic Orb
morphs.note: Increases your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active.
morphs.desc: Project a globe of annihilation that slowly floats forward, dealing 892 Magic Damage every 1 second to nearby enemies. While the orb is active you gain 100 Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery. An ally near the globe can activate the Combustion synergy, causing the orb to explode for 6146 Magic Damage to nearby enemies and restore 3960 Magicka or Stamina to the ally, whichever maximum is higher.

morphs.name: Energy Orb
morphs.note: The orb heals allies instead of damaging enemies and moves faster.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka.
Project a globe of regeneration that slowly floats forward, healing for 1341 Health every 1 second to you and nearby allies. An ally near the globe can activate the Healing Combustion synergy, causing the orb to explode and heal for 6149 Health to nearby allies and restoring 3960 Magicka or Stamina to the activator, whichever maximum is higher.

mist-form.name: Mist Form
mist-form.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka.
Disperse into a dark mist, causing the next 3 projectiles to deal no damage to you for 1 second while you dash forward and reappear at your target location after a short duration. Casting again within 4 seconds costs 33% more Magicka.

morphs.name: Elusive Mist
morphs.note: Grants you Major Expedition and Major Evasion after reappearing.
morphs.desc: Disperse into a dark mist, causing the next 3 projectiles to deal no damage to you for 1 second while you dash forward and reappear at your target location after a short duration. You gain Major Expedition and Major Evasion for 4 seconds after reappearing, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% and reducing damage from area attacks by 20%. Casting again within 4 seconds costs 33% more Magicka.

morphs.name: Blood Mist
morphs.note: Deals damage to enemies around you and heals for a portion of the damage caused for a duration after casting.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds, Area: 5 meters.
Dissolve into a bloody mist, causing the next 3 projectiles to deal no damage to you for 1 second while you dash forward and reappear at your target location after a short duration. Upon activation you drain the blood of those around you for 20 seconds, dealing 1192 Magic Damage every 2 seconds to enemies and healing you for 45% of the damage caused. Casting again within 4 seconds costs 33% more Magicka.

poison-arrow.name: Poison Arrow
poison-arrow.desc: Shoot an arrow coated in Baandari poison at an enemy, dealing 3175 Poison Damage and an additional 9510 Poison Damage over 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Venom Arrow
morphs.note: Interrupts enemies hit if they are casting. Grants Major Brutality after casting. Reduces cost as ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Stamina.
Shoot an arrow coated in Shadowscale poison at an enemy, dealing 3175 Poison Damage and an additional 9530 Poison Damage over 20 seconds. If the enemy hit is casting an ability they are interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for 3 seconds. After casting you gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage for 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Poison Injection
morphs.note: Deals additional damage to low Health enemies.
morphs.desc: Shoot an arrow coated in Baandari poison at an enemy, dealing 3175 Poison Damage and an additional 9530 Poison Damage over 20 seconds. Deals up to 120% more damage to enemies under 50% Health.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.desc: Pounce on an enemy with primal fury, dealing 4369 Bleed Damage and applying the Hemorrhaging status effect. When you are 7 meters or closer this ability becomes Carnage, which causes you to rip into an enemy and deal 4627 Bleed Damage over 12 seconds, dealing up to 450% more damage to enemies under 100% Health.

morphs.name: Brutal Pounce
morphs.note: Deals additional damage to other nearby enemies. Carnage hits in a cone and increases in duration on successive application.
morphs.desc:
Area: 7 meters.
Pounce on an enemy with primal fury, dealing 4513 Bleed Damage and applying the Hemorrhaging status effect to all nearby enemies. When you are 7 meters or closer this skill becomes Brutal Carnage, which rips into all enemies in front of you to deal 4926 Bleed Damage over 12 seconds, dealing up to 450% more damage to enemies under 100% Health. The duration increases by 10 seconds if cast on the same enemy multiple times.

morphs.name: Feral Pounce
morphs.note: You restore Stamina and trigger Fury generation when dealing damage with either form of the ability.
morphs.desc: Pounce on an enemy with primal fury, dealing 4369 Bleed Damage and applying the Hemorrhaging status effect. When you are 7 meters or closer this ability becomes Feral Carnage, which causes you to rip into an enemy and deal 4627 Bleed Damage over 12 seconds, dealing up to 450% more damage to enemies under 100% Health. Dealing damage with either ability restores 200 Stamina and triggers Fury generation.

magicka-detonation.name: Magicka Detonation
magicka-detonation.desc: Curse an enemy with a magical bomb that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing 1190 Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. Each enemy within the bomb's radius increases the damage by 100%, including the original target.

morphs.name: Inevitable Detonation
morphs.note: If the bomb is dispelled or removed early, the explosion is triggered immediately.
morphs.desc: Curse an enemy with a magical bomb that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing 1230 Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. If the bomb is dispelled or removed early, the explosion is triggered immediately. Each enemy within the bomb's radius increases the damage by 100%.

morphs.name: Proximity Detonation
morphs.note: You become the center of the detonation. Removes cast time, but doubles the duration it takes to detonate.
morphs.desc:
Casting Time: Instant, Duration: 8 seconds, Target: Area.
Activate a magical bomb on yourself that explodes after 8 seconds, dealing 1230 Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. Each enemy within the bomb's radius increases the damage by 100%, including the original target.

padomaic-sprint.name: Padomaic Sprint
padomaic-sprint.desc: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% for 6 seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.
padomaic-sprint.desc_max: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% for 12 seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.

panacea.name: Panacea
panacea.desc: Release the rejuvenating energies of your staff to swirl around you, healing you or an ally for 7940 Health every 1 second for 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Life Giver
morphs.note: Also automatically casts Regeneration, Blessing of Protection, and Steadfast Ward.
morphs.desc: Release the rejuvenating energies of your staff to swirl around you, healing you or an ally for 8202 Health every 1 second for 5 seconds. When you activate this ability you automatically cast Regeneration, Blessing of Protection, and Steadfast Ward at no cost. These will update based on which morph of each ability you have taken.

morphs.name: Light's Champion
morphs.note: Any friendly target healed gains Major Force, increasing Critical Damage dealt.
morphs.desc: Release the rejuvenating energies of your staff to swirl around you, healing you or a nearby ally for 7940 Health every 1 second for 5 seconds. Any friendly target you heal gains Major Force for 8 seconds, increasing their Critical Damage by 20%.

natures-grasp.name: Nature's Grasp
natures-grasp.desc: Launch a vine to swing yourself to an ally, healing them for 9522 Health over 10 seconds. You gain 3 Ultimate when this effect completes if you are in combat.

morphs.name: Bursting Vines
morphs.note: Travels faster, heals instantly, and restores more Ultimate.
morphs.desc: Launch a vine to swing yourself to an ally, instantly healing them for 7381 Health. Gain 10 Ultimate when healing an ally under 60% Health while you are in combat. This effect can occur every 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Nature's Embrace
morphs.note: Heals both you and the ally.
morphs.desc: Launch a vine to swing yourself to an ally, healing you and them for 9828 Health over 10 seconds. Gain 3 Ultimate when either of these effects complete while you are in combat.

maturation.name: Maturation
maturation.desc: When you activate a heal on yourself or an ally you grant the target Minor Toughness, increasing their Max Health by 10% for 10 seconds.
maturation.desc_max: When you activate a heal on yourself or an ally you grant the target Minor Toughness, increasing their Max Health by 10% for 20 seconds.

natures-gift.name: Nature's Gift
natures-gift.desc: When you overheal yourself or an ally with a Green Balance ability, you gain 125 Magicka and 125 Stamina, up to once every 1 second.
natures-gift.desc_max: When you overheal yourself or an ally with a Green Balance ability, you gain 250 Magicka and 250 Stamina, up to once every 1 second.

piercing-cold.name: Piercing Cold
piercing-cold.desc: Increases the amount of damage you block by 4% and increases your Frost Damage by 7%.
piercing-cold.desc_max: Increases the amount of damage you block by 8% and increases your Frost Damage by 15%.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.desc: Focus your body and mind into a meditative state, healing for 1500 Health and restoring 1500 Magicka and Stamina every 1 second. You will remain in a meditative state until you toggle this ability off or are interrupted.

morphs.name: Deep Thoughts
morphs.note: Increases the amount of Magicka and Stamina restored.
morphs.desc: Focus your body and mind into a meditative state, healing for 1500 Health and restoring 1900 Magicka and Stamina every 1 second. You will remain in a meditative state until you toggle this ability off or are interrupted.

morphs.name: Introspection
morphs.note: Maintaining the channel increases the amount of Health restored.
morphs.desc: Focus your body and mind into a meditative state, healing for 1800 Health and restoring 1500 Magicka and Stamina every 1 second. Maintaining the channel increases the Health restored by 10% every tick, up to a maximum of 50%. You will remain in a meditative state until you toggle this ability off or are interrupted.

mend-wounds.name: Mend Wounds
mend-wounds.desc: Invoke the Rites of Moawita, replacing your Light and Heavy Attacks with healing abilities that can only be used on allies. Your Light Attacks heal for 2572. Your Heavy Attacks heal for 2287 every 1 second, and restore 1155 Magicka to you for successfully healing.

morphs.name: Mend Spirit
morphs.note: Increases your ally's Physical and Spell Resistance while you heal them.
morphs.desc: Invoke the Rites of Moawita, replacing your Light and Heavy Attacks with healing abilities that only can be used on allies. Your Light Attacks heal for 2656. Your Heavy Attacks heal for 2361 every 1 second, and restore 1155 Magicka to you for successfully healing. After you heal an ally you grant them Major Resolve, increasing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 5 seconds.

morphs.name: Symbiosis
morphs.note: You heal yourself for a percentage of the healing done to the ally.
morphs.desc: Invoke the Rites of Moawita, replacing your Light and Heavy Attacks with healing abilities that can be used on allies. Your Light Attacks heal for 2656. Your Heavy Attacks heal for 2361 every 1 second, and restore 1155 Magicka to you for successfully healing. You heal yourself for 50% of the amount of healing done to the ally.

near-death-experience.name: Near-Death Experience
near-death-experience.desc: While you have a Living Death ability slotted, your Critical Strike Chance with all healing abilities is increased by up to 6% in proportion to the severity of the target's wounds.
near-death-experience.desc_max: While you have a Living Death ability slotted, your Critical Strike Chance with all healing abilities is increased by up to 12% in proportion to the severity of the target's wounds.

malacaths-vengeance.name: Malacath's Vengeance
malacaths-vengeance.desc: Swing Volendrung in a mighty downward blow, dealing 12075 Physical Damage to a single target.

pariahs-resolve.name: Pariah's Resolve
pariahs-resolve.desc: Channel Volendrung's power to grant you and nearby group members Major Brutality, Major Endurance, and Major Expedition for 20 seconds, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%, your Stamina Recovery by 30%, and your Movement Speed by 30%. Activating this ability removes all snares and immobilizations from you and grants immunity to them for 4 seconds.

mesmerize.name: Mesmerize
mesmerize.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka.
Subdue enemies in front of you with your baleful gaze, stunning them for 5 seconds if they are facing your direction. This stun cannot be blocked.

morphs.name: Hypnosis
morphs.note: Affects all enemies around you.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3510 Magicka, Area: 7 meters, Target: Area.
Subdue enemies around you with your baleful gaze, stunning them for 5 seconds if they are facing your direction. This stun cannot be blocked.

morphs.name: Stupefy
morphs.note: Enemies are snared after the stun ends.
morphs.desc: Subdue enemies in front of you with your baleful gaze, stunning them for 5 seconds if they are facing your direction. This stun cannot be blocked. After the stun ends they remain stupefied, reducing their Movement Speed by 53% for 5 seconds.

preemptive-power.name: Preemptive Power
preemptive-power.desc: Start each Scrying attempt with an additional row of facets already claimed.

mountain-giant.name: Mountain Giant
mountain-giant.desc: WITH AN EARTHEN HEART ABILITY SLOTTED The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows. Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target.
mountain-giant.desc_max: WITH AN EARTHEN HEART ABILITY SLOTTED The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows. Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores 1430 Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every 0.5 seconds.

malevolent-promise.name: Malevolent Promise
malevolent-promise.desc: Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies. Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for 6 seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning. This effect can occur once every 2 seconds.

master-of-the-chase.name: Master of the Chase
master-of-the-chase.desc: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Give chase, hunter. Become pursuit unrelenting. Increases your Movement Speed by 15%.
master-of-the-chase.desc_max: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Give chase, hunter. Become pursuit unrelenting. Increases your Movement Speed by 30%. Increases the Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by 50%.
master-of-the-chase.img_note: The wiki has no icon for this passive; the picture is the Werewolf line's Werewolf Transformation.

nocturnal-inspiration.name: Nocturnal Inspiration
nocturnal-inspiration.desc: The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation. Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate 2 Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every 0.3 seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.

nothing-wasted.name: Nothing Wasted
nothing-wasted.desc: As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted. Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for 12 seconds, which increases your Max Health by 2% and Weapon and Spell Damage by 2% per stack, up to 10 times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

pound-of-flesh.name: Pound of Flesh
pound-of-flesh.desc: Knock upon death's door and demand your due. When you take damage you have a 10% chance to heal 1600 Health and restore 5% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by 1% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

radial-sweep.name: Radial Sweep
radial-sweep.desc: Swing your Aedric spear around with holy vengeance, dealing 6351 Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and an additional 3175 Magic Damage every 2 seconds for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Everlasting Sweep
morphs.note: Deals Physical Damage and increases the duration, which further increases for each enemy hit.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 10 seconds.
Swing your Aedric spear around with holy vengeance, dealing 6561 Physical Damage to all nearby enemies and an additional 3175 Physical Damage every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. The duration is extended by 2 seconds for each enemy hit.

morphs.name: Crescent Sweep
morphs.note: Deals additional damage to enemies in front of you.
morphs.desc: Swing your Aedric spear around with holy vengeance, dealing 6561 Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and an additional 3175 Magic Damage every 2 seconds for 6 seconds. Enemies in your path will be hit for 60% more damage.

puncturing-strikes.name: Puncturing Strikes
puncturing-strikes.desc: Launch a relentless assault, striking up to 6 enemies in front of you three times with your Aedric spear. The spear deals 2433 Magic Damage per strike and reduces enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 0.5 seconds.

morphs.name: Biting Jabs
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Physical Damage. Grants you Major Brutality after casting and has a higher chance of applying the Sundered status effect.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Stamina.
Launch a relentless assault, striking up to 6 enemies in front of you three times with your Aedric spear. The spear deals 2514 Physical Damage per strike and reduces enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 0.5 seconds. Each strike has a 10% chance of applying the Sundered status effect. Activating this ability grants you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Puncturing Sweep
morphs.note: You heal for a percentage of the damage done.
morphs.desc: Launch a relentless assault, striking up to 6 enemies in front of you three times with your Aedric spear. The spear deals 2514 Magic Damage per strike and reduces enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 0.5 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage done with this ability.

pressure-points.name: Pressure Points
pressure-points.desc: Increases your Critical Chance rating by 219 for each Nightblade ability slotted, increasing your chance to critically strike by 1% per ability.
pressure-points.desc_max: Increases your Critical Chance rating by 438 for each Nightblade ability slotted, increasing your chance to critically strike by 2% per ability.

reach.name: Reach
reach.desc: Increases the range of long-range abilities by 2 meters while near a keep or outpost. Any ability with a range greater than 28 meters is affected.
reach.desc_max: Increases the range of long-range abilities by 5 meters while near a keep or outpost. Any ability with a range greater than 28 meters is affected.

rapid-maneuver.name: Rapid Maneuver
rapid-maneuver.desc: Mobilize your forces, granting Major Expedition to you and your group, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% for 8 seconds.

morphs.name: Retreating Maneuver
morphs.note: Attacks made against you from behind deal less damage while this effect persists.
morphs.desc: Mobilize your forces, granting Major Expedition to you and your group, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% for 8 seconds. Attacks from behind deal 15% less damage while this effect persists.

morphs.name: Charging Maneuver
morphs.note: Also grants Minor Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed further. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 6156 Stamina.
Mobilize your forces, granting Major and Minor Expedition to you and your group, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% and 15% respectively, for 8 seconds.

rebate.name: Rebate
rebate.desc: You restore 185 Magicka or Stamina when one of your non-Ultimate Daedric Summoning abilities end. The resource returned is dictated by the ability's cost.
rebate.desc_max: You restore 371 Magicka or Stamina when one of your non-Ultimate Daedric Summoning abilities end. The resource returned is dictated by the ability's cost.

rune-prison.name: Rune Prison
rune-prison.desc:
Cost: 3510 Magicka.
Imprison an enemy in a constricting sphere of dark magic. After a short duration they are stunned for 3 seconds. This stun cannot be blocked.

morphs.name: Rune Cage
morphs.note: Deals damage when effect completes.
morphs.desc: Imprison an enemy in a constricting sphere of dark magic. After a short duration they are stunned for 3 seconds. Deals 4921 Magic Damage if the stun lasts the full duration. This stun cannot be blocked.

morphs.name: Defensive Rune
morphs.note: Cast spell on self, stunning the next enemy who attacks you.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 120 seconds, Target: Self.
Place a rune of protection on yourself for 2 minutes. While active, the next enemy to attack you is imprisoned in a constricting sphere of dark magic, stunning them after a short delay for 3 seconds. This stun cannot be blocked.

prism.name: Prism
prism.desc: Casting a Dawn's Wrath ability while in combat generates 2 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 6 seconds.
prism.desc_max: Casting a Dawn's Wrath ability while in combat generates 3 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 6 seconds.

restoring-spirit.name: Restoring Spirit
restoring-spirit.desc: Reduces the Health, Magicka, Stamina, and Ultimate costs of your abilities by 2%.
restoring-spirit.desc_max: Reduces the Health, Magicka, Stamina, and Ultimate costs of your abilities by 5%.

ruffian.name: Ruffian
ruffian.desc: WHILE USING DUAL WIELDING ATTACKS Gives you an 8% damage bonus when attacking stunned, immobilized, or silenced enemies.
ruffian.desc_max: WHILE USING DUAL WIELDING ATTACKS Gives you an 15% damage bonus when attacking stunned, immobilized, or silenced enemies.

resolve.name: Resolve
resolve.desc: Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by 114 for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.
resolve.desc_max: Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by 343 for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

rapid-mending.name: Rapid Mending
rapid-mending.desc: Increases your healing received by 1% for every 2 pieces of Heavy Armor worn.
rapid-mending.desc_max: Increases your healing received by 1% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

prodigy.name: Prodigy
prodigy.desc: Increases your Weapon Critical and Spell Critical rating by 109 for each piece of Light Armor equipped.
prodigy.desc_max: Increases your Weapon Critical and Spell Critical rating by 219 for each piece of Light Armor equipped.

puncture.name: Puncture
puncture.desc: Thrust your weapon with disciplined precision at an enemy, dealing 3175 Physical Damage and taunting them to attack you for 15 seconds. Also inflicts Major Breach on the enemy, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 15 seconds.

morphs.name: Ransack
morphs.note: You also gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken.
morphs.desc: Thrust your weapon with disciplined precision at an enemy, dealing 3279 Physical Damage and taunting them to attack you for 15 seconds. Also inflicts Major Breach on the enemy, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 15 seconds. You also gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by 5% for 15 seconds.

morphs.name: Pierce Armor
morphs.note: Also inflicts Minor Breach, further reducing the enemy's Resistances.
morphs.desc: Thrust your weapon with disciplined precision at an enemy, dealing 3279 Physical Damage and taunting them to attack you for 15 seconds. Also inflicts Minor Breach and Major Breach on the enemy, reducing their Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 2974 and 5948 for 15 seconds.

restoration-expert.name: Restoration Expert
restoration-expert.desc: WITH RESTORATION STAFF EQUIPPED Increases your healing by 8% on allies under 30% Health.
restoration-expert.desc_max: WITH RESTORATION STAFF EQUIPPED Increases your healing by 15% on allies under 30% Health.

restoration-master.name: Restoration Master
restoration-master.desc: WITH RESTORATION STAFF EQUIPPED Increases healing with Restoration Staff spells by 3%.
restoration-master.desc_max: WITH RESTORATION STAFF EQUIPPED Increases healing with Restoration Staff spells by 5%.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.desc: Share your staff's life-giving energy, healing you or a nearby ally for 9522 Health over 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Rapid Regeneration
morphs.note: The healing happens faster over a shorter duration and increases in healing on low Health targets.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 5 seconds.
Share your staff's life-giving energy, healing you or a nearby ally for 9834 Health over 5 seconds. The healing increases by up to 50% more on targets under 100% Health.

morphs.name: Radiating Regeneration
morphs.note: Heals two additional targets.
morphs.desc: Share your staff's life-giving energy, healing you or up to 3 nearby allies for 9834 over 10 seconds.

sacred-ground.name: Sacred Ground
sacred-ground.desc: While standing in your own Cleansing Ritual, Rune Focus, or Rite of Passage areas of effect and for up to 2 seconds after leaving them you gain Minor Mending, increasing your healing done by 8%. Also increases the amount of damage you can block by 10% for the duration.
sacred-ground.desc_max: While standing in your own Cleansing Ritual, Rune Focus, or Rite of Passage area effects and for up to 4 seconds after leaving them you gain Minor Mending, increasing your healing done by 8%. Also increases the amount of damage you can block by 10% for the duration.

rite-of-passage.name: Rite of Passage
rite-of-passage.desc: Channel the grace of the gods, healing you and nearby allies for 7623 Health every 1 second for 4 seconds. You cannot move while channeling, but you gain immunity to all disabling effects.

morphs.name: Remembrance
morphs.note: Gain Major Protection after casting, reducing your damage taken.
morphs.desc: Channel the grace of the gods, healing you and nearby allies for 7622 Health every 1 second for 4 seconds. Gain Major Protection, reducing damage you take by 10% for 10 seconds. You cannot move while channeling, but you gain immunity to all disabling effects.

morphs.name: Practiced Incantation
morphs.note: Increases the duration of the channel and allows you move at a reduced rate while channeling.
morphs.desc:
Channel Time: 8 seconds, Duration: 8 seconds.
Channel the grace of the gods, healing you and nearby allies for 7622 Health every 1 second for 8 seconds. While channeling this ability, you gain immunity to all disabling effects.

rushed-ceremony.name: Rushed Ceremony
rushed-ceremony.desc: Beacon your inner light, healing yourself or a wounded ally in front of you for 9529 Health.

morphs.name: Honor the Dead
morphs.note: Refunds part of the ability's cost when used to heal an injured target.
morphs.desc: Beacon your inner light, healing yourself or a wounded ally in front of you for 9528 Health. Healing anyone who is below 75% Health restores 18% of the ability's cost every 2 seconds over 6 seconds as Magicka.

morphs.name: Breath of Life
morphs.note: Heals a second target for one third the amount.
morphs.desc: Beacon your inner light, healing yourself or a wounded ally in front of you for 9528 Health. Also heals one other injured target for 3279 Health.

restoring-aura.name: Restoring Aura
restoring-aura.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Champion the cause of divine glory to apply Minor Endurance, Minor Fortitude, and Minor Intellect to nearby group members for 20 seconds, increasing Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 15%. While slotted on either bar you gain these effects.

morphs.name: Radiant Aura
morphs.note: Increases the radius and duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 60 seconds, Radius: 28 meters.
Champion the cause of divine glory to apply Minor Endurance, Minor Fortitude, and Minor Intellect to you and nearby group members for 1 minute, increasing your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 15%. While slotted on either bar you gain these effects.

morphs.name: Repentance
morphs.note: No longer applies buffs to allies, instead you consume corpses to restore Health and Stamina.
morphs.desc: Consecrate the souls of the fallen, healing you and your allies for 3000 Health and restoring 3000 Stamina to you for each corpse nearby. While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Fortitude, Minor Endurance, and Minor Intellect, increasing your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by 15%.

rune-focus.name: Rune Focus
rune-focus.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Create a rune of celestial protection and gain Major Resolve for 20 seconds, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948. While the rune is active you heal for 318 Health every 1 second, scaling off your Max Health. Standing within the rune increases the healing done by 200%.

morphs.name: Channeled Focus
morphs.note: Increases the duration and causes you to restore Magicka over the duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 25 seconds.
Create a rune of celestial protection and gain Major Resolve for 25 seconds, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948. You also recover 242 Magicka every 1 second over the duration. While the rune is active you heal for 320 Health every 1 second, scaling off your Max Health. Standing within the rune increases the healing done by 200%.

morphs.name: Restoring Focus
morphs.note: Increases the healing done and causes you to restore Stamina over the duration.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 918 Stamina.
Create a rune of celestial protection and gain Major Resolve for 20 seconds, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by 5948. You also recover 242 Stamina every 1 second over the duration. While the rune is active you heal for 411 Health every 1 second, scaling off your Max Health. Standing within the rune increases the healing done by 200%.

refreshing-shadows.name: Refreshing Shadows
refreshing-shadows.desc: Increases your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by 7%.
refreshing-shadows.desc_max: Increases your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by 15%.

purge.name: Purge
purge.desc:
Cost: 7830 Magicka.
Cleanse yourself and your group, removing up to 3 negative effects immediately.

morphs.name: Efficient Purge
morphs.note: Reduces the cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 5400 Magicka.
Cleanse yourself and your group, removing up to 3 negative effects immediately.

morphs.name: Cleanse
morphs.note: If a negative effect is removed, the target is healed.
morphs.desc: Cleanse yourself and your group, removing 3 negative effects immediately. For every negative effect removed, the target is healed for 5% of their Max Health.

reverse-slash.name: Reverse Slash
reverse-slash.desc: Shift your grip and strike an enemy down, dealing 3175 Physical Damage. Deals up to 300% more damage to enemies with less than 50% Health.

morphs.name: Reverse Slice
morphs.note: Now deals its damage in an area around the initial target.
morphs.desc:
Area: 5 meters.
Shift your grip and unleash a devastating slice, dealing 3279 Physical Damage to your foe and all nearby enemies. Deals up to 300% more damage to enemies with less than 50% Health.

morphs.name: Executioner
morphs.note: Converts to Bleed Damage and reduces the cost. Increases the amount of bonus damage dealt to low health targets.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2160 Stamina.
Shift your grip and cut deep, dealing 3175 Bleed Damage to your foe. Deals up to 400% more damage to enemies with less than 50% Health.

radiant-destruction.name: Radiant Destruction
radiant-destruction.desc: Burn an enemy with a ray of holy fire, dealing 19806 Magic Damage over 3.8 seconds. Deals up to 500% more damage to enemies below 33% Health. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Radiant Glory
morphs.note: Reduces the cost and you heal for a percentage of the damage inflicted.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 648 Magicka / 1s.
Burn an enemy with a ray of holy fire, dealing 20460 Magic Damage over 3.8 seconds. Deals up to 500% more damage to enemies below 33% Health. You heal for 15% of the damage inflicted. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Radiant Oppression
morphs.note: The bonus damage against low health targets now starts at higher health.
morphs.desc: Burn an enemy with a ray of holy fire, dealing 20460 Magic Damage over 3.8 seconds. Deals up to 500% more damage to enemies below 40% Health. This ability is considered direct damage.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.desc: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Reduces the Stamina cost of Bow abilities by 7%.
ranger.desc_max: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Reduces the Stamina cost of Bow abilities by 15%.

roar.name: Roar
roar.desc:
Duration: 4 seconds.
Roar with bloodlust to fear nearby enemies for 4 seconds and setting them Off Balance for 7 seconds. Grants you a stack of Blood Hunger, which empowers Gnash and Claw Fury. Up to 12 nearby allies can activate the Feeding Frenzy synergy, which grants 6% damage done and Minor Force for 30 seconds, increasing Critical Damage by 10%. While slotted you gain Major Savagery.

morphs.name: Ferocious Roar
morphs.note: Grants you and allies Major Courage, you can use your own synergy, and grants two stacks of Blood Hunger.
morphs.desc: Roar with bloodlust to fear nearby enemies for 4 seconds and setting them Off Balance for 7 seconds. Grants two stacks of Blood Hunger, which empowers Gnash and Claw Fury. You and up to 11 nearby allies gain Major Courage for 20 seconds and can activate the Feeding Frenzy synergy, which grants 6% damage done and Minor Force for 30 seconds. While slotted you gain Major Savagery.

morphs.name: Deafening Roar
morphs.note: Adds Major Cowardice and Maim to enemies. Converts the slot bonuses to Major Evasion and Minor Protection. Selecting this morph enhances Gnash to taunt.
morphs.desc: Roar with bloodlust to fear nearby enemies for 4 seconds, setting them Off Balance for 7 seconds, and applying Major Cowardice and Maim for 15 seconds. Grants you a stack of Blood Hunger. Up to 12 nearby allies can activate the Feeding Frenzy synergy, which grants 6% damage done and Minor Force for 30 seconds. While slotted you gain Major Evasion and Minor Protection. Selecting this morph causes your Gnash to taunt enemies if cast while Bracing.

revealing-flare.name: Revealing Flare
revealing-flare.desc:
Cost: 5130 Magicka.
Launch a blinding flare, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies in the target area for 5 seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for 4 seconds. While slotted you gain Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Lingering Flare
morphs.note: The flare lasts longer.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 10 seconds.
Launch a blinding flare, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies in the target area for 10 seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for 4 seconds. While slotted you gain Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Blinding Flare
morphs.note: Exposed enemies are also stunned.
morphs.desc: Launch a blinding flare, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies in the target area for 5 seconds. Exposed enemies are stunned for 4 seconds, and cannot return to stealth or invisibility for 4 seconds. While slotted you gain Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

rapid-fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid-fire.desc: Unleash a barrage of arrows at an enemy, dealing 47619 Physical Damage over 4 seconds. You can move at full speed and are immune to all disabling effects while channeling this attack. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Toxic Barrage
morphs.note: Deals Poison Damage. Dealing damage with the attack injects them with poison, dealing additional damage over time.
morphs.desc: Unleash a barrage of arrows at an enemy, dealing 47610 Poison Damage over 4 seconds. After dealing damage you poison the enemy, dealing an additional 27330 Poison Damage over 8 seconds after a 1 second delay. You can move at full speed and are immune to all disabling effects while channeling this attack. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Ballista
morphs.note: Create a turret to channel the attack for you, but for less damage.
morphs.desc:
Casting Time: Instant, Channel Time: , Duration: 5 seconds, Range: 25 meters.
Create a turret to unleash a barrage of arrows at an enemy, dealing 42562 Physical Damage over 5 seconds.

savage-beast.name: Savage Beast
savage-beast.desc: Casting an Animal Companions ability while are in combat generates 2 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 8 seconds.
savage-beast.desc_max: Casting an Animal Companions ability while are in combat generates 4 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 8 seconds.

revitalize.name: Revitalize
revitalize.desc: Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by 2% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.
revitalize.desc_max: Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by 4% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

render-flesh.name: Render Flesh
render-flesh.desc: Sacrifice your own power to repair damaged flesh, healing you or an ally in front of you for 9529 Health but applying Minor Defile to yourself for 4 seconds, reducing your healing received and damage shield strength by 6%.

morphs.name: Resistant Flesh
morphs.note: Grant resistances to the target equal to half the amount healed.
morphs.desc: Sacrifice your own power to repair damaged flesh, healing you or an ally in front of you for 9842 Health but applying Minor Defile to yourself for 4 seconds, reducing your healing received and damage shield strength by 6%. You grant the target Spell and Physical Resistance equal to half the amount healed for 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Blood Sacrifice
morphs.note: Consumes a corpse to heal a second target.
morphs.desc: Sacrifice your own power to repair damaged flesh, healing you or an ally in front of you for 9842 Health but applying Minor Defile to yourself for 4 seconds, reducing your healing received and damage shield strength by 6%. Consumes a corpse near you when cast to heal a second target.

restoring-tether.name: Restoring Tether
restoring-tether.desc: Siphon the last remnants of life from a corpse, healing for 15228 Health over 12 seconds to yourself and all allies between you and the corpse. While slotted, your healing done is increased by 3%.

morphs.name: Braided Tether
morphs.note: Also heals allies in a radius around you.
morphs.desc:
Area: 5 meters.
Siphon the last remnants of life from a corpse, healing for 15714 Health over 12 seconds to yourself, all allies around you, and all allies between you and the corpse. While slotted, your healing done is increased by 3%.

morphs.name: Mortal Coil
morphs.note: Restores Magicka and Stamina while siphoning the corpse.
morphs.desc: Siphon the last remnants of life from a corpse, healing for 15228 Health over 12 seconds to yourself and all allies between you and the corpse. You also restore 170 Magicka and Stamina every 2 seconds while siphoning the corpse. While slotted, your healing done is increased by 3%.

reanimate.name: Reanimate
reanimate.desc:
Cost: 335 Ultimate.
Bring your allies back from the brink of death, resurrecting up to 3 allies at the target location.

morphs.name: Renewing Animation
morphs.note: You restore Magicka and Stamina for each ally you resurrect.
morphs.desc: Bring your allies back from the brink of death, resurrecting up to 3 allies at the target location. You restore 5300 Magicka and Stamina for each ally you successfully resurrect.

morphs.name: Animate Blastbones
morphs.note: You consume other corpses in the area and summon Blastbones.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 320 Ultimate.
Bring your allies back from the brink of death, resurrecting up to 3 allies at the target location. You consume up to 3 other corpses in the area and summon a Blighted Blastbones for each corpse consumed.

reusable-parts.name: Reusable Parts
reusable-parts.desc: When your Sacrificial Bones, Skeletal Mage, or Spirit Mender dies, the cost of your next Sacrificial Bones, Skeletal Mage, or Spirit Mender is reduced by 33%.
reusable-parts.desc_max: When your Sacrificial Bones, Skeletal Mage, or Spirit Mender dies, the cost of your next Sacrificial Bones, Skeletal Mage, or Spirit Mender is reduced by 66%.

rapid-rot.name: Rapid Rot
rapid-rot.desc: Increases your damage done with damage over time effects by 5%.
rapid-rot.desc_max: Increases your damage done with damage over time effects by 10%.

ruinous-cyclone.name: Ruinous Cyclone
ruinous-cyclone.desc: Turn into a living cyclone, dealing 7875 Physical Damage every 0.5 seconds for 7 seconds in an 8 meter radius, while pulling all enemies within 15 meters closer to you.

rourkens-rebuke.name: Rourken's Rebuke
rourkens-rebuke.desc: Batter foes in an arc in front of you, dealing 9055 Physical Damage, knocking enemies back 4 meters, and stunning them for 4 seconds.

runeblades.name: Runeblades
runeblades.desc: Cost Determined by Highest Max Resource Craft a series of Apocryphal runes before launching them at a foe, dealing 1905 Magic Damage three times and generating Crux. This ability deals 3% increased damage for each active Crux when cast.

morphs.name: Writhing Runeblades
morphs.note: Has increased Critical Chance for each active Crux.
morphs.desc: Cost Determined by Highest Max Resource Craft a series of Apocryphal runes before launching them at a foe, dealing 1967 Magic Damage three times and generating Crux. This ability gains between 1095 and 2191 Weapon Critical and Spell Critical rating and deals 3% increased damage for each active Crux when cast.

morphs.name: Escalating Runeblades
morphs.note: Deals increased damage and the last rune deals damage in an area.
morphs.desc: Cost Determined by Highest Max Resource Craft a series of Apocryphal runes before launching them at a foe, dealing 1905 Magic Damage, 2095 Magic Damage, and 2511 Magic Damage and generating Crux. The last rune explodes, dealing damage to all enemies within 8 meters of the target. This ability deals 3% increased damage for each active Crux when cast.

psychic-lesion.name: Psychic Lesion
psychic-lesion.desc: With a Herald of the Tome Ability Slotted Your attacks wound the mind with heretical knowledge, increasing damage dealt by Status Effects by 7% and Status Effect Chance by 27%.
psychic-lesion.desc_max: With a Herald of the Tome Ability Slotted Your attacks wound the mind with heretical knowledge, increasing damage dealt by Status Effects by 15% and Status Effect Chance by 55%.

runic-jolt.name: Runic Jolt
runic-jolt.desc: Craft a defensive Apocryphal rune that deals 3175 Magic Damage and applies Minor Maim for 15 seconds, reducing their damage done by 5%. The rune also taunts for 15 seconds if it would not cause taunt immunity, and generates Crux. While slotted, damage taken is reduced by 2% per active Crux.

morphs.name: Runic Sunder
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Physical Damage. Reduce your target's Armor and gain Armor.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 1377 Stamina.
Craft a defensive Apocryphal rune that deals 3175 Physical Damage. The rune steals 2200 Armor and applies Minor Maim for 15 seconds, reducing their damage done by 5%. The rune also taunts for 15 seconds if it would not cause taunt immunity, and generates Crux. While slotted, damage taken is reduced by 2% per active Crux.

morphs.name: Runic Embrace
morphs.note: Heal yourself and apply Minor Lifesteal.
morphs.desc: Craft a rune that deals 3175 Magic Damage and heals you for 1706 Health, scaling off your Max Health. You apply Minor Maim and Minor Lifesteal for 15 seconds, reducing enemy damage done by 5%, and healing you and your allies for 600 Health every 1 second when damaging them. The rune taunts for 15 seconds if it would not cause taunt immunity, and generates Crux. While slotted, damage taken is reduced by 2% per active Crux.

runespite-ward.name: Runespite Ward
runespite-ward.desc: Like the rune knights of old, formulate a shield that absorbs 4800 damage for 6 seconds, scaling off your Max Health. The first time you take direct damage, the shield retaliates and deals 1624 Magic Damage to the attacker, scaling off your Armor. Consume Crux to heal yourself for 1600 Health, scaling off your Max Health, per Crux spent.

morphs.name: Spiteward of the Lucid Mind
morphs.note: Consume Crux to refund cost.
morphs.desc: Like the rune knights of old, formulate a shield that absorbs 4800 damage for 6 seconds, scaling off your Max Health. The first time you take direct damage, the shield retaliates and deals 1625 Magic Damage to the attacker, scaling off your Armor. Consume Crux to heal yourself 1600 Health, scaling off your Max Health, and refund 30% of Spiteward of the Lucid Mind cost per Crux spent.

morphs.name: Impervious Runeward
morphs.note: Drastically increases the size of the damage shield for the first second but reduces the size of the shield after.
morphs.desc: Like the rune knights of old, formulate a shield that absorbs 9916 damage for 1 second, and then 2203 damage for 5 seconds if the first shield persists. Both shields scale off your Max Health. The first time you take direct damage, the shield retaliates and deals 1625 Magic Damage to the attacker, scaling off your Armor. Consume Crux to heal yourself for 1600 Health, scaling off your Max Health, per Crux spent.

runic-defense.name: Runic Defense
runic-defense.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Cast forth a complex rune granting you and your group members Minor Resolve for 20 seconds, increasing your Armor by 2974. You gain Minor Protection for 20 seconds, reducing your damage taken by 5%. The first time you are damaged while below 50% Health, the Minor Protection is consumed to heal you for 4800 Health, scaling off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Runeguard of Still Waters
morphs.note: Immobilizes nearby enemies.
morphs.desc: Cast forth a complex rune granting you and your group members Minor Resolve for 20 seconds, increasing your Armor by 2974. After 1 second, the spellweave immobilizes enemies within 7 meters for 3 seconds. You gain Minor Protection for 20 seconds, reducing your damage taken by 5%. The first time you are damaged while below 50% Health, the Minor Protection is consumed to heal you for 4800 Health, scaling off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Runeguard of Freedom
morphs.note: Coverts a portion of the healing into Armor and Crowd Control Immunity.
morphs.desc: Cast forth a complex rune granting you and your group members Minor Resolve for 20 seconds, increasing your Armor by 2974. You gain Minor Protection for 20 seconds, reducing your damage taken by 5%. The first time you are damaged while below 50% Health, Minor Protection is consumed to heal you for 2400 Health, scaling off your Max Health, and gain 3300 Armor and Crowd Control Immunity for 7 seconds. This immunity can occur once every 30 seconds.

rune-of-eldritch-horror.name: Rune of Eldritch Horror
rune-of-eldritch-horror.desc: Etch an incomprehensible rune on your enemy's mind, paralyzing them in fear after a 1 second delay, stunning them for 4 seconds. This terror applies Minor Vulnerability for 10 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 5%. If used against a monster, the paralyze lasts for 8 seconds. This ability cannot be dodged.

morphs.name: Rune of Uncanny Adoration
morphs.note: Charms the target and causes them to move towards you.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3510 Magicka.
Etch a blasphemous rune on your enemy's mind, charming them after a 1 second delay for 4 seconds. This eldritch attraction causes them to move towards the player and applies Minor Vulnerability for 10 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 5%. If used against a monster, the charm lasts for 8 seconds. This ability cannot be dodged.

morphs.name: Rune of the Colorless Pool
morphs.note: Applies Minor Brittle to the target.
morphs.desc: Etch an amorphous rune on your enemy's mind, paralyzing them in fear after a 1 second delay, stunning them for 4 seconds. This undimensioned phenomenon applies Minor Vulnerability and Minor Brittle for 20 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 5% and their Critical Damage taken by 10%. If used against a monster, the paralyze lasts for 8 seconds. This ability cannot be dodged.

runemend.name: Runemend
runemend.desc: Cost determined by highest max resource Craft a series of precise Apocryphal runes, then propel them at yourself or an ally in front of you. The runes heal for 3175 Health three times and generate Crux. Each active Crux reduces the cost of this ability by 3%.

morphs.name: Evolving Runemend
morphs.note: Heals for an additional amount over time.
morphs.desc: Cost determined by highest max resource Craft a series of adaptive Apocryphal runes, then propel them at yourself or an ally in front of you. The runes heal for 3175 Health three times, an additional 3570 Health over 6 seconds, and generate Crux. Each active Crux reduces the cost of this ability by 3%.

morphs.name: Audacious Runemend
morphs.note: Healing low Health targets grants them Ultimate.
morphs.desc: Cost determined by highest max resource Craft a series of virtuous Apocryphal runes, then propel them at yourself or an ally in front of you. The runes heal for 3279 Health three times and generate Crux. Healing a target under 50% Health grants them Minor Heroism for 6 seconds, generating 1 Ultimate every 1.5 seconds. Each active Crux reduces the cost of this ability by 3%.

remedy-cascade.name: Remedy Cascade
remedy-cascade.desc: Cost determined by highest max resource Channel the abyssal sea to coalesce a beam of restorative energy. The beam heals you and your allies in its path for 30966 Health over 4.5 seconds. Consume Crux to also restore 728 Magicka and Stamina per Crux spent to your allies over 4.5 seconds.

morphs.name: Cascading Fortune
morphs.note: Heals for more on low Health targets.
morphs.desc: Cost determined by highest max resource Channel the abyssal sea to coalesce a beam that heals you and your allies in its path for 31980 Health over 4.5 seconds. The beam heals for up to 50% more in proportion to the severity of the target's wounds as you reweave fate itself. Consume Crux to also restore 728 Magicka and Stamina per Crux spent to your allies over 4.5 seconds.

morphs.name: Curative Surge
morphs.note: The beam gradually heals for more the longer you channel it.
morphs.desc: Cost determined by highest max resource Channel the abyssal sea to coalesce a beam that heals you and your allies in its path for 31980 Health over 4.5 seconds. The beam gradually grows stronger the longer you channel it, healing for up to 192% more at the end of its duration. Consume Crux to also restore 728 Magicka and Stamina per Crux spent to your allies over 4.5 seconds.

sacrificial-bones.name: Sacrificial Bones
sacrificial-bones.desc:
Duration: 10 seconds.
Summon a skeleton from the ground after 2.5 seconds. The skeleton leaps to you, sacrificing the fallen soul within and enhancing your necromantic energies for 10 seconds, increasing your damage done with Necromancer abilities and damage over time effects by 15%. Creates a corpse on death if you are in combat.

morphs.name: Blighted Blastbones
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability that deals Disease Damage to enemies instead of empowering you. Applies Major Defile and the Diseased status effect to enemies hit.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 1836 Stamina, Duration: 8 seconds, Area: 6 meters, Range: 28 meters, Target: Enemy.
Summon a decaying skeleton from the ground after 2.5 seconds. The skeleton runs after the target and explodes when it gets close to them, dealing 9842 Disease Damage to all enemies nearby and applying the Diseased status effect and Major Defile to them for 4 seconds, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by 12%. Creates a corpse on death.

morphs.name: Grave Lord's Sacrifice
morphs.note: Increases the duration. While active, your third Flame Skull deals damage in an area.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Summon a skeleton from the ground after 2.5 seconds. The skeleton leaps to you, sacrificing the fallen soul within and mastering your necromantic energies for 20 seconds, increasing your damage done with Necromancer abilities and damage over time effects by 15%. While active, your third cast of Flame Skull damages in an 6 meter area. Creates a corpse on death if you are in combat.

rending-claws.name: Rending Claws
rending-claws.desc: Shred up to 6 enemies in front of you with wild abandon, dealing 5461 Physical Damage and an additional 10895 Bleed Damage over 10 seconds. Reduced to 6537 Bleed Damage over 6 seconds against players. The initial hit has a 15% chance of applying Sundered, while the damage over time has a 5% chance of applying Hemorrhaging.

morphs.name: Claw Fury
morphs.note: Converts into an area direct damage channeled attack. Heals you, generates Fury and Blood Hunger, and increases in damage based on Blood Hunger stacks.
morphs.desc:
Casting Time: , Channel Time: 4.7 seconds, Cost: 420 Stamina / 1s, Target: Area.
Shred up to 6 enemies in front of you with furious intent, dealing 60073 Physical Damage in a channeled attack over 4.7 seconds. Dealing damage with this skill heals you for 1674 Health, based on your Max Health, generates 15 Fury, and a stack of Blood Hunger. These effects can occur once per second. Claw Fury deals 25% more damage per stack of Blood Hunger, consumes all stacks when ending, and is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Bloodclaws
morphs.note: The initial hit heals for a portion of the damage caused, while the damage over time heals based off your Max Health.
morphs.desc: Shred up to 6 enemies in front of you with blood soaked claws, dealing 5641 Physical Damage and an additional 10915 Bleed Damage over 10 seconds. Reduced to 6549 Bleed Damage over 6 seconds against players. You heal for 40% of the initial damage and heal for 1022 Health with the damage over time, based off your Max Health. The initial hit grants a stack of Blood Hunger per enemy hit and has a 15% chance of applying Sundered, while the bleed has a 5% chance of applying Hemorrhaging.

resolute-defense.name: Resolute Defense
resolute-defense.desc: You are as unyielding as a mountain. Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by 6%, up to 5 times. Blocking damage has a 20% chance to restore 500 Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.

soul-trap.name: Soul Trap
soul-trap.desc: Lay claim to an enemy's soul, dealing 12683 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. Fills an empty Soul Gem if an affected enemy dies.

morphs.name: Soul Splitting Trap
morphs.note: Affects additional enemies near your initial target, but for a shorter duration. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Magicka, Duration: 10 seconds, Area: 8 meters.
Lay claim to enemy souls, dealing 6342 Magic Damage to your target and any other nearby enemies over 10 seconds. Fills an empty Soul Gem if an affected enemy dies.

morphs.name: Consuming Trap
morphs.note: Also restore Health, Magicka, and Stamina if enemy dies while affected.
morphs.desc: Lay claim to an enemy's soul, dealing 11330 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. If an affected enemy dies, you fill an empty Soul Gem, heal for 3115 Health, and restore 2578 Magicka and 6000 Stamina. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina.

spear-wall.name: Spear Wall
spear-wall.desc: WHEN ACTIVATING AN AEDRIC SPEAR ABILITY Gain Minor Berserk and Minor Protection for 3 seconds, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by 5%.
spear-wall.desc_max: WHEN ACTIVATING AN AEDRIC SPEAR ABILITY Gain Minor Berserk and Minor Protection for 6 seconds, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by 5%.

spear-shards.name: Spear Shards
spear-shards.desc: Send your spear into the heavens to bring down a shower of divine wrath, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to enemies in the area and an additional 450 Magic Damage every 1 second for 10 seconds. An ally near the spear can activate the Blessed Shards synergy, restoring 3960 Magicka or Stamina, whichever maximum is higher.

morphs.name: Luminous Shards
morphs.note: The synergy grants both Magicka and Stamina instead of whichever is lowest and you can use your own synergy. Reduces cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka.
Send your spear into the heavens to bring down a shower of divine wrath, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to enemies in the area and an additional 453 Magic Damage every 1 second for 10 seconds. You or an ally near the spear can activate the Holy Shards synergy, which restores 3960 Magicka and Stamina.

morphs.name: Blazing Spear
morphs.note: Increases damage dealt of the residual effect. Initial hit immobilizes enemies.
morphs.desc: Send your spear into the heavens to bring down a shower of divine wrath, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to enemies in the area and an additional 757 Magic Damage every 1 second for 10 seconds. Enemies hit by the initial hit are immobilized for 4 seconds. An ally near the spear can activate the Blessed Shards synergy, restoring 3960 Magicka or Stamina, whichever maximum is higher.

searing-strike.name: Searing Strike
searing-strike.desc: Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing 3175 Flame Damage and an additional 9515 Flame Damage over 10 seconds. The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

morphs.name: Searing Claw
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability. The damage over time increases the longer the effect lasts.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Stamina.
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing 3175 Flame Damage and an additional 9520 Flame Damage over 10 seconds. The flame sears into the target, dealing 10% more damage every 2 seconds. The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

morphs.name: Burning Embers
morphs.note: Adds healing based on your Max Health whenever the ability deals damage.
