morphs.desc: Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing 3175 Flame Damage and an additional 9520 Flame Damage over 10 seconds. You heal for 3413 Health from the initial hit and 510 Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health. The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

summon-storm-atronach.name: Summon Storm Atronach
summon-storm-atronach.desc:
Cost: 200 Ultimate.
Summon an immobile storm atronach at the target location. Its arrival deals 6149 Shock Damage and stuns enemies for 3 seconds. The atronach zaps the closest enemy, dealing 3074 Shock Damage every 1 second. An ally near the atronach can activate the Charged Lightning synergy, granting nearby allies Major Berserk for 10 seconds, increasing their damage done by 10%.

morphs.name: Greater Storm Atronach
morphs.note: Increases the health and damage of the atronach.
morphs.desc: Summon an immobile storm atronach at the target location. Its arrival deals 6149 Shock Damage and stuns enemies for 3 seconds. The atronach zaps the closest enemy, dealing 4127 Shock Damage every 1 second. An ally near the atronach can activate the Charged Lightning synergy, granting nearby allies Major Berserk for 10 seconds, increasing their damage done by 10%.

morphs.name: Summon Charged Atronach
morphs.note: The atronach now uses a powerful area of effect attack, which always applies Concussion.
morphs.desc:
Radius: 8 meters.
Summon an immobile storm atronach at the target location. Its arrival deals 6351 Shock Damage and stuns enemies for 3 seconds. The atronach calls upon a lightning storm every 2 seconds, dealing 6351 Shock Damage to enemies around it. Enemies hit are afflicted with the Concussion status effect. An ally near the atronach can activate the Charged Lightning synergy, granting nearby allies Major Berserk for 10 seconds, increasing their damage done by 10%.

summon-unstable-familiar.name: Summon Unstable Familiar
summon-unstable-familiar.desc: Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric familiar to fight at your side. The familiar's attacks deal 952 Shock Damage. Once summoned, you can activate the familiar's special ability for 3510 Magicka, dealing 1153 Shock Damage every 2 seconds for 20 seconds to enemies near them. The familiar remains until killed or unsummoned.

morphs.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
morphs.note: Summons a clannfear instead of a familiar. Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability to heal you and the clannfear based on your Max Health. The clannfear's basic attacks deal Physical Damage.
morphs.desc: Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals 983 Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for 983 Physical Damage after 1 second. Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for 4320 Magicka, healing you for 5120 and the clannfear for 2559. The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

morphs.name: Summon Volatile Familiar
morphs.note: You summon a volatile familiar. Once summoned, you can activate the familiar's special ability to pulse area damage and stun enemies.
morphs.desc: Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric familiar to fight at your side. The familiar's attacks deal 983 Shock Damage. Once summoned, you can activate the familiar's special ability for 3510 Magicka, dealing 1192 Shock Damage every 2 seconds for 20 seconds to enemies near them. The second hit stuns enemies hit for 3 seconds. The familiar remains until killed or unsummoned.

solar-flare.name: Solar Flare
solar-flare.desc: Conjure a ball of solar energy to heave at an enemy, dealing 6575 Magic Damage and increasing your damage done with class abilities by 5% for 10 seconds. Also grants you Empower for 10 seconds, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150%.

morphs.name: Dark Flare
morphs.note: Reduces cost and applies Major Defile to the target and nearby enemies.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Magicka.
Conjure a ball of solar energy to heave at an enemy, dealing 6790 Magic Damage and increasing your damage done with class abilities by 5% for 10 seconds. Afflicts the target and enemies within 8 meters with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by 12% for 4 seconds. Also grants you Empower for 10 seconds, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150%.

morphs.name: Solar Barrage
morphs.note: Deals damage in multiple blasts as damage over time around you instead of at a single enemy.
morphs.desc:
Casting Time: Instant, Duration: 20 seconds, Area: 8 meters, Target: Area.
Conjure solar energy to blast enemies around you, dealing 1192 Magic Damage every 2 seconds and increasing your damage done with class abilities by 5% for 20 seconds. While this ability is active you gain Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150%.

slaughter.name: Slaughter
slaughter.desc: WHILE DUAL WIELDING Increases damage with Dual Wield abilities by 10% against enemies with under 25% Health.
slaughter.desc_max: WHILE DUAL WIELDING Increases damage with Dual Wield abilities by 20% against enemies with under 25% Health.

slayer.name: Slayer
slayer.desc: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 1% for each Fighters Guild ability slotted.
slayer.desc_max: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 3% for each Fighters Guild ability slotted.

skilled-tracker.name: Skilled Tracker
skilled-tracker.desc: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional 10% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

silver-bolts.name: Silver Bolts
silver-bolts.desc: Fire a Dawnguard Vampire Hunter's crossbow bolt to strike an enemy, dealing 5717 Physical Damage.

morphs.name: Silver Shards
morphs.note: Fires additional bolts at other enemies near the initial target for less damage.
morphs.desc:
Area: 5 meters.
Fire an augmented Dawnguard Vampire Hunter's crossbow bolt to strike an enemy, dealing 5717 Physical Damage. Fires additional bolts at other enemies near the initial target for 22% less damage.

morphs.name: Silver Leash
morphs.note: Decrease the range and damage, increases the cost, but pulls the enemy to you, attempts to taunt them, and snares them.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3780 Stamina, Range: 22 meters.
Fire a Dawnguard's crossbow hook to pull an enemy to you, dealing 3936 Physical Damage, taunting them for 15 seconds if they are not already taunted, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

spell-warding.name: Spell Warding
spell-warding.desc: Increases your Spell Resistance by 363 for each piece of Light Armor equipped.
spell-warding.desc_max: Increases your Spell Resistance by 726 for each piece of Light Armor equipped.

shield-charge.name: Shield Charge
shield-charge.desc: Rush an enemy with your shield raised and ram them, dealing 3811 Physical Damage and stunning them for 3 seconds. You automatically block all attacks at no cost for 0.5 seconds after activating.

morphs.name: Shielded Assault
morphs.note: Gain a damage shield after the block effect ends.
morphs.desc: Rush an enemy and ram them, dealing 3811 Physical Damage and stunning them for 3 seconds. You automatically block all attacks at no cost for 0.5 seconds after activating. When this ends, you gain a damage shield that absorbs 5120 damage for 6 seconds. The shield strength scales off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Invasion
morphs.note: Stuns longer based on the distance traveled. Reduces the cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3510 Stamina.
Rush an enemy and ram them, dealing 3811 Physical Damage and stunning them for 4 seconds. The stun duration increases by up to 50%, based on how far you traveled. You automatically block all attacks at no cost for 0.5 seconds after activating.

steadfast-ward.name: Steadfast Ward
steadfast-ward.desc: Call on your staff's strength to protect you or the lowest health ally around you with a damage shield that absorbs 6351 damage for 6 seconds. The shield's strength is increased by up to 100%, depending on the severity of the target's wounds.

morphs.name: Ward Ally
morphs.note: Cast two shields instead of one, with one shield always on yourself. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4320 Magicka.
Call on your staff's strength to protect you and the lowest health ally around you with a damage shield that absorbs 6352 damage. The shield's strength is increased by up to 100%, depending on the severity of the target's wounds.

morphs.name: Healing Ward
morphs.note: Heals target based on the shield's strength every second it persists.
morphs.desc: Call on your staff's strength to protect you or the lowest health ally around you with a damage shield that absorbs 6561 damage. The shield's strength is increased by up to 100%, depending on the severity of the target's wounds. While the shield persists, the target is healed for 33% of the shield's remaining strength every second.

shadow-barrier.name: Shadow Barrier
shadow-barrier.desc: Casting a Shadow ability grants you Major Resolve for 6 seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948. This duration is increased by 2 seconds for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. Current duration: (2 * # Heavy Armor + 6) seconds.
shadow-barrier.desc_max: Casting a Shadow ability grants you Major Resolve for 12 seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948. This duration is increased by 2 seconds for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. Current duration: (2 * # Heavy Armor + 12) seconds

shadow-cloak.name: Shadow Cloak
shadow-cloak.desc:
Cost: 2970 Magicka / 1s.
Cloak yourself in shadow to become invisible. When moving your Magicka Recovery is disabled and when not moving Shadow Cloak is half cost. When Shadow Cloak begins or ends, you gain Born From Shadow for 15 seconds, increasing your damage done to monsters by 15%. While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by 5%.

morphs.name: Shadowy Disguise
morphs.note: Guarantees a Critical Strike on your next attack after activating. Cost decreases as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka / 1s.
Cloak yourself in shadow to become invisible. When moving your Magicka Recovery is disabled and when not moving Shadowy Disguise is half cost. Your next direct damage attack will Critically Strike. When Shadowy Disguise begins or ends, you gain Born From Shadow for 15 seconds, increasing your damage done to monsters by 15%. While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by 5%.

morphs.name: Dark Cloak
morphs.note: No longer grants invisibility. Now heals over time based on your Max Health.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4050 Magicka, Duration: 3 seconds.
Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for 853 Health every 1 second, over 3 seconds, increasing by an additional 150% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health. While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by 5%.

summon-shade.name: Summon Shade
summon-shade.desc: Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for 20 seconds. The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing 1270 Magic Damage once every 2 seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for 4 seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by 5%.

morphs.name: Dark Shade
morphs.note: The summoned shade's attacks now hit in an area and deal increased damage.
morphs.desc: Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for 20 seconds. The shade attacks nearby enemies within 9 meters of it, dealing 1705 Magic Damage once every 2 seconds and afflicting them with Minor Maim for 4 seconds, reducing their damage done by 5%.

morphs.name: Shadow Image
morphs.note: The summoned shade now is stationary and attacks from a range but costs more. Activating the ability again while the shade is active allows you to teleport to its position.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3780 Magicka.
Summon a shade version of yourself to stay in place and attack an enemy from range for 20 seconds. The shade shoots at an enemy, dealing 1310 Magic Damage every 2 seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for 4 seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by 5%. While the shade is summoned, you can activate this ability again for no cost to teleport to the shade's location.

soul-siphoner.name: Soul Siphoner
soul-siphoner.desc: Increases your healing done by 1% for each Siphoning ability slotted.
soul-siphoner.desc_max: Increases your healing done by 3% for each Siphoning ability slotted.

soul-shred.name: Soul Shred
soul-shred.desc: Ravage nearby enemies' souls with a night rune, dealing 9529 Magic Damage and stunning them for 4 seconds. An ally can target a ravaged enemy and activate the Soul Leech synergy, dealing 8535 Magic Damage to them and healing for the damage caused.

morphs.name: Soul Siphon
morphs.note: Heals you and your allies instead of damaging and stunning enemies.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 4 seconds, Radius: 28 meters.
Sanctify your soul and the souls of nearby allies with a night rune, healing for 9839 Health and an additional 25656 Health over 4 seconds. You and your allies will also receive Major Vitality, increasing your healing received and damage shield strength by 12% for 4 seconds. An ally can target a nearby enemy and activate the Soul Leech synergy, dealing 8535 Magic Damage to them and healing for the damage caused.

morphs.name: Soul Tether
morphs.note: Heals for half the initial damage caused. Tether to enemies hit, dealing constant damage and healing for damage caused.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 8 seconds.
Ravage nearby enemies' souls with a night rune, dealing 9842 Magic Damage, healing for half the damage, and stunning them for 4 seconds. Ravaged enemies are tethered to you for 8 seconds, and while they remain within 10 meters, you siphon 1713 Health from them every second. An ally can target a ravaged enemy and activate the Soul Leech synergy, dealing 8535 Magic Damage to them and healing for the damage caused.

strife.name: Strife
strife.desc: Steal an enemy's life force, dealing 5894 Magic Damage and healing you or a nearby ally for 33% of the damage inflicted every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. Deals 1% more damage for every 2% Health you have.

morphs.name: Funnel Health
morphs.note: Heals two additional targets.
morphs.desc: Steal an enemy's life force, dealing 6092 Magic Damage and healing you or 3 other nearby allies for 33% of the damage inflicted every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. Deals 1% more damage for every 2% Health you have.

morphs.name: Swallow Soul
morphs.note: Removes Health cost, increases damage, but only heals yourself.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2700 Magicka.
Steal an enemy's life force, dealing 7614 Magic Damage and healing you for 33% of the damage inflicted every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. Deals 1% more damage for every 2% Health you have.

siphoning-strikes.name: Siphoning Strikes
siphoning-strikes.desc: Channel a portion of your soul to convert Health to 2000 Magicka and Stamina. While slotted on either bar, your soul yearns for the warmth of life. All damage you deal heals you for 1250 Health, up to once every 1 second.

morphs.name: Leeching Strikes
morphs.note: Increases the healing done and grants ramping cost reduction for the next cast when the heal activates.
morphs.desc: Channel a portion of your soul to convert Health to 2000 Magicka and Stamina. While slotted on either bar, your soul yearns for the warmth of life. All damage you deal heals you for 1800 Health and reduces the cost of your next Leeching Strikes by 10%, stacking up to 10 times. This effect can occur once every 1 second.

morphs.name: Siphoning Attacks
morphs.note: Increases the Magicka and Stamina restored, and the heal now also restores Magicka and Stamina.
morphs.desc: Channel a portion of your soul to convert Health to 2600 Magicka and Stamina. While slotted on either bar, your soul yearns for the warmth of life. All damage you deal heals you for 1250 Health and restores 200 Magicka and Stamina, up to once every 1 second.

soul-summons.name: Soul Summons
soul-summons.desc: Allows you to revive once every 2 hours without spending a Soul Gem.
soul-summons.desc_max: Allows you to revive once every 1 hour without spending a Soul Gem.

soul-shatter.name: Soul Shatter
soul-shatter.desc: WHEN SOUL ABILITY IS SLOTTED When your Health drops below 20% your soul explodes, dealing 800 Magic Damage to enemies within 8 meters of you. This effect can occur once every 2 minutes and scales off your Max Health.
soul-shatter.desc_max: WHEN SOUL ABILITY IS SLOTTED When your Health drops below 20% your soul explodes, dealing 1600 Magic Damage to enemies within 8 meters of you. This effect can occur once every 2 minutes and scales off your Max Health.

soul-lock.name: Soul Lock
soul-lock.desc: Killing an enemy has a 5% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.
soul-lock.desc_max: Killing an enemy has a 10% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

soul-strike.name: Soul Strike
soul-strike.desc: Burn an enemy from the inside with soulfire, dealing 40488 Magic Damage over 5 seconds. While channeling this ability, you gain immunity to all disabling effects. Enemies affected by this ability are revealed for 3 seconds and may not enter stealth or invisibility. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Soul Assault
morphs.note: Increases the duration of the channel and number of ticks.
morphs.desc:
Channel Time: 6 seconds.
Burn an enemy from the inside with soulfire, dealing 55768 Magic Damage over 6 seconds. While channeling this ability, you gain immunity to all disabling effects. Enemies affected by this ability are revealed for 3 seconds and may not enter stealth or invisibility. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Shatter Soul
morphs.note: Upon completion, deals damage to all enemies near your target.
morphs.desc:
Area: 6 meters.
Burn an enemy from the inside with soulfire, dealing 40494 Magic Damage over 5 seconds. Upon completion, the soulfire overflows and explodes from the enemy, dealing 6558 Magic Damage to all enemies near them. While channeling this ability, you gain immunity to all disabling effects. Enemies affected by this ability are revealed for 3 seconds and may not enter stealth or invisibility. This ability is considered direct damage.

siege-shield.name: Siege Shield
siege-shield.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Create a protective sphere over your location that reduces damage taken from siege weapons by 50% for you and nearby allies.

morphs.name: Siege Weapon Shield
morphs.note: Your and allied siege weapons in the bubble take reduced damage from other siege weapons.
morphs.desc: Create a protective sphere over your location that reduces damage taken from siege weapons by 50% for you and nearby allies. The sphere also protects you and your allies' siege weapons, reducing damage from enemy siege weapons by 75%.

morphs.name: Propelling Shield
morphs.note: Costs less and allies in the shield gain increased range.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 7830 Magicka.
Create a protective sphere over your location that reduces damage taken from siege weapons by 50% for you and nearby allies. Also increases the range of abilities with a range greater than 28 meters by 7 meters. Does not affect Leap, Move Position, and Pull abilities.

scatter-shot.name: Scatter Shot
scatter-shot.desc: Blast an enemy with an explosive arrow, dealing 3811 Physical Damage, knocking them back 8 meters.

morphs.name: Magnum Shot
morphs.note: Deals increased damage and reduces the cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3510 Stamina.
Blast an enemy with an explosive arrow, dealing 4723 Physical Damage and knocking them back 8 meters.

morphs.name: Draining Shot
morphs.note: Heals you if enemy is successfully hit, but snares them instead of stunning.
morphs.desc: Blast an enemy with an enchanted arrow, dealing 3811 Physical Damage and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 3 seconds. If the enemy is hit, you heal for 6558.

snipe.name: Snipe
snipe.desc: Plant a masterfully aimed arrow in an enemy's vital spot, dealing 6575 Physical Damage.

morphs.name: Lethal Arrow
morphs.note: Deals Poison Damage and always applies the Poisoned status effect. Also applies Minor Defile to the enemy.
morphs.desc: Plant a masterfully aimed arrow in an enemy's vital spot, dealing 6790 Poison Damage and applying the Poisoned status effect. Also afflicts enemy with Minor Defile, which reduces their healing received and damage shield strength by 6% for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Focused Aim
morphs.note: Increases the range, always applies the Sundered status effect, and reduces cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2430 Stamina, Range: 40 meters.
Plant a masterfully aimed arrow in an enemy's vital spot, dealing 6574 Physical Damage and applying the Sundered status effect.

scales-of-pitiless-justice.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice
scales-of-pitiless-justice.desc: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by 20%.
scales-of-pitiless-justice.desc_max: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by 50%.

shadowy-supplier.name: Shadowy Supplier
shadowy-supplier.desc: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.

shadow-rider.name: Shadow Rider
shadow-rider.desc: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.

spectral-assassin-skill.name: Spectral Assassin
spectral-assassin-skill.desc: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.

shield-wall.name: Shield Wall
shield-wall.desc:
Duration: 6 seconds.
Reinforce your shield, allowing you to automatically block all attacks at no cost for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Spell Wall
morphs.note: You also reflect all projectiles cast at you.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 7 seconds.
Reinforce your shield, allowing you to automatically block all attacks at no cost and reflect all projectiles cast at you for 7 seconds.

morphs.name: Shield Discipline
morphs.note: Your One Hand and Shield abilities cost nothing while active.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 8 seconds.
Reinforce your shield, allowing you to automatically block all attacks at no cost for 8 seconds. Your One Hand and Shield non-Ultimate abilities cost nothing while this effect persists.

sleet-storm.name: Sleet Storm
sleet-storm.desc: Twist a violent storm around you, dealing 3175 Frost Damage every 1 second for 8 seconds to enemies around you and reducing their Movement Speed by 40%. You cannot conceal your presence while active. You and nearby allies gain Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Northern Storm
morphs.note: Increases your damage done every second while active, and for a duration after.
morphs.desc: Twist a violent storm around you, dealing 3279 Frost Damage every 1 second for 8 seconds to enemies around you and reducing their Movement Speed by 40%. You cannot conceal your presence while active. Increases your damage done by 4%, reduced to 1% while Battle Spirit is active, every 1 second for 12 seconds, up to 9 times. You and nearby allies gain Major Protection, reducing damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Permafrost
morphs.note: Increases the snare potency and applies the Chilled status effect to enemies hit, but at the expense of damage done. Increases the duration as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 13 seconds.
Twist a violent storm around you, dealing 433 Frost Damage every 1 second for 13 seconds to enemies around you and reducing their Movement Speed by 70% and applying the Chilled status effect. You cannot conceal your presence while active. You and nearby allies gain Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.desc: Stir a group of shalk that attack after 3 seconds, dealing 6860 Magic Damage to enemies in front of you. After the shalk complete their attack, they burrow underground for 6 seconds and then resurface again, dealing 9529 Magic Damage to enemies in front of you.

morphs.name: Subterranean Assault
morphs.note: Converts to a Stamina ability and deals Poison Damage. Reduces the cost and time it takes for the ability to deal damage, but the second hit no longer deals increased damage.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2066 Stamina, Duration: 6 seconds.
Stir a group of shalk that attack after 3 seconds, dealing 7086 Poison Damage to enemies in front of you. After the shalk complete their attack, they burrow underground for 3 seconds and then resurface again, dealing 7086 Poison Damage to enemies in front of you.

morphs.name: Deep Fissure
morphs.note: Applies Major and Minor Breach to enemies hit, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance.
morphs.desc: Stir a group of shalk that attack after 3 seconds, dealing 7086 Magic Damage to enemies in front of you. After the shalk complete their attack, they burrow underground for 6 seconds and then resurface again, dealing 9842 Magic Damage to enemies in front of you. Enemies damaged are afflicted with Major and Minor Breach, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 and 2974 for 10 seconds.

secluded-grove.name: Secluded Grove
secluded-grove.desc: Swell a healing forest at the target location, instantly healing the most injured friendly target for 7623 Health. The forest continues to heal you and your allies in the area for 2541 Health every 1 second for 6 seconds.

morphs.name: Enchanted Forest
morphs.note: Generate Ultimate if the initial heal is used on a low health target.
morphs.desc: Swell a healing forest at the target location, instantly healing the most injured friendly target for 7873 Health. The forest continues to heal you and your allies in the area for 2623 Health every 1 second for 6 seconds. You generate 20 Ultimate if the initial heal is used on a friendly target under 50% Health.

morphs.name: Healing Thicket
morphs.note: The healing over time will continue to heal you and your allies after leaving the area.
morphs.desc: Swell a healing forest at the target location, instantly healing the most injured friendly target for 7873 Health. The forest continues to heal you and your allies in the area for 2623 every 1 second for 6 seconds. The healing over time will continue to heal you or your allies for 4 seconds after leaving the forest.

see-the-unseen.name: See the Unseen
see-the-unseen.desc: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

spell-orb.name: Spell Orb
spell-orb.desc: When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for 10 seconds. When you reach 5 spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing 1537 Magic Damage. This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.
spell-orb.desc_max: When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for 10 seconds. When you reach 5 spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing 3071 Magic Damage. This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.

spirit-mender.name: Spirit Mender
spirit-mender.desc: Conjure a ghostly spirit to do your bidding and stay by your side for 16 seconds. The spirit heals you or the lowest Health ally around you every 2 seconds, restoring 1905 Health. Creates a corpse on death if you are in combat.

morphs.name: Spirit Guardian
morphs.note: Some of the damage you take is transferred to the spirit instead.
morphs.desc: Conjure a ghostly spirit to do your bidding and stay by your side for 16 seconds. The spirit heals you or the lowest Health ally around you every 2 seconds, restoring 1967 Health. While active, 10% of the damage you take is transferred to the spirit instead. Creates a corpse on death if you are in combat.

morphs.name: Intensive Mender
morphs.note: The spirit lasts for half as long, but heals for twice the amount, heals two additional allies, and costs half as much.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2160 Magicka, Duration: 8 seconds, Area: 8 meters, Target: Area.
Conjure a ghostly spirit to do your bidding and stay by your side for 8 seconds. The spirit heals you or lowest Health ally around you every 2 seconds, restoring 3936 Health to the target and 2 allies nearby them. Creates a corpse on death if you are in combat.

skeletal-mage.name: Skeletal Mage
skeletal-mage.desc: Unearth a skeletal mage from the dirt to fight by your side for 20 seconds, while granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%. The mage attacks the closest enemy every 2 seconds, dealing 1270 Shock Damage. Creates a corpse on death if you are in combat.

morphs.name: Skeletal Archer
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Physical Damage. The archer deals more damage with each attack.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2525 Stamina.
Unearth a skeletal archer from the dirt to fight by your side for 20 seconds, while granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%. The archer attacks the closest enemy every 2 seconds, dealing 1269 Physical Damage. Each time the archer deals damage, it deals 15% more damage than the previous attack. Creates a corpse on death if you are in combat.

morphs.name: Skeletal Arcanist
morphs.note: The mage deals damage to all enemies around the initial target.
morphs.desc:
Area: 5 meters, Target: Area.
Unearth a skeletal mage from the dirt to fight by your side for 20 seconds, while granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%. The mage attacks the closest enemy every 2 seconds, dealing 1310 Shock Damage to them and all other enemies nearby. Creates a corpse on death if you are in combat.

shocking-siphon.name: Shocking Siphon
shocking-siphon.desc: Violently drain the last spark of life from a corpse, dealing 16860 Shock Damage over 20 seconds to all enemies around the corpse and between you and the corpse. You also gain Major Savagery for 20 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. While slotted, your damage done is increased by 3%.

morphs.name: Detonating Siphon
morphs.note: Ability now deals Disease Damage. The corpse explodes at the end of the siphon, dealing additional damage.
morphs.desc: Violently drain the last spark of life from a corpse, dealing 16920 Disease Damage over 20 seconds to all enemies around the corpse and between you and the corpse. You also gain Major Savagery for 20 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. When the siphon ends the corpse explodes, dealing an additional 4921 Disease Damage to all enemies nearby. While slotted, your damage done is increased by 3%.

morphs.name: Mystic Siphon
morphs.note: Your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery increases while siphoning the corpse.
morphs.desc: Violently drain the last spark of life from a corpse, dealing 16920 Shock Damage over 20 seconds to all enemies around the corpse and between you and the corpse. You also gain Major Savagery for 20 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%. While siphoning the corpse you gain 150 Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery. While slotted, your damage done is increased by 3%.

scriers-patience.name: Scrier's Patience
scriers-patience.desc: Grants you an additional turn of Scrying.
scriers-patience.desc_max: Grants you two additional turns of Scrying.

scry.name: Scry
scry.desc: Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control. Consumes 1 turn.

strike-from-the-shadows.name: Strike from the Shadows
strike-from-the-shadows.desc: While you are at Vampire Stage 2 or higher When you leave Sneak, invisibility, or Mist Form your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by 150 for 6 seconds.
strike-from-the-shadows.desc_max: While you are at Vampire Stage 2 or higher When you leave Sneak, invisibility, or Mist Form your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by 300 for 6 seconds.

splintered-secrets.name: Splintered Secrets
splintered-secrets.desc: What they don't know can kill them. Increase your Physical and Spell Penetration by 620 per Herald of the Tome ability slotted.
splintered-secrets.desc_max: What they don't know can kill them. Increase your Physical and Spell Penetration by 1240 per Herald of the Tome ability slotted.

shadow-of-the-bloodmoon.name: Shadow of the Bloodmoon
shadow-of-the-bloodmoon.desc: The Great Hunt demands more participants. Become a shepard to the lamb who wishes to fight back. Allows you to infect another player with Lycanthropy once every week by returning to the Werewolf ritual site. Players already infected with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria cannot be infected with Lycanthropy.
shadow-of-the-bloodmoon.img_note: The wiki has no icon for this passive; the picture is the Werewolf line's Werewolf Transformation.

share-the-spoils.name: Share the Spoils
share-the-spoils.desc: Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield. Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members 250 Magicka and Stamina, 2 Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.

sphere-of-influence.name: Sphere of Influence
sphere-of-influence.desc: Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you. Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to 2416 damage for 4 seconds and 225 Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for 12 seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at 25% of the target's Max Health.

static-reverberation.name: Static Reverberation
static-reverberation.desc: The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it. When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a 20% chance to deal 942 Shock Damage, up to once every 0.1 seconds. The chance increases by 1% for every 1% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

steadfast-candescence.name: Steadfast Candescence
steadfast-candescence.desc: Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter. Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by 20% while stationary.

sun-shield.name: Sun Shield
sun-shield.desc: Surround yourself with solar rays, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to nearby enemies and applying Minor Maim to them for 10 seconds, reducing their damage done by 5%. The rays then protect you, granting a damage shield that absorbs up to 4800 damage for 6 seconds, increasing by 10% for each enemy hit, up to 60%. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Radiant Ward
morphs.note: Has reduced cost and the shield is strengthened further for each enemy hit.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4320 Magicka.
Surround yourself with solar rays, dealing 4764 Magic Damage to nearby enemies and applying Minor Maim to them for 10 seconds, reducing their damage done by 5%. The rays then protect you, granting a damage shield that absorbs up to 4958 damage for 6 seconds, increasing by 20% for each enemy hit, up to 120%. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

morphs.name: Blazing Shield
morphs.note: No longer deals damage to enemies on activation, instead deals damage when shield expires based on the amount it absorbed, and increases the radius.
morphs.desc:
Radius: 8 meters.
Surround yourself with solar rays, applying Minor Maim to nearby enemies for 10 seconds, reducing their damage done by 5%. You gain a damage shield that absorbs up to 4800 damage for 6 seconds, increasing by 10% for each enemy hit, up to 60%. This ability scales off your Max Health. When the shield expires it explodes, dealing 33% of damage absorbed as Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

teleport-strike.name: Teleport Strike
teleport-strike.desc: Flash through the shadows and ambush an enemy, dealing 4383 Magic Damage and afflicting them with Minor Vulnerability for 10 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 5%.

morphs.name: Lotus Fan
morphs.note: Now deals damage in an area around you, and deals additional damage over time to enemies hit.
morphs.desc:
Area: 6 meters.
Flash through the shadows and ambush an enemy while unleashing a fan of knives, dealing 4383 Magic Damage to them and enemies around you. All enemies hit take an additional 5595 Magic Damage over 5 seconds and are afflicted with Minor Vulnerability for 10 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 5%.

morphs.name: Ambush
morphs.note: Converts to a Stamina ability and deals Physical Damage. Also grants you Empower and Minor Berserk.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3213 Stamina.
Flash through the shadows and ambush an enemy, dealing 4527 Physical Damage and afflicting them with Minor Vulnerability for 10 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 5%. Also grants you Empower and Minor Berserk for 10 seconds, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150% and your damage done by 5%.

war-horn.name: War Horn
war-horn.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Sound a war horn to rally your forces, increasing you and your group's Max Magicka and Max Stamina by 10% for 30 seconds.

morphs.name: Aggressive Horn
morphs.note: You and your allies gain Major Force for a brief period after activation.
morphs.desc: Sound a war horn to rally your forces, increasing you and your group's Max Magicka and Max Stamina by 10% for 30 seconds. You and your allies gain Major Force, increasing your Critical Damage by 20% for 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Sturdy Horn
morphs.note: You and your allies take less damage from critical attacks for a brief period after activation.
morphs.desc: Sound a war horn to rally your forces, increasing you and your group's Max Magicka and Max Stamina by 10% for 30 seconds. You and your allies gain 1320 Critical Resistance for 10 seconds, reducing incoming Critical Damage by 20%.

summon-winged-twilight.name: Summon Winged Twilight
summon-winged-twilight.desc: Call on Azura to send a winged twilight to fight at your side. The winged twilight's zap deals 952 Shock Damage and its kick deals 952 Shock Damage. Once summoned, you can activate the winged twilight's special ability for 4590 Magicka, causing it to heal a friendly target for 9529 and itself for 4761. The winged twilight remains until killed or unsummoned.

morphs.name: Summon Twilight Tormentor
morphs.note: You summon a twilight tormentor, which deals higher damage. Once summoned, you can activate the twilight's special ability to grant it a damage bonus to high health enemies.
morphs.desc:
Target: Self.
Call on Azura to send a twilight tormentor to fight at your side. The twilight tormentor's zap deals 1310 Shock Damage and its kick deals 1310 Shock Damage. Once summoned, you can activate the twilight tormentor's special ability for 2700 Magicka, causing it to deal 60% more damage to enemies above 50% Health for 20 seconds. The twilight tormentor remains until killed or unsummoned.

morphs.name: Summon Twilight Matriarch
morphs.note: You summon a twilight matriarch. Once summoned, you can activate the twilight's special ability to heal the matriarch and up to 2 other friendly targets.
morphs.desc: Call on Azura to send a twilight matriarch to fight at your side. The twilight matriarch's zap deals 952 Shock Damage and its kick deals 952 Shock Damage. Once summoned, you can activate the twilight matriarch's special ability for 4590 Magicka, causing it to heal 2 friendly targets for 9842 and itself for 4921. The twilight matriarch remains until killed or unsummoned.

unholy-knowledge.name: Unholy Knowledge
unholy-knowledge.desc: Reduces the Health, Magicka, and Stamina costs of your non Core Combat abilities by 3%.
unholy-knowledge.desc_max: Reduces the Health, Magicka, and Stamina costs of your non Core Combat abilities by 6%.

sun-fire.name: Sun Fire
sun-fire.desc: Blast an enemy with a charge of radiant heat, dealing 3175 Flame Damage, and an additional 9510 Flame Damage over 20 seconds. Upon activation you gain Major Savagery for 20 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Vampire's Bane
morphs.note: Increases the duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Blast an enemy with a charge of radiant heat, dealing 3175 Flame Damage, and an additional 14760 Flame Damage over 30 seconds. Upon activation you gain Major Savagery for 30 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

morphs.name: Reflective Light
morphs.note: Splits the projectile, allowing it to affect two additional nearby enemies. Briefly snares enemies hit.
morphs.desc:
Area: 5 meters.
Blast up to three enemies with a charge of radiant heat, dealing 3279 Flame Damage, an additional 9530 Flame Damage over 20 seconds, and reducing their Movement Speed by 40% for 3 seconds. Upon activation you gain Major Savagery for 20 seconds, increasing Critical Chance by 12%.

tri-focus.name: Tri Focus
tri-focus.desc: With Destruction Staff Equipped Fully-charged Inferno Staff Heavy Attacks deal an additional 6120 Flame Damage over 20 seconds. Fully-charged Lightning Staff Heavy Attacks damage nearby enemies for 50% of the damage done. Fully-charged Ice Staff Heavy Attacks grant you a damage shield that absorbs 2640 damage. This effect scales off your Max Health. While an Ice Staff is equipped, blocking costs Magicka instead of Stamina.
tri-focus.desc_max: With Destruction Staff Equipped Fully-charged Inferno Staff Heavy Attacks deal an additional 12280 Flame Damage over 20 seconds. Fully-charged Lightning Staff Heavy Attacks damage nearby enemies for 100% of the damage done. Fully-charged Ice Staff Heavy Attacks grant you a damage shield that absorbs 5280 damage. This effect scales off your Max Health. While an Ice Staff is equipped, blocking costs Magicka instead of Stamina.

wall-of-elements.name: Wall of Elements
wall-of-elements.desc: Slam your staff down to create an elemental barrier in front of you, dealing 768 Magic Damage to enemies in the target area every 1 second. Wall of Fire deals additional damage to Burning enemies. Wall of Frost costs more, but snares and reduces armor against Chilled enemies and grants damage shields. Wall of Storms sets Concussed enemies Off Balance.

morphs.name: Unstable Wall of Elements
morphs.note: The wall explodes when it expires, dealing additional damage.
morphs.desc: Create an unstable elemental barrier in front of you, dealing 769 Magic Damage to enemies in the target area every 1 second before exploding for an additional 3279 Magic Damage. Unstable Wall of Fire deals additional damage to Burning enemies. Unstable Wall of Frost costs more, but snares and reduces armor against Chilled enemies and grants damage shields. Unstable Wall of Storms sets Concussed enemies Off Balance.

morphs.name: Elemental Blockade
morphs.note: Increases the size and duration of the wall.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 15 seconds.
Slam your staff down to create an elemental barrier in front of you, dealing 769 Magic Damage to enemies in the target area every 1 second. Blockade of Fire deals additional damage to Burning enemies. Blockade of Frost costs more, but snares and reduces armor against Chilled enemies and grants damage shields. Blockade of Storms sets Concussed enemies Off Balance.

weakness-to-elements.name: Weakness to Elements
weakness-to-elements.desc:
Duration: 30 seconds.
Send the elements to sap an enemy's defenses and afflict them with Major Breach for 30 seconds, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948.

morphs.name: Elemental Susceptibility
morphs.note: Applies each elemental status effect periodically while active and increases the range, but adds a cost.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3240 Magicka, Range: 35 meters.
Send the elements to sap an enemy's defenses and afflict them with Major Breach for 30 seconds, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948. Every 7.5 seconds the enemy is afflicted with the Burning, Chilled, and Concussion status effect.

morphs.name: Elemental Drain
morphs.note: Also applies Minor Magickasteal to the enemy and greatly increases the duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 60 seconds.
Send the elements to sap an enemy's defenses and afflict them with Major Breach for 60 seconds, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948. Also applies Minor Magickasteal to the enemy for 60 seconds, causing you and your allies to restore 168 Magicka every 1 second when damaging them.

twin-blade-and-blunt.name: Twin Blade and Blunt
twin-blade-and-blunt.desc: WHILE DUAL WIELDING Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped: Each axe increases your Critical Damage done by 3%. Each mace increases your Offensive Penetration by 743. Each sword increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 64. Each dagger increases your Critical Chance rating by 328.
twin-blade-and-blunt.desc_max: WHILE DUAL WIELDING Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped: Each axe increases your Critical Damage done by 6%. Each mace increases your Offensive Penetration by 1487. Each sword increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 129. Each dagger increases your Critical Chance rating by 657.

twin-slashes.name: Twin Slashes
twin-slashes.desc: Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing 1587 Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional 9510 Bleed Damage over 20 seconds.

morphs.name: Rending Slashes
morphs.note: Increases the initial damage, applies the Hemorrhaging status effect, and reduces the enemy's Movement Speed.
morphs.desc: Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing 1967 Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional 9530 Bleed Damage over 20 seconds. Enemies hit by the initial hit are afflicted with the Hemorrhaging status effect. You also reduce their Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

morphs.name: Blood Craze
morphs.note: Whenever an enemy is damaged from the attack you are healed.
morphs.desc: Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing 1587 Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional 9530 Bleed Damage over 20 seconds. You heal for 984 Health anytime this ability deals damage.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Launch yourself into a lethal spin, dealing 4764 Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Deals up to 33% more damage to enemies with less than 50% Health.

morphs.name: Whirling Blades
morphs.note: Increases the bonus damage against low health targets.
morphs.desc: Launch yourself into a lethal spin, dealing 4921 Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Deals up to 100% more damage to enemies with less than 50% Health.

morphs.name: Steel Tornado
morphs.note: Increases the radius. Reduces cost as ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 3240 Stamina, Radius: 9 meters.
Launch yourself into a lethal spin, releasing a flurry of blades around you that deals 4764 Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Deals up to 33% more damage to enemies with less than 50% Health.

trap-beast.name: Trap Beast
trap-beast.desc: Set a sharpened blade trap at your location, which takes 1.5 seconds to arm and lasts for 20 seconds. When triggered, the trap deals 3172 Bleed Damage, an additional 9520 Bleed Damage over 20 seconds, and grants you Minor Force, increasing your Critical Damage by 10% for the duration. Enemies who activate the trap are immobilized for 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Barbed Trap
morphs.note: Increases the damage done by the initial hit, and it always applies the Hemorrhaging status effect.
morphs.desc: Set a sharpened blade trap at your location, which takes 1.5 seconds to arm and lasts for 20 seconds. When triggered, the trap deals 3934 Bleed Damage, an additional 9830 Bleed Damage over 20 seconds, and grants you Minor Force, increasing your Critical Damage by 10% for the duration. Enemies hit by the initial hit are afflicted with the Hemorrhaging status effect. Enemies who activate the trap are immobilized for 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Lightweight Beast Trap
morphs.note: The trap can be thrown up to 28 meters away. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2970 Stamina, Range: 28 meters, Target: Ground.
Launch a sharpened blade trap at a target location, which takes 1.5 seconds to arm and lasts for 20 seconds. When triggered, the trap deals 3174 Bleed Damage, an additional 9530 Bleed Damage over 20 seconds, and grants you Minor Force, increasing your Critical Damage by 10% for the duration. Enemies who activate the trap are immobilized for 2 seconds.

unstoppable-skill.name: Unstoppable
unstoppable-skill.desc:
Duration: 20 seconds.
Requires 5 pieces of heavy armor equipped Intensify your physical presence to gain Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds. Also grants you immunity to knockback and disabling effects for 6 seconds, but reduces your Movement Speed by 65% for the duration.

morphs.name: Unstoppable Brute
morphs.note: Decreases the cost as the ability ranks up. While active, each piece of Heavy Armor worn decreases the cost of Break Free.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2943 Stamina.
Requires 5 pieces of heavy armor equipped Intensify your physical presence to gain Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 20 seconds. While this effect persists, each piece of Heavy Armor worn decreases the cost of Break Free by 5%. Also grants you immunity to knockback and disabling effects for 6 seconds, but reduces your Movement Speed by 65% for the duration.

morphs.name: Immovable
morphs.note: Each piece of Heavy Armor worn increases the amount of damage you can block, but also increases the snare strength. Increases duration of Major Resolve as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 23 seconds.
Requires 5 pieces of heavy armor equipped Intensify your physical presence to gain Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 23 seconds. Also grants you immunity to knockback and disabling effects for 6 seconds, but reduces your Movement Speed by (5 * # Heavy Armor + 65) for the duration. Each piece of Heavy Armor worn increases the amount of damage you block and the potency of the snare by 5%.

sword-and-board.name: Sword and Board
sword-and-board.desc: WITH ONE HAND WEAPON AND SHIELD EQUIPPED Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 3% and the amount of damage you can block by 10%.
sword-and-board.desc_max: WITH ONE HAND WEAPON AND SHIELD EQUIPPED Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 5% and the amount of damage you can block by 20%.

veiled-strike.name: Veiled Strike
veiled-strike.desc: Slash an enemy, dealing 6351 Magic Damage. If you strike an enemy from their flank you set them Off Balance.

morphs.name: Surprise Attack
morphs.note: Converts to a Stamina ability and deals Physical Damage. Always applies the Sundered status effect and deals guaranteed critical damage when flanking an enemy.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Stamina.
Slash an enemy, dealing 6561 Physical Damage and applying the Sundered status effect. If you strike an enemy from their flank you set them Off Balance. This attack will also be guaranteed to be a Critical Strike, up to once every 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Concealed Weapon
morphs.note: Deals increased damage, which furthers when leaving Sneak or invisibility. While slotted you gain Minor Expedition.
morphs.desc: Slash an enemy, dealing 6987 Magic Damage. If you strike an enemy from their flank you set them Off Balance. When you leave Sneak or invisibility while in combat, increase your damage done with this ability by 10% for 15 seconds. While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by 15%.

transfer.name: Transfer
transfer.desc: Casting a Siphoning ability while in combat generates 1 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 4 seconds.
transfer.desc_max: Casting a Siphoning ability while in combat generates 2 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 4 seconds.

surge.name: Surge
surge.desc:
Duration: 33 seconds.
Invoke Meridia's name to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 33 seconds. While active, dealing Critical Damage heals you for 2550 Health. This effect can occur once every 1 second.

morphs.name: Power Surge
morphs.note: The heal now heals in an area around you but with a longer cooldown, and only triggers off Critical healing.
morphs.desc:
Area: 18 meters, Target: Area.
Invoke Meridia's name to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon Damage and Spell Damage by 20% for 33 seconds. While active, activating a Critical heal causes the ability to heal you and your allies around you for 2550 Health. This effect can occur once every 3 seconds.

morphs.name: Critical Surge
morphs.note: Increases the healing.
morphs.desc: Invoke Meridia's name to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20% for 33 seconds. While active, dealing Critical Damage heals you for 3300 Health. This effect can occur once every 1 second.

uppercut.name: Uppercut
uppercut.desc: Slam an enemy with an upward swing, dealing 7305 Physical Damage.

morphs.name: Dizzying Swing
morphs.note: Also sets the enemy Off Balance. Hitting Off Balance enemies stuns them. Enemies that are immune to Off Balance are snared.
morphs.desc: Slam an enemy with an upward swing, dealing 7546 Physical Damage and setting them Off Balance for 7 seconds. Hitting an enemy that is already Off Balance stuns them for 2 seconds. Targets that are immune to Off Balance are snared by 40% for 2 seconds.

morphs.name: Wrecking Blow
morphs.note: Grants you Empower and Major Berserk after casting.
morphs.desc: Slam an enemy with an upward swing, dealing 7546 Physical Damage. Grants you Major Berserk and Empower for 3 seconds, increasing damage done by 10% and increasing damage done with Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150%.

trapping-webs.name: Trapping Webs
trapping-webs.desc: Hurl webs to ensnare your foes, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies in the area by 50% and dealing 4761 Physical Damage. After 10 seconds the webs explode, dealing 6349 Poison Damage to enemies within. A ranged ally can activate the Spawn Broodling synergy on an affected enemy, dealing 6149 Poison Damage to them and summoning a spider to attack for 10 seconds. The spider bites enemies for 1845 Physical Damage.

morphs.name: Shadow Silk
morphs.note: The synergy summons a more powerful spider, which deals additional damage over time.
morphs.desc: Hurl webs to ensnare your foes, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies in the area by 50% and dealing 4919 Physical Damage. After 10 seconds the webs explode, dealing 6558 Poison Damage to enemies within. A ranged ally can activate the Black Widow synergy on an affected enemy, dealing 6149 Poison Damage to them and summoning a spider to attack for 10 seconds. The spider bites enemies for 1845 Physical Damage and can poison them for 12282 Poison Damage over 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Tangling Webs
morphs.note: The synergy also fears the enemy.
morphs.desc: Hurl webs to ensnare your foes, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies in the area by 50% and dealing 4763 Physical Damage. After 10 seconds the webs explode, dealing 6349 Poison Damage to enemies within. A ranged ally can activate the Arachnophobia synergy on an affected enemy, dealing 6149 Poison Damage to them, fearing them for 4 seconds, and summoning a spider to attack for 10 seconds. The spider bites enemies for 1845 Physical Damage.

undeath.name: Undeath
undeath.desc: While you are at Vampire Stage 3 or higher Reduces your damage taken by up to 7% based on your missing Health.
undeath.desc_max: While you are at Vampire Stage 3 or higher Reduces your damage taken by up to 15% based on your missing Health.

volley.name: Volley
volley.desc: Launch a multitude of arrows into the sky to rain down, dealing 938 Physical Damage to enemies in the target area every 1 second for 8 seconds, after a 2 second delay.

morphs.name: Endless Hail
morphs.note: Increases the duration.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 15 seconds.
Launch a multitude of arrows into the sky to rain down, dealing 938 Physical Damage to enemies in the target area every 1 second for 13 seconds, after a 2 second delay.

morphs.name: Arrow Barrage
morphs.note: Increases the radius and damage done.
morphs.desc:
Radius: 7 meters.
Launch a multitude of arrows into the sky to rain down, dealing 1263 Physical Damage to enemies in the target area every 1 second for 8 seconds, after a 2 second delay.

trafficker.name: Trafficker
trafficker.desc: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by 120%.
trafficker.desc_max: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by 180%.

werewolf-transformation.name: Werewolf Transformation
werewolf-transformation.desc: Transform into a beast, fearing nearby enemies for 3 seconds. While transformed and in combat, abilities generate 15 Fury. When you have 1000, this ability becomes Rampage, which increases your damage done by 15%, Movement Speed by 20%, and removes the cost of all Werewolf abilities for 20 seconds. While slotted, your Stamina Recovery is increased by 15%.

morphs.name: Pack Leader
morphs.note: While transformed you spawn two direwolves, gain Major Protection and increased block mitigation, and grant Minor Courage to you and your group. Upgrades Rampage to grant Health Recovery while active.
morphs.desc: Transform into an imposing beast, fearing nearby enemies for 3 seconds. You also gain Major Protection, 15% increased Block Mitigation, and you and group members gain Minor Courage. You summon two direwolves that deal 282 Physical Damage twice or 1503 Physical Damage once every 2 seconds. While transformed in combat, abilities generate Fury. When you have 1000, this ability becomes Enduring Rampage, which gains 4000 Health Recovery in addition to its base effects. While slotted, your Stamina Recovery is increased by 15%.

morphs.name: Werewolf Berserker
morphs.note: While transformed, gain Major Berserk and your Light and Heavy Attacks apply a bleed. Improves Insatiable Hunger to grant Fury.
morphs.desc: Transform into a berserk beast, fearing nearby enemies for 3 seconds. While transformed, you gain Major Berserk and your Light Attacks and Heavy Attacks apply a bleed for 3756 Bleed Damage over 4 seconds, or 1878 Bleed Damage after 1 second against players. While transformed and in combat, abilities generate Fury. When you have 1000, this ability becomes Rampage, which increases your damage done, Movement Speed, and removes the cost of Werewolf abilities for 20 seconds. While slotted, your Stamina Recovery is increased by 15%.

vigor.name: Vigor
vigor.desc: Let loose a battle cry, instilling yourself and nearby allies with resolve and healing them for 9522 Health over 10 seconds.

morphs.name: Echoing Vigor
morphs.note: Increases the radius. Increases the duration as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 16 seconds, Radius: 15 meters.
Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for 14280 Health over 16 seconds.

morphs.name: Resolving Vigor
morphs.note: The heal over time now happens faster over a shorter duration, heals for more, increases your Armor, but now only targets yourself.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 5 seconds, Target: Self.
Let loose a battle cry, instilling yourself with resolve and healing for 14760 Health over 5 seconds. After casting you gain Minor Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by 2974, for 20 seconds.

undaunted-command.name: Undaunted Command
undaunted-command.desc: Activating a synergy restores 2% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.
undaunted-command.desc_max: Activating a synergy restores 4% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

undaunted-mettle.name: Undaunted Mettle
undaunted-mettle.desc: Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by 1% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped.
undaunted-mettle.desc_max: Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by 2% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped.

swiftly-forgotten.name: Swiftly Forgotten
swiftly-forgotten.desc: Bounty is decreased by 46 after 3 minutes. Heat is decreased by 36 after 3 seconds.
swiftly-forgotten.desc_max: Bounty is decreased by 115 after 3 minutes. Heat is decreased by 64 after 3 seconds.

timely-escape.name: Timely Escape
timely-escape.desc: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.

veil-of-shadows.name: Veil of Shadows
veil-of-shadows.desc: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by 10%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.desc: Unleash a swarm of fetcherflies to relentlessly attack an enemy, dealing 12683 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. The fetcherflies rip through the enemy's flesh, afflicting them with Minor Vulnerability for the duration, increasing their damage taken by 5%.

morphs.name: Fetcher Infection
morphs.note: Every second cast deals increased damage.
morphs.desc: Unleash a swarm of fetcherflies to relentlessly attack an enemy, dealing 13079 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. Every second cast of this ability deals 75% increased damage. The fetcherflies rip through the enemy's flesh, afflicting them with Minor Vulnerability for the duration, increasing their damage taken by 5%.

morphs.name: Growing Swarm
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability and deals Bleed Damage. Deals additional damage to nearby enemies of the affected target, but limits the cast to one at a time.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2525 Stamina, Area: 5 meters.
Unleash a swarm of fetcherflies to relentlessly attack an enemy, causing them to bleed for 13079 Bleed Damage over 20 seconds. The fetcherflies rip through the original enemy's flesh, afflicting them with Minor Vulnerability for the duration, increasing their damage taken by 5%. Enemies near the carrier take 1189 Bleed Damage every 2 seconds for the duration. You can only have one Growing Swarm active at a time.

undo.name: Undo
undo.desc:
Cost: 165 Ultimate.
Step backwards in time, resetting your Health, Magicka, Stamina, and position to what they were 4 seconds ago.

morphs.name: Precognition
morphs.note: You can cast the ability while crowd controlled and will automatically gain Crowd Control Immunity.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 150 Ultimate.
Step backwards in time, resetting your Health, Magicka, Stamina, and position to what they were 4 seconds ago. You can cast this ability while you are crowd controlled and it automatically grants you Crowd Control Immunity.

morphs.name: Temporal Guard
morphs.note: While slotted your damage taken is reduced.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 150 Ultimate.
Step backwards in time, resetting your Health, Magicka, Stamina, and position to what they were 4 seconds ago. While slotted you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by 5%.

time-stop.name: Time Stop
time-stop.desc:
Cost: 7830 Magicka.
Freeze the passage of time at the target location, gradually reducing the Movement Speed of enemies in the area during the channel before finally stunning them in place for 3 seconds when the channel completes.

morphs.name: Borrowed Time
morphs.note: Negates healing done on enemies that are stunned.
morphs.desc: Freeze the passage of time at the target location, gradually reducing the Movement Speed of enemies in the area during the channel before finally stunning them in place for 3 seconds when the channel completes. Enemies that are stunned gain 5000 Heal Absorption for 3 seconds, negating the next 5000 points of healing done.

morphs.name: Time Freeze
morphs.note: Removes the cast time, but it takes longer to stun enemies. Reduces the cost as the ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Casting Time: Instant, Channel Time: , Cost: 7560 Magicka, Duration: 4 seconds.
Freeze the passage of time at the target location, gradually reducing the Movement Speed of enemies in the area over 4 seconds before finally stunning them in place for 3 seconds when the duration completes.

undead-confederate.name: Undead Confederate
undead-confederate.desc: While you have a Sacrificial Bones, Skeletal Mage, or Spirit Mender active, your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery is increased by 77.
undead-confederate.desc_max: While you have a Sacrificial Bones, Skeletal Mage, or Spirit Mender active, your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery is increased by 155.

sundering-swing.name: Sundering Swing
sundering-swing.desc: Smash Volendrung into a structure, dealing 10000 Physical Damage every 0.8 seconds for 3 seconds.

vampiric-drain.name: Vampiric Drain
vampiric-drain.desc: Siphon away your enemies' vitality, dealing 2379 Magic Damage and healing you for 25% of your missing Health every 1 second for 3 seconds. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Drain Vigor
morphs.note: Restores a portion of your missing Stamina.
morphs.desc: Siphon away your enemies' vitality, dealing 2381 Magic Damage, healing you for 25% of your missing Health, and restoring 10% of your missing Stamina every 1 second for 3 seconds. This ability is considered direct damage.

morphs.name: Exhilarating Drain
morphs.note: Generates Ultimate.
morphs.desc: Siphon away your enemies' vitality, dealing 2381 Magic Damage, healing you for 25% of your missing Health, and generating 5 Ultimate every 1 second for 3 seconds. This ability is considered direct damage.

trowel.name: Trowel
trowel.desc: Removes 3 layers of dirt or rock from a 1x1 area. Costs 2 Intuition to use.
trowel.desc_max: Removes 3 layers of dirt or rock from a 1x1 area. Costs 2 Intuition to use. Can safely trigger Fissures to create explosive chain reactions.

unnatural-movement.name: Unnatural Movement
unnatural-movement.desc: While you are at Vampire Stage 4 Reduces the cost of Sprint by 25%. If you continuously Sprint for 6 seconds you automatically become invisible.
unnatural-movement.desc_max: While you are at Vampire Stage 4 Reduces the cost of Sprint by 50%. If you continuously Sprint for 3 seconds you automatically become invisible.

tome-bearers-inspiration.name: Tome-Bearer's Inspiration
tome-bearers-inspiration.desc: Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every 5 seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional 3172 Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none. While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%.

morphs.name: Inspired Scholarship
morphs.note: Increases the frequency of damage.
morphs.desc: Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every 3 seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional 2556 Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none. While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%.

morphs.name: Recuperative Treatise
morphs.note: When dealing damage, restore Magicka and Stamina.
morphs.desc: Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every 5 seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional 3175 Magic Damage, restores 600 Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none. While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 20%.

the-imperfect-ring.name: The Imperfect Ring
the-imperfect-ring.desc: Cost Determined by Lowest Max Resource Devise a flawed rune under an enemy that etches foes nearby with scrawled glyphs, dealing 12683 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. An ally near the initial target can activate the Runebreak synergy, dealing 7380 Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

morphs.name: Rune of Displacement
morphs.note: Places a rune under the target that deals damage and pulls nearby enemies after a delay.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 18 seconds, Radius: 10 meters.
Cost Determined by Lowest Max Resource Devise a discharging rune under an enemy. After 2 seconds the rune pulses, pulling in foes between 2 to 10 meters and etching them with scrawled glyphs that deal 13100 Magic Damage over 18 seconds. An ally near the initial target can activate the Runebreak synergy, dealing 7380 Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

morphs.name: Fulminating Rune
morphs.note: Deals additional area damage after a delay. Up to 3 allies can use the Runebreak synergy.
morphs.desc: Cost Determined by Lowest Max Resource Devise an explosive rune under an enemy that etches foes nearby with scrawled glyphs, dealing 12672 Magic Damage over 20 seconds. The rune lingers on the initial target for 6 seconds before detonating, dealing 3934 Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters. Rune detonation cannot be primed with Fulminating Rune again for 6 seconds. Up to 3 allies near the initial target can activate the Runebreak synergy, dealing 7380 Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

the-unblinking-eye.name: The Unblinking Eye
the-unblinking-eye.desc: Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for 6 seconds and deals 3047 Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every 0.5 seconds. The scion's beam can be repositioned by recasting The Unblinking Eye.

morphs.name: The Tide King's Gaze
morphs.note: Beam duration is increased, automatically follows the initial target, and searches for new targets if it is slain.
morphs.desc:
Duration: 8 seconds, Target: Enemy.
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for 8 seconds that deals 3148 Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every 0.5 seconds. The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

morphs.name: The Languid Eye
morphs.note: Also applies a snare to enemies hit and damage increases over time.
morphs.desc: Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for 6 seconds that deals 3047 Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every 0.5 seconds and snares them by 50% for 3 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds, the beam's damage increases by 7%. The scion's beam can be repositioned by recasting The Languid Eye.

wellspring-of-the-abyss.name: Wellspring of the Abyss
wellspring-of-the-abyss.desc: Apocryphal knowledge bubbles up from the depths of your psyche, increasing your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 40 for each Soldier of Apocrypha ability slotted.
wellspring-of-the-abyss.desc_max: Apocryphal knowledge bubbles up from the depths of your psyche, increasing your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 81 for each Soldier of Apocrypha ability slotted.

vitalizing-glyphic.name: Vitalizing Glyphic
vitalizing-glyphic.desc: Summon an Apocryphal glyphic, which you and your allies can heal. The glyphic spawns at 30% Health and grows stronger the more you heal it. The power within the glyphic grants up to 200 Weapon and Spell Damage and heals you and your allies around it for up to 2541 Health every 1 second in proportion to its Health.

morphs.name: Glyphic of the Tides
morphs.note: The glyphic spawns at a higher Health percentage and grants additional damage reduction when it is fully powered.
morphs.desc: Summon an Apocryphal glyphic, which you and your allies can heal. The glyphic spawns at 53% Health and grows stronger the more you heal it. The power within the glyphic grants up to 200 Weapon and Spell Damage and heals you and your allies around it for up to 2540 Health every 1 second in proportion to its Health. At full Health the glyphic grants Major Protection, reducing damage taken by 10%.

morphs.name: Resonating Glyphic
morphs.note: Dealing damage to the glyphic powers it up instead of healing it, but requires you to be in combat to activate.
morphs.desc: Summon an Apocryphal glyphic while in combat, which you and your allies can damage. The glyphic spawns at 70% Health and grows stronger the more you damage it. The glyphic grants up to 200 Weapon and Spell Damage and heals you and your allies around it for up to 2623 Health every 1 second in proportion to its Health.

vinedusk-training.name: Vinedusk Training
vinedusk-training.desc: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Increases your damage done by 2% against enemies 15 meters or closer. Increases your Critical Chance rating by 657 against enemies further than 15 meters.
vinedusk-training.desc_max: WITH BOW EQUIPPED Increases your damage done by 5% against enemies 15 meters or closer. Increases your Critical Chance rating by 1314 against enemies further than 15 meters.

superheated-ward.name: Superheated Ward
superheated-ward.desc: Roil the air around you or an ally, granting a damage shield that absorbs up to 12356 for 6 seconds. This ability scales off the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina and is capped at 50% of the target's Max Health.

morphs.name: Volcanic Ward
morphs.note: Adds damage reduction to the next attack. Heals when the shield ends.
morphs.desc: Roil the air around you or an ally, granting a damage shield that absorbs up to 12356 for 6 seconds and reducing the next instance of damage taken by 10%. When the shield ends the latent heat warms the target, healing them for 4417 Health. This ability scales off the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina and the shield is capped at 50% of the target's Max Health.

morphs.name: Magma Fist
morphs.note: Converts into a Stamina ability that deals damage instead of shielding. Enemies hit take additional damage from all sources.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 2295 Stamina, Range: 28 meters, Target: Enemy.
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing 6561 Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by 66 for 7 seconds per stack, up to 3 times. Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within 6 seconds by 66%, up to once every 6 seconds.

the-storm-voice.name: The Storm Voice
the-storm-voice.desc: The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight. When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore 8 Health, 8 Magicka, and 8 Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by 3. Current amount: 8 Health 8 Magicka 8 Stamina
the-storm-voice.desc_max: The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight. When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore 16 Health, 16 Magicka, and 16 Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by 6. Current amount: 16 Health 16 Magicka 16 Stamina

traumatic-burns.name: Traumatic Burns
traumatic-burns.desc: Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes. Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take 5% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by 15% for 5 seconds.
traumatic-burns.desc_max: Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes. Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take 5% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by 30% for 5 seconds.

tundras-maw.name: Tundra's Maw
tundras-maw.desc: Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold. Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for 2.1 seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by 20%.

unbound-potential.name: Unbound Potential
unbound-potential.desc: Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle. Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by 30%, halving against players, for the duration.

veils-forfeit.name: Veil's Forfeit
veils-forfeit.desc: Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release. While you are in combat, directly healing a target below 66% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within 10 seconds, up to once every second. Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by 50%.

world-in-ruin.name: World in Ruin
world-in-ruin.desc: Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake. Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by 3%.
world-in-ruin.desc_max: Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake. Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by 7%.

wind-walker.name: Wind Walker
wind-walker.desc: Increases your Stamina Recovery by 2% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. Reduces the Stamina cost of your abilities by 1% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.
wind-walker.desc_max: Increases your Stamina Recovery by 4% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. Reduces the Stamina cost of your abilities by 2% per piece of Medium Armor equipped.

wing-buffet.name: Wing Buffet
wing-buffet.desc:
Cost: 4320 Magicka.
Unfurl draconic wings to knock back enemies around you 4 meters and stun them for 1.8 seconds. The winds from your buffet swirl around you, reducing your damage taken from projectiles by 50% for 6 seconds, while granting you Major Expedition for 4 seconds, increasing Movement Speed by 30%.

morphs.name: Fleetstep Wings
morphs.note: Gain immunity to snares and immobilizations. Cost reduces as ability ranks up.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4050 Magicka.
Unfurl draconic wings to knock back enemies around you 4 meters and stun them for 1.8 seconds. The enchanted winds sent forth by your wings coalesce around you, reducing your damage taken from projectiles by 50% for 6 seconds, while granting you immunity to snares and immobilizations and Major Expedition for 4 seconds, increasing Movement Speed by 30%.

morphs.name: Protect the Brood
morphs.note: Converts the knockback into partial protection for group members. Adds Minor Protection.
morphs.desc:
Cost: 4050 Magicka, Area: 12 meters.
Unfurl draconic wings to safeguard you and nearby group members for 6 seconds, reducing damage taken from projectiles by 50% for you and 25% for group members. You and your brood gain Minor Protection for 20 seconds, reducing damage taken by 5%. You gain Major Expedition for 4 seconds, increasing Movement Speed by 30%.

wild-adaptation.name: Wild Adaptation
wild-adaptation.desc: The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it. Gain 333 Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of 1665.

wildfire-embers.name: Wildfire Embers
wildfire-embers.desc: Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames. When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing 4284 Flame Damage over 12 seconds. This effect stacks up to 12 times and increases in damage 25% per stack.

highborn.name: Highborn
highborn.desc: Increases your experience gain with the Destruction Staff skill line by 15%. Increases your experience gained by 1%.

spell-recharge.name: Spell Recharge
spell-recharge.desc: When you activate an ability, you restore 200 Magicka or Stamina, based on whichever is lowest. This effect can occur once every 6 seconds. When you are using an ability with a channel or cast time, you take 1% less damage.
spell-recharge.desc_max: When you activate an ability, you restore 625 Magicka or Stamina, based on whichever is lowest. This effect can occur once every 6 seconds. When you are using an ability with a channel or cast time, you take 5% less damage.

elemental-talent.name: Elemental Talent
elemental-talent.desc: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 86.
elemental-talent.desc_max: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 258.

amphibian.name: Amphibian
