amphibian.desc: Increases your experience gain with the Restoration Staff skill line by 15%. Increases your swimming speed by 50%.

resourceful.name: Resourceful
resourceful.desc: Increases your Max Magicka and Max Stamina by 333. When you drink a potion, you restore 1000 Health, Magicka, and Stamina.
resourceful.desc_max: Increases your Max Magicka and Max Stamina by 1000. When you drink a potion, you restore 3125 Health, Magicka, and Stamina.

argonian-resistance.name: Argonian Resistance
argonian-resistance.desc: Increases your Max Health by 333 and your Disease and Poison Resistance by 660.
argonian-resistance.desc_max: Increases your Max Health by 1000 and your Disease and Poison Resistance by 2310.

acrobat.name: Acrobat
acrobat.desc: Increases your experience gain with the Bow skill line by 15%. Decreases your fall damage taken by 10%.

resist-affliction.name: Resist Affliction
resist-affliction.desc: Increases your Max Stamina by 600 and your Disease and Poison Resistance by 660.
resist-affliction.desc_max: Increases your Max Stamina by 2000 and your Disease and Poison Resistance by 2310.

hunters-eye.name: Hunter's Eye
hunters-eye.desc: Increases your Stealth Detection radius by 1 meter. Increases your Movement Speed by 1% and your Physical and Spell Penetration by 300.
hunters-eye.desc_max: Increases your Stealth Detection radius by 3 meters. Increases your Movement Speed by 5% and your Physical and Spell Penetration by 950.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.desc: Increases your experience gain with the Light Armor skill line by 15%. Increases your Alliance Points gained by 1%.

spell-attunement.name: Spell Attunement
spell-attunement.desc: Increases your Spell Resistance by 660. This effect is doubled if you are afflicted with Burning, Chilled, or Concussed. Increases your Magicka Recovery by 40.
spell-attunement.desc_max: Increases your Spell Resistance by 2310. This effect is doubled if you are afflicted with Burning, Chilled, or Concussed. Increases your Magicka Recovery by 130.

magicka-mastery.name: Magicka Mastery
magicka-mastery.desc: Reduces the Magicka cost of your abilities by 2%.
magicka-mastery.desc_max: Reduces the Magicka cost of your abilities by 7%.

ashlander.name: Ashlander
ashlander.desc: Increases your experience gain with the Dual Wield skill line by 15%. Reduces your damage taken from environmental lava by 50%.

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.desc: Increases your Max Magicka and Max Stamina by 600.
dynamic.desc_max: Increases your Max Magicka and Max Stamina by 1910.

ruination-skill.name: Ruination
ruination-skill.desc: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 86.
ruination-skill.desc_max: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 258.

diplomat.name: Diplomat
diplomat.desc: Increases your experience gain with the One Hand and Shield skill line by 15%. Increases your gold gained by 1%.

red-diamond.name: Red Diamond
red-diamond.desc: Reduces the cost of all your abilities by 2%.
red-diamond.desc_max: Reduces the cost of all your abilities by 6%.

cutpurse.name: Cutpurse
cutpurse.desc: Increases your experience gain with the Medium Armor skill line by 15%. Increases your chance to successfully pickpocket by 5%.

robustness.name: Robustness
robustness.desc: Increases your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 30.
robustness.desc_max: Increases your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 90.

feline-ambush.name: Feline Ambush
feline-ambush.desc: Increases your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by 4%. Decreases your detection radius in Stealth by 1 meter.
feline-ambush.desc_max: Increases your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by 12%. Decreases your detection radius in Stealth by 3 meters.

reveler.name: Reveler
reveler.desc: Increases your experience gain with the Two Handed skill line by 15%. Increases the duration of any consumed drink by 15 minutes.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.desc: Increases your Max Stamina by 500. When you take damage, you gain 1 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.
stalwart.desc_max: Increases your Max Stamina by 1500. When you take damage, you gain 5 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

resist-frost.name: Resist Frost
resist-frost.desc: Increases your Max Health by 333 and Frost Resistance by 1540.
resist-frost.desc_max: Increases your Max Health by 1000 and Frost Resistance by 4620.

rugged.name: Rugged
rugged.desc: Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by 866.
rugged.desc_max: Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by 2600.

craftsman.name: Craftsman
craftsman.desc: Increases your experience gain with the Heavy Armor skill line by 15%. Increases your crafting inspiration gained by 10%.

unflinching-rage.name: Unflinching Rage
unflinching-rage.desc: Increases your Max Health by 300. When you deal damage, you heal for 700 Health. This can occur once every 4 seconds.
unflinching-rage.desc_max: Increases your Max Health by 1000. When you deal damage, you heal for 2125 Health. This can occur once every 4 seconds.

swift-warrior.name: Swift Warrior
swift-warrior.desc: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 86. Reduces the cost of Sprint by 4% and increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by 3%.
swift-warrior.desc_max: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by 258. Reduces the cost of Sprint by 12% and increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by 10%.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.desc: Increases your experience gain with the One Hand and Shield skill line by 15%. Increases the duration of any eaten food by 15 minutes.

adrenaline-rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline-rush.desc: When you deal damage, you restore 333 Stamina. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.
adrenaline-rush.desc_max: When you deal damage, you restore 1005 Stamina. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.

martial-training.name: Martial Training
martial-training.desc: Reduces the cost of your weapon abilities by 2%. Reduces the effectiveness of snares applied to you by 5%.
martial-training.desc_max: Reduces the cost of your weapon abilities by 8%. Reduces the effectiveness of snares applied to you by 15%.

lunar-blessings.name: Lunar Blessings
lunar-blessings.desc: Increase your Maximum Health, Magicka, and Stamina by 305.
lunar-blessings.desc_max: Increase your Maximum Health, Magicka, and Stamina by 915.
